Challenge_AReallyCDDAy_desc.EN: You get out of the shower and fall badly. You're blind drunk, and have a nasty cold. <LINE> <LINE> On top of all this, the house is on fire! Oh, and there's a zombie apocalypse. Today is definitely not your day. <LINE> <LINE> [A challenge inspired by the "Really Bad Day" scenario from the awesome, wonderful, and MUST-PLAY Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead]
Challenge_AReallyCDDAy_desc.CN: 你 从 浴 室 出 来 就 摔 得 很 惨 . 昨 晚 喝 得 烂 醉 如 泥 , 现 在 还 得 了 重 感 冒 . <LINE> <LINE> 更 糟 糕 的 是 , 房 子 着 火 了 ! 今 天 绝 对 不 是 你 的 幸 运 日 . <LINE> <LINE>( 这 个 挑 战 的 灵 感 来 自 于 超 赞 , 精 彩 , 必 玩 的 《 大 灾 变 : 黑 暗 之 日 》 中 的 " 真 正 糟 糕 的 一 天 ")

Challenge_AStormIsComingInfoBox.CN: <CENTRE>你将面对无穷无尽的恶劣天气…

Challenge_AStormIsComing_desc.EN: Clouds are gathering over Kentucky. The crackle of thunder can be heard in the distance. <LINE> <LINE> As skies darken, the dead that stumble over the earth grow restless. <LINE> <LINE> This is a storm that will grow and fall back in its ferocity, but it will never end.
Challenge_AStormIsComing_desc.CN: 肯 塔 基 州 上 空 乌 云 密 布 . 远 处 传 来 雷 鸣 . <LINE> <LINE> 随 着 天 色 渐 暗 , 地 上 的 死 者 开 始 躁 动 不 安 . <LINE> <LINE> 这 场 来 势 凶 猛 的 风 暴 时 强 时 弱 , 但 永 远 不 会 结 束 .

Challenge_Challenge1_desc.EN: You thought you were safe out here, in the middle of nowhere. Now, you can hear moans throughout the forest. Hordes of deadheads, encroaching on your isolated cabin from every angle, waiting to feast on your delicious flesh. Death is inevitable, but a shotgun is close at hand. <LINE> <LINE> Last Stand features endless waves of zombies in ever-increasing numbers. Survive for as long as possible against the overwhelming odds.
Challenge_Challenge1_desc.CN: 你 能 听 到 它 们 正 在 靠 近 . 成 群 结 队 的 尸 潮 , 从 四 面 八 方 涌 向 你 与 世 隔 绝 的 小 屋 . 死 亡 不 可 避 免 的 , 但 猎 枪 就 在 身 旁 . <LINE> <LINE> 背 水 一 战 的 特 色 是 数 量 不 断 增 加 的 无 尽 尸 潮 . 在 压 倒 性 的 困 难 中 尽 可 能 生 存 下 去 .

Challenge_Challenge1_name.EN: House in the Woods - Last Stand
Challenge_Challenge1_name.CN: 林中小屋 - 背水一战

Challenge_Challenge2_PressKey.EN: Press "o" for permanent boost and to spend some money.
Challenge_Challenge2_PressKey.CN: 按 "o" 键 花点钱并获得永久加成.

Challenge_Challenge2_WaveFinished.CN: 第 %1 波 完成时间: %2

Challenge_Challenge2_WaveStart.CN: 第 %1 波: %2 (按 Enter 键跳过)

Challenge_Challenge2_desc.EN: Another day, another cabin ready to be bloodied. The hordes are upon you, and your death will be as painful as it is gruesome. So go out fighting. <LINE> <LINE> Last Stand Accumulator features endless waves of zombies in ever-increasing numbers. Use money earned by killing zeds to buy equipment, level up skills, and repair your blood-soaked weaponry.
Challenge_Challenge2_desc.CN: 另 一 天 , 另 一 间 准 备 浴 血 的 小 屋 . 大 批 尸 潮 向 你 涌 来 , 你 的 死 亡 将 无 比 痛 苦 且 可 怕 . 所 以 殊 死 一 搏 吧 … <LINE> <LINE> 背 水 一 战 - 累 计 赏 金 的 特 色 是 数 量 不 断 增 加 的 无 尽 尸 潮 . 用 击 杀 僵 尸 赚 到 的 钱 来 购 买 装 备 , 提 升 等 级 和 修 理 你 的 武 器 .

Challenge_Challenge2_name.EN: House in the Woods - Last Stand Accumulator
Challenge_Challenge2_name.CN: 林中小屋 - 背水一战 累计赏金

Challenge_Kingsmouth_desc.EN: Escape from the world in our tropical paradise! Explore a unique island with a sprawling four-story resort, bungalows on a private boardwalk, a small town filled with friendly locals, and more! <LINE><LINE> For fishing, swimming, the best food and drink, or simple relaxation, there's no place like Kingsmouth. Just remember to bring your sunblock! <LINE><LINE>
Challenge_Kingsmouth_desc.CN: 远 离 世 俗 , 来 这 处 热 带 天 堂 ! 快 去 探 索 这 座 独 特 的 岛 屿 小 镇 : 四 层 楼 的 度 假 村 , 木 板 路 连 接 的 水 上 小 屋 , 还 有 热 情 好 客 的 居 民 ! <LINE><LINE> 无 论 是 钓 鱼 , 游 泳 , 品 尝 美 食 美 酒 , 还 是 放 松 身 心 , 王 口 岛 都 是 您 的 理 想 之 选 . 别 忘 了 带 上 防 晒 霜 哦 ! <LINE><LINE>

Challenge_OpeningHoursInfoBox.EN: <CENTRE> The Mall opens at 9AM. <LINE> <LINE> Get ready for the crowds.
Challenge_OpeningHoursInfoBox.CN: <CENTRE> 商 场 在 上 午 九 点 开 门 . <LINE> <LINE> 准 备 好 迎 接 尸 潮 …

Challenge_OpeningHours_desc.EN: Once upon a time, The Mall was an important place in their lives. Instinct has led them to its doors. A memory of what they used to do. <LINE> <LINE> You are alone, but not for long. At 9AM the Mall will be ready for business: the doors will open, and the hordes will enter. The only bargain they're looking for is your tasty flesh! <LINE> <LINE> Shop 'til you drop, survivor.
Challenge_OpeningHours_desc.CN: 商 场 被 包 围 了 , 这 里 曾 经 是 它 们 生 活 中 的 重 要 场 所 . 本 能 将 它 们 引 向 大 门 . 就 像 活 着 的 时 候 那 样 … <LINE> <LINE> 你 独 自 一 人 , 但 坚 持 不 了 太 久 . 上 午 九 点 , 商 场 将 开 始 营 业 : 门 会 打 开 , 成 群 的 僵 尸 将 无 情 闯 入 . <LINE> <LINE> 趁 还 没 死 , 赶 紧 搜 刮 .

Challenge_Studio_desc.EN: Tours of the Mountain Lion Pictures Studios backlot are now available! See where classic movies such as CyberKiller 2, Mother's Boy, and The Dog Goblin were filmed. <LINE><LINE>Explore our sets such as Town, Graveyard, Spooky Cabin, and more. Become the star of classic movies using our bluescreens. Shoot replicas of classic weapons like "Filthy" Larry Salatch's Magnum or CyberKiller's sawed-off JS2000 at our firing range. You might even see a famous face or two! <LINE><LINE> PLEASE NOTE: Tours only take place at night. Our casts and crew members can get a little jumped up on caffeine during daylight hours!
Challenge_Studio_desc.CN: 美 洲 狮 影 业 (Mountain Lion Pictures Studios) 的 外 景 地 现 已 开 放 参 观 ! 快 来 参 观 《 赛 博 杀 手 2 》 《 妈 妈 的 男 孩 》 和 《 狗 妖 精 》 等 经 典 电 影 的 拍 摄 地 吧 ! <LINE><LINE> 你 可 以 探 索 我 们 的 拍 摄 场 景 : 例 如 小 镇 , 墓 地 还 有 鬼 屋 . 也 可 以 借 用 我 们 的 蓝 幕 , 摇 身 一 变 成 为 经 典 电 影 的 明 星 ! 还 可 以 在 这 里 的 靶 场 把 玩 经 典 武 器 的 复 制 品 , 例 如 " 肮 脏 者 " 拉 里 · 萨 拉 奇 的 马 格 南 手 枪 , 或 是 赛 博 杀 手 的 短 管 JS2000 步 枪 . 没 准 你 还 能 看 见 一 两 位 明 星 哦 ! <LINE><LINE> 注 意 : 参 观 仅 在 夜 间 进 行 . 白 天 , 我 们 的 演 职 人 员 总 是 因 喝 太 多 咖 啡 而 兴 奋 不 已 !

Challenge_TheDescendingFog_desc.EN: People first saw it on the water. A faint white blanket over the Ohio river. <LINE> <LINE> It began as a mist. Then it enveloped the town. The townsfolk died screaming in the gloom. Now they walk out there. <LINE> <LINE> Unseen, unheard and relentless in the pursuit of the living.
Challenge_TheDescendingFog_desc.CN: 人 们 第 一 次 看 到 它 是 在 水 面 上 . 像 一 条 淡 淡 的 白 色 毯 子 覆 盖 着 俄 亥 俄 河 . <LINE> <LINE> 它 开 始 只 是 一 片 薄 雾 . 很 快 笼 罩 了 整 个 城 镇 . 人 们 在 阴 霾 中 尖 叫 着 死 去 , 现 在 它 们 走 出 来 了 . <LINE> <LINE> 在 对 生 者 的 追 逐 中 , 无 形 , 无 声 , 无 情 .

Challenge_WinterIsComingInfoBox.EN: <CENTRE> In three days the endless winter begins. <LINE> <LINE> Wrap up warm.
Challenge_WinterIsComingInfoBox.CN: <CENTRE> 再 过 三 天 无 尽 的 冬 天 就 开 始 了 . <LINE> <LINE> 多 穿 点 …

Challenge_WinterIsComing_desc.EN: It's mid-July, but suddenly there's a chill on the breeze. In a mere three days, a winter like no other before it will set in. <LINE> <LINE> You awake in an isolated location, with meager supplies. The undead hordes might be slowed by the intense cold - but they are no less deadly. <LINE> <LINE> Wrap up warm, survivor.
Challenge_WinterIsComing_desc.CN: 现 在 是 七 月 中 旬 , 但 微 风 中 突 然 传 来 一 股 寒 意 . 再 过 三 天 就 会 迎 来 一 个 前 所 未 有 的 冬 天 . <LINE> <LINE> 在 一 个 与 世 隔 绝 的 地 方 醒 来 . 你 的 物 资 匮 乏 , 僵 尸 可 能 会 因 为 严 寒 而 减 慢 脚 步 , 但 仍 然 致 命 . <LINE> <LINE> 多 穿 点 , 幸 存 者 …

Challenge_YouHaveOneDayInfoBox.EN: <CENTRE> In 24 hours your trip back to Knox County will become Hell on Earth.
Challenge_YouHaveOneDayInfoBox.CN: <CENTRE>再过 24 小时你在诺克斯县的旅程就会变得困难无比…

Challenge_YouHaveOneDay_desc.EN: You're back in Knox County, the map where the Project Zomboid infection first began. <LINE> <LINE> You have one day of relative safety. Then the zombies will arrive in huge numbers, and they WILL find you. Where did you make your last stand in the old days? Better find it quick. <LINE> <LINE> [Our thanks to Community mapper BobHeckling for recreating the old 0.1.5 map with the current PZ toolset!]
Challenge_YouHaveOneDay_desc.CN: 你 回 到 了 诺 克 斯 县 , 又 回 到 了 僵 尸 毁 灭 工 程 最 初 的 地 图 上 . <LINE> <LINE> 你 只 有 一 天 时 间 做 准 备 . 然 后 尸 潮 将 会 蜂 拥 而 至 , 它 们 会 无 情 的 猎 杀 你 . 昔 日 你 曾 在 何 处 坚 守 阵 地 ? 赶 紧 找 到 它 . <LINE> <LINE>[ 感 谢 社 区 地 图 制 作 者 BobHeckling 使 用 当 前 的 PZ 工 具 集 重 新 创 建 了 0.1.5 版 本 的 地 图 ! ]

IGUI_AnimalTrailer_Info.EN: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Animal Trailer <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> To put an animal inside a trailer, bring it near the rear door and right click the trailer. <LINE> You can also do so with a small animal you are carrying. <LINE> <LINE> The animals can eat from the food container inside a trailer. <LINE> You can also directly feed or give water to an animal inside a trailer by right clicking on the trailer. <LINE> Trailers have a nest box, which chickens will lay eggs inside. <LINE> Each trailer has a total capacity, with each animal adding to this capacity depending on their type and size. <LINE> Animals in trailers will slowly gain stress when the trailer is moving.
IGUI_AnimalTrailer_Info.CN: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> 动 物 拖 车 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> 如 果 需 要 将 动 物 放 入 拖 车 , 先 将 动 物 带 到 后 门 附 近 , 然 后 右 键 点 击 拖 车 . <LINE> 你 也 可 以 对 自 己 身 上 携 带 的 小 型 动 物 右 键 拖 车 放 入 拖 车 . <LINE> <LINE> 动 物 可 以 食 用 拖 车 内 的 食 物 容 器 中 的 食 物 . <LINE> 你 也 可 以 通 过 右 键 点 击 拖 车 , 直 接 向 拖 车 内 的 动 物 喂 食 或 供 水 . <LINE> 拖 车 配 备 有 巢 箱 , 鸡 会 在 其 中 下 蛋 . <LINE> 每 辆 拖 车 都 有 总 容 量 限 制 , 每 种 动 物 会 根 据 其 种 类 和 体 型 占 用 相 应 的 容 量 . <LINE> 拖 车 移 动 时 , 车 内 的 动 物 会 逐 渐 产 生 压 力 .

IGUI_AnimalUI_Info.EN: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Animal Info <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> Animals need a Livestock Zone, created using the "designation" icon on the left. Any zones that touch form a bigger zone. More detailed information can be found on the Zone info panel, and in the Survival Guide. <LINE> <LINE> Build a trough using the Carpentry menu. The trough has to be in the animal's designation zone to work properly. <LINE> More detailed information can be found on the trough info panel. <LINE> <LINE> Add food by placing it in the trough's container. <LINE> Add water in the trough by right clicking it. <LINE> <LINE> Animals get stressed by loud noises, being near zombies, and by people running near them. <LINE> <LINE> Males usually attack each other during their mating season. <LINE> Babies that need milk need access to their mothers.
IGUI_AnimalUI_Info.CN: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> 动 物 信 息 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> 动 物 需 要 " 畜 牧 区 ", 可 通 过 左 侧 工 具 栏 的 " 规 划 " 图 标 创 建 . 相 邻 区 域 会 自 动 合 并 . 更 多 细 节 可 在 区 域 信 息 面 板 和 生 存 指 南 中 查 看 . <LINE> <LINE> 可 通 过 木 工 菜 单 建 造 饲 料 槽 . 饲 料 槽 必 须 位 于 动 物 所 属 区 域 内 才 能 生 效 . <LINE> 详 细 说 明 见 饲 料 槽 信 息 面 板 . <LINE> <LINE> 向 容 器 内 放 置 食 物 以 添 加 饲 料 . <LINE> 右 键 点 击 饲 料 槽 添 加 饮 水 . <LINE> <LINE> 动 物 会 因 以 下 情 况 产 生 压 力 : 巨 大 噪 音 , 附 近 有 僵 尸 , 人 类 奔 跑 经 过 , <LINE> <LINE> 雄 性 动 物 在 发 情 期 会 互 相 攻 击 . <LINE> 幼 崽 需 要 接 触 母 体 获 取 乳 汁 .

IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_boar.EN: <LINE> <LINE> Boar: <LINE> Piglets need milk from their mother. <LINE> Their mating season is September to February. <LINE> Males don't fight each other. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, and Animal Feed.
IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_boar.CN: <LINE> <LINE> 公 猪 : <LINE> 猪 崽 需 要 从 母 猪 获 取 乳 汁 . <LINE> 发 情 期 : 9 月 至 次 年 2 月 <LINE> 公 猪 之 间 不 会 争 斗 . <LINE> 可 食 用 : 干 草 , 青 草 , 蔬 菜 , 水 果 和 动 物 饲 料 .

IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_bull.EN: <LINE> <LINE> Bull: <LINE> Calves need milk from their mother. <LINE> Mating season is all year round. <LINE> From adolescence, bulls will fight other bulls. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, and Animal Feed.
IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_bull.CN: <LINE> <LINE> 公 牛 : <LINE> 牛 犊 需 要 从 母 牛 获 取 乳 汁 . <LINE> 全 年 都 是 发 情 期 . <LINE> 从 青 春 期 开 始 , 公 牛 会 与 其 他 公 牛 争 斗 . <LINE> 可 食 用 : 干 草 , 青 草 , 蔬 菜 , 水 果 和 动 物 饲 料 .

IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_cockerel.EN: <LINE> <LINE> Cockerel: <LINE> Cockerels will go into a hutch at night. Animals inside closed hutch will be protected from predators. <LINE> Animals will leave the hutch in the morning. <LINE> Only a hen that has been fertilized by a cockerel can lay eggs that will hatch. <LINE> Mating season is all year round. <LINE> From adolescence, cockerels will fight other cockerels. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, Seeds, Nuts, and Animal Feed.
IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_cockerel.CN: <LINE> <LINE> 公 鸡 : <LINE> 母 鸡 会 在 夜 间 进 入 鸡 舍 . 关 闭 鸡 舍 门 后 , 内 部 的 动 物 可 免 受 掠 食 者 侵 害 . <LINE> 动 物 们 会 在 早 晨 离 开 鸡 舍 . <LINE> 只 有 与 公 鸡 交 配 过 的 母 鸡 才 能 产 下 可 孵 化 的 蛋 . <LINE> 全 年 都 是 发 情 期 . <LINE> 成 年 后 会 与 其 他 公 鸡 争 斗 . <LINE> 可 食 用 : 干 草 , 青 草 , 蔬 菜 , 水 果 , 种 子 , 坚 果 和 动 物 饲 料 .

IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_cow.EN: <LINE> <LINE> Cow: <LINE> Calves need milk from their mother. <LINE> Mating season is all year round. <LINE> Cows start to produce milk a few days after becoming pregnant. <LINE> You can milk a cow with a bucket. <LINE> When the pregnancy is over, if not milked or the calf does not feed from its mother, the cow will stop producing milk after few days. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, and Animal Feed.
IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_cow.CN: <LINE> <LINE> 奶 牛 : <LINE> 牛 犊 需 要 从 母 牛 获 取 乳 汁 . <LINE> 全 年 都 是 发 情 期 . <LINE> 母 牛 怀 孕 几 天 后 开 始 产 奶 . <LINE> 你 可 以 使 用 桶 给 奶 牛 挤 奶 . <LINE> 妊 娠 结 束 后 , 如 果 没 有 挤 奶 或 牛 犊 没 有 从 母 牛 处 进 食 , 母 牛 几 天 后 就 会 停 止 产 奶 . <LINE> 可 食 用 : 干 草 , 青 草 , 蔬 菜 , 水 果 和 动 物 饲 料 .

IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_ewe.EN: <LINE> <LINE> Ewe: <LINE> Lambs need milk from their mother. <LINE> Mating season is September to February. <LINE> Ewes start to produce milk a few days after becoming pregnant. <LINE> You can milk a sheep with a bucket. <LINE> When the pregnancy is over, if not milked or a lamb doesn't feed from the ewe, the ewe will stop producing milk after a few days. <LINE> The ewe starts producing wool from adolescence. <LINE> You can shear an animal that has enough wool with a Shears. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, and Animal Feed.
IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_ewe.CN: <LINE> <LINE> 母 羊 : <LINE> 羊 羔 需 要 从 母 羊 获 取 乳 汁 . <LINE> 发 情 期 : 9 月 至 次 年 2 月 . <LINE> 怀 孕 数 日 后 开 始 产 奶 . <LINE> 你 可 以 使 用 桶 给 奶 牛 挤 奶 . <LINE> 妊 娠 结 束 后 , 如 果 未 被 挤 奶 或 羊 羔 未 进 食 , 产 后 数 日 停 止 泌 乳 . <LINE> 青 春 期 开 始 产 羊 毛 . <LINE> 你 可 以 用 剪 刀 剪 取 足 量 羊 毛 <LINE> 可 食 用 : 干 草 , 青 草 , 蔬 菜 , 水 果 和 饲 料 .

IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_hen.EN: <LINE> <LINE> Hen: <LINE> Hens will go into a hutch at night. Animals inside a closed hutch will be protected from predators. <LINE> Animals will leave the hutch in the morning. <LINE> Chicken lays one egg per day. <LINE> Only a hen that has been fertilized by a cockerel will lay eggs that will hatch. <LINE> Mating season is all year round. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, Seeds, Nuts, and Animal Feed.
IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_hen.CN: <LINE> <LINE> 母 鸡 : <LINE> 母 鸡 会 在 夜 间 进 入 鸡 舍 . 关 闭 鸡 舍 门 后 , 内 部 的 动 物 可 免 受 掠 食 者 侵 害 . <LINE> 动 物 们 会 在 早 晨 离 开 鸡 舍 . <LINE> 每 只 母 鸡 每 天 会 产 一 枚 蛋 . <LINE> 只 有 被 公 鸡 受 精 的 母 鸡 才 能 产 下 可 孵 化 的 蛋 . <LINE> 全 年 都 是 发 情 期 . <LINE> 可 食 用 : 干 草 , 青 草 , 蔬 菜 , 水 果 , 种 子 , 坚 果 和 动 物 饲 料 .

IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_pig.EN: <LINE> <LINE> Pig: <LINE> Piglets need milk from their mother. <LINE> Their mating season is September to February. <LINE> Sows start to produce milk a few days after becoming pregnant. <LINE> When the pregnancy is over, if not milked or a piglet doesn't feed from the sow, the sow will stop producing milk after a few days. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, and Animal Feed.
IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_pig.CN: <LINE> <LINE> 母 猪 : <LINE> 猪 崽 需 要 从 母 猪 那 里 获 取 乳 汁 . <LINE> 发 情 期 : 9 月 至 次 年 2 月 . <LINE> 母 猪 怀 孕 几 天 后 开 始 产 奶 . <LINE> 妊 娠 结 束 后 , 如 果 没 有 挤 奶 或 猪 崽 没 有 从 母 猪 那 里 进 食 , 母 猪 几 天 后 就 会 停 止 产 奶 . <LINE> 可 食 用 : 干 草 , 青 草 , 蔬 菜 , 水 果 和 动 物 饲 料 .

IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_ram.EN: <LINE> <LINE> Ram: <LINE> Lambs need milk from their mother. <LINE> Mating season is September to February. <LINE> From adolescence, rams will fight other rams. <LINE> Rams start producing wool from adolescence. <LINE> You can shear an animal that has enough wool with a Shears. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, and Animal Feed.
IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_ram.CN: <LINE> <LINE> 公 羊 : <LINE> 羊 羔 需 要 从 母 羊 获 取 乳 汁 . <LINE> 发 情 期 : 9 月 至 次 年 2 月 . <LINE> 青 春 期 起 会 与 其 他 公 羊 争 斗 . <LINE> 你 可 以 用 剪 刀 剪 取 足 量 羊 毛 <LINE> 可 食 用 : 干 草 , 青 草 , 蔬 菜 , 水 果 和 饲 料 .

IGUI_Animal_ZoneFirstInfo.EN: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Farm animals needs a Livestock Zone to know where to stay. <LINE> <LINE> Animals in a Zone will never leave it unless they're stressed, hungry or thirsty. <LINE> <LINE> A fence is needed only to protect them from predators. <LINE> <LINE> If two or more Zones touch, they are considered as one Zone. <LINE> <LINE> Troughs and Hutches should be inside an animal's Zone so the animal can find them.
IGUI_Animal_ZoneFirstInfo.CN: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> 畜 禽 需 要 一 个 牲 畜 区 来 确 定 它 们 的 栖 息 地 . <LINE> <LINE> 如 果 一 个 区 域 内 有 动 物 , 它 们 将 永 远 不 会 离 开 该 区 域 , 除 非 它 们 感 到 压 力 , 饥 饿 或 口 渴 . . <LINE> <LINE> 只 要 需 要 的 话 , 就 需 要 设 置 围 栏 来 保 护 它 们 免 受 捕 食 者 的 侵 害 . <LINE> <LINE> 如 果 两 个 或 更 多 的 区 域 相 邻 , 它 们 将 被 视 为 一 个 区 域 . <LINE> <LINE> 水 槽 和 小 棚 应 该 放 置 在 动 物 所 在 的 区 域 内 , 以 便 动 物 能 够 找 到 它 们 .

IGUI_Burpees_Tooltip.EN: Improves strength and fitness when performed regularly. Will drain endurance a lot.
IGUI_Burpees_Tooltip.CN: 定期进行锻炼可提高力量水平和身体强度. 但会消耗很多耐力.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_AddItem.EN: Allows the player to add an item to their inventory or other players inventory. Use command /additem and /addkey or items list UI.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_AddItem.CN: 允许玩家将物品添加到自己的或其他玩家的库存中. 使用 /additem 和 /addkey 命令或物品列表 UI.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_AddUserlog.EN: Player can add their own entries to logs of other players on the server. Use context menu in Users List window.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_AddUserlog.CN: 玩家可以在服务器上其他玩家的日志中添加自己的条目. 使用用户列表窗口中的上下文菜单.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_AddXP.EN: Allows the player to add experience points to themselves or other players. Use command /addxp.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_AddXP.CN: 允许玩家为自己或其他玩家增加经验值. 使用 /addxp 命令.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_AdminChat.EN: Player have access to a separate chat channel for administrators.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_AdminChat.CN: 玩家可以访问专门为管理员设置的聊天频道.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_AnimalCheats.EN: Allows player to use AnimalCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_AnimalCheats.CN: 允许玩家使用 AnimalCheats, 该功能在 AdminPowers 窗口中启用.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_AnswerTickets.EN: Allows player to see and manage the list of in-game tickets raised by other players. Use See Tickets button in the Admin panel.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_AnswerTickets.CN: 允许玩家查看和管理其他玩家提交的游戏内问题列表. 使用管理面板中的查看问题按钮.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_BanUnbanUser.EN: Player have the ability to ban and unban users from the server. Use commands /banuser, /unbanuser, /banid and /unbanid.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_BanUnbanUser.CN: 玩家可以封禁和解封服务器上的用户. 使用 /banuser, /unbanuser, /banid 和 /unbanid 命令.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_BypassLuaCheck.EN: Checksum verification for Lua files is disabled for player, allowing for potentially unauthorized modifications.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_BypassLuaCheck.CN: 禁用对 Lua 文件的校验和验证, 允许玩家进行潜在的未经授权的修改.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanAlwaysJoinS.EN: Player can always join a server, even if it's full.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanAlwaysJoinS.CN: 玩家可以随时加入服务器, 即使服务器已满.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanGoInsideSaf.EN: Player have access to safehouses that are typically locked.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanGoInsideSaf.CN: 玩家可以访问通常被锁定的安全屋.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanHearAll.EN: Player can hear all voice conversations occurring on the server. Use option in Admin Powers window.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanHearAll.CN: 玩家能够听到服务器上进行的所有语音对话. 可通过"管理员权限"窗口中的选项来使用此功能.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanMedicalChea.EN: Allows player to use MedicalCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanMedicalChea.CN: 允许玩家使用医疗作弊功能, 该功能在 AdminPowers 窗口中启用.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanModifyPlaye.EN: Player can modify player stats. Use Player Stats button in the Admin Panel.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanModifyPlaye.CN: 玩家可以修改自己的属性值. 请在管理面板中点击"玩家属性"按钮进行操作.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanOpenLockedD.EN: Player can open normally inaccessible doors.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanOpenLockedD.CN: 玩家可以打开通常无法进入的门.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanSeeAll.EN: Allows player to see other players regardless of obstacles. Use option in Admin Powers window.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanSeeAll.CN: 允许玩家无视障碍物查看其他玩家. 使用 Admin Powers 窗口中的选项.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanSeeMessageF.EN: Allows player to receive messages sent by players for administrators.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanSeeMessageF.CN: 允许玩家接收玩家发送给管理员的消息.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanSeePlayersS.EN: Player can see the statistics and information of other players. Use Player Stats button in Admin Panel.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanSeePlayersS.CN: 玩家可以查看其他玩家的统计信息和详情. 使用管理面板中的玩家统计按钮.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanSetupNonPVP.EN: Player can establish areas on the map where PvP combat is disabled. Use Non PVP Zone button in the Admin Panel.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanSetupNonPVP.CN: 玩家可以在地图上建立禁用 PvP 战斗的区域. 使用管理面板中的非 PvP 区域按钮.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanSetupSafeho.EN: Player can create and configure safe houses within the game world. Use context menu and commands /addtosafehouse, /kickfromsafehouse and /releasesafehouse.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CanSetupSafeho.CN: 玩家可以在游戏世界中创建和配置安全屋. 使用上下文菜单和 /addtosafehouse, /kickfromsafehouse 及 /releasesafehouse 命令.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CantBeBannedBy.EN: Player will not be banned by the anti-cheat system.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CantBeBannedBy.CN: 玩家不会被反作弊系统封禁.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CantBeBannedBy.EN: Player can't be banned by other users.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CantBeBannedBy.CN: 玩家不能被其他用户封禁.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CantBeKickedBy.EN: Player will not be kicked by the anti-cheat system.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CantBeKickedBy.CN: 玩家不会被反作弊系统踢出.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CantBeKickedBy.EN: Player can't be kicked by other users.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CantBeKickedBy.CN: 玩家不能被其他用户踢出.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CantBeKickedIf.EN: Player won't be kicked for lag issues.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CantBeKickedIf.CN: 玩家不会因延迟问题被踢出.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_ChangeAccessLe.EN: Player can change the access level of other players on the server. Use command /setaccesslevel.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_ChangeAccessLe.CN: 玩家可以更改服务器上其他玩家的访问级别. 使用 /setaccesslevel 命令.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_ChangeAndReloa.EN: Player can modify and reload server options on-the-fly. Use commands /changeoption and /reloadoptions.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_ChangeAndReloa.CN: 玩家可以即时修改并重新加载服务器选项. 使用 /changeoption 和 /reloadoptions 命令.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_ClimateManager.EN: Player can control and alter environmental factors like the weather on the server. Use Climate Control button in Admin Panel.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_ClimateManager.CN: 玩家可以控制和修改环境因素, 如服务器上的天气. 使用管理面板中的气候控制按钮.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_ConnectWithDeb.EN: Player have access to a debugging connection with specific permissions. Use commands /debugplayer and /setTimeSpeed.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_ConnectWithDeb.CN: 玩家可以使用具有特定权限的调试连接功能. 请使用命令 /debugplayer 和 /setTimeSpeed 来操作.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CreateHorde.EN: Player can spawn hordes of zombies at a desired location. Use /createhorde and /createhorde2 console commands.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CreateHorde.CN: 玩家可以在指定位置生成僵尸群. 使用 /createhorde 和 /createhorde2 控制台命令.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CreateStory.EN: Player can create custom storylines or scenarios within the game. Use Randomized Zone Story and Randomized Road Story context menu options.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_CreateStory.CN: 玩家可以在游戏中创建自定义故事线或场景. 使用随机区域故事和随机道路故事的上下文菜单选项.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_DebugConsole.EN: Player have access to a console command interface for debugging and testing purposes. Use commands /log and /clear.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_DebugConsole.CN: 玩家可以访问用于调试和测试的控制台命令界面. 使用 /log 和 /clear 命令.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_DisplayServerM.EN: Player can broadcast messages to all players on the server. Use /servermsg console command.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_DisplayServerM.CN: 玩家可以向服务器上的所有玩家广播消息. 使用 /servermsg 控制台命令.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_EditItem.EN: Player can change properties or attributes of items in the game world. Use inventory context menu option.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_EditItem.CN: 玩家可以更改游戏中物品的属性或特征. 使用库存中的上下文菜单选项.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_FactionCheat.EN: Allows player to manage factions. Use button in the Admin Panel.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_FactionCheat.CN: 允许玩家管理派系. 使用管理面板中的按钮.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_GeneralCheats.EN: Allows player to use /roll and /card console commands. Also allows to remove vehicles.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_GeneralCheats.CN: 允许玩家使用 /roll 和 /card 控制台命令. 还可以移除车辆.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_GetStatistic.EN: Allows player to access detailed server, connections and packets statistics. Use Packet Counts and Show Statistics buttons in Admin panel.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_GetStatistic.CN: 允许玩家访问详细的服务器, 连接和数据包统计信息. 使用管理面板中的数据包计数和显示统计信息按钮.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_GetSteamScoreb.EN: Allows player to use mini scoreboard in Admin panel.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_GetSteamScoreb.CN: 允许玩家在管理面板中使用迷你计分板.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_HideFromSteamU.EN: Player can make themselves invisible from other players in the Users List window on Steam servers.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_HideFromSteamU.CN: 玩家可以在 Steam 服务器的用户列表窗口中使自己对其他玩家不可见.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_InspectPlayerI.EN: Player can view the inventory contents of any other player on the server.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_InspectPlayerI.CN: 玩家可以查看服务器上任何其他玩家的物品栏内容.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_KickUser.EN: Player can kick other players from the server. Use /kick or /kickuser console commands.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_KickUser.CN: 玩家可以将其他玩家踢出服务器. 使用 /kick 或 /kickuser 控制台命令.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_LoginOnServer.EN: Allows player to login to server.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_LoginOnServer.CN: 允许玩家登录到服务器.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_MakeEventsAlar.EN: Allows the player to trigger in-game sound events. Use commands /alarm, /gunshot, /thunder, and /chopper.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_MakeEventsAlar.CN: 允许玩家触发游戏内的声音事件. 使用 /alarm, /gunshot, /thunder 和 /chopper 命令.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_ManipulateMods.EN: Player can update installed mods within the game. Use /checkModsNeedUpdate command.
IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_ManipulateMods.CN: 玩家可以更新游戏中安装的模组. 使用 /checkModsNeedUpdate 命令.

IGUI_CapabilitiesTooltips_ManipulateVehi.EN: Allows player to spawn vehicles in the game world. Use /addvehicle console command.

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Berries_Text.EN: Berries are most common in forests. The Herbalist skill helps identify safe to eat varieties!
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Berries_Text.CN: 浆果在森林中最常见. 草药师技能有助于识别可以安全食用的品种!

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Categories_Text.EN: More loot categories become visible on the search window tooltip at higher Foraging levels. You'll become better at spotting unlikelier objects.
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Categories_Text.CN: 在更高的搜寻等级, 搜寻窗口的工具提示上会显示更多战利品类别. 你会变得更善于发现不太可能的物体.

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Crops_Text.EN: Wild crops are most common in farmland, and all have a chance to be seed-bearing.
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Crops_Text.CN: 野生作物在农田中最常见, 并且都有可能结出种子.

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Darkness_Text.EN: It is difficult to forage in the dark. Bring a torch to light up the night!
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Darkness_Text.CN: 在黑暗中很难搜寻. 带上手电筒照亮黑夜!

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Finding_Text.EN: To find items, search areas regularly. Traveling while searching will reveal more items. Avoid walking in circles!
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Finding_Text.CN: 要找到物品, 请定期搜索区域. 边旅行边搜索会发现更多物品. 避免绕圈行走!

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_FirewoodStones_Text.EN: Firewood can be gathered in forests, stones are most commonly found on roads!
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_FirewoodStones_Text.CN: 树枝可以在森林中采集, 石头最常见于道路上!

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Herbs_Text.EN: Healing herbs are more common during, and after, rain in deep forest! A wider range of herbs can be found with the Herbalist skill.
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Herbs_Text.CN: 治疗药草在森林深处的雨中和雨后更常见! 使用草药师技能可以找到更多种类的药草.

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Insects_Text.EN: Insects can be found everywhere. They are more commonly found at night!
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Insects_Text.CN: 昆虫随处可见. 它们更常见于夜间!

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Mushrooms_Text.EN: Mushrooms are most common in forests, and after it rains. The Herbalist skill helps identify safe to eat varieties!
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Mushrooms_Text.CN: 蘑菇在森林中及下雨后最常见. 草药师技能有助于识别可以安全食用的品种!

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_SearchFocus_Text.EN: Looking for something special? Use the Search Focus to increase your chance of finding a selected category!
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_SearchFocus_Text.CN: 寻找特别的东西? 使用搜寻专注来增加找到选定类别的机会!

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Seasons_Text.EN: All naturally occurring items are governed by month and season. What you can find depends on the time of year!
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Seasons_Text.CN: 所有自然产生的物品都受月份和季节的影响. 你能找到什么取决于一年中的时间!

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Situational_Text.EN: Check relevant and logical locations for items. For example, Chipped Stones are often found in cracks and potholes on roads!
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Situational_Text.CN: 检查物品的相关和逻辑位置. 例如, 碎石经常出现在道路的裂缝和坑洞中!

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Skill_Text.EN: Some items are harder to identify. Your Foraging skill level affects what you can find. Keep leveling!
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Skill_Text.CN: 有些物品更难辨认. 你的搜寻技能等级会影响你能找到的东西. 继续提高水平!

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Tips_Text.EN: These tips unlock as you level up! Click the (?) icon to show these tips at any time.
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Tips_Text.CN: 这些提示会随着你的升级而解锁! 点击(?)图标可随时显示这些提示.

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Visibility_Text.EN: To find an item you must be able to see it. Moving through trees risks injury. Try searching clearings and paths!
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Visibility_Text.CN: 要找到物品, 你必须能够看到它. 穿行树林有受伤的风险. 尝试搜索空地和路径!

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Weather_Text.EN: Fog, snow, clouds, and rain affect your ability to find items. An umbrella helps when searching in the rain.
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_Weather_Text.CN: 雾, 雪, 云和雨会影响你寻找物品的能力. 雨伞有助于在雨中搜索.

IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_WildPlants_Text.EN: Wild fruits and vegetables are most common in vegetation and farmland. Some varieties might only become evident in Winter.
IGUI_SearchMode_Tip_WildPlants_Text.CN: 野生水果和蔬菜在植被和农田中最常见. 有些品种可能只在冬季才会出现.

IGUI_perks_Agriculture_Description.EN: Increases the available information for crops. Trained by harvesting crops planted yourself.
IGUI_perks_Agriculture_Description.CN: 增加对作物的可用信息. 通过收获自己种植的作物进行训练.

IGUI_perks_Aiming_Description.EN: Increases your chance of hitting a target with firearms, and of doing extra damage.
IGUI_perks_Aiming_Description.CN: 提高你使用枪械命中目标的几率, 以及造成额外伤害的可能性.

IGUI_perks_Animal Care_Description.EN: Increases the available information for animals and the number of resources harvested from them.
IGUI_perks_Animal Care_Description.CN: 增加对动物的可用信息, 以及从它们身上获取的资源数量.

IGUI_perks_Axe_Description.EN: Increases attack speed and damage when using axe-type weapons, and reduces their muscle strain.
IGUI_perks_Axe_Description.CN: 提高使用斧子时的攻击速度和伤害, 并减少肌肉劳损.

IGUI_perks_Blacksmithing_Description.EN: Allows the creation of metal items and objects.
IGUI_perks_Blacksmithing_Description.CN: 允许制造金属物品和物体.

IGUI_perks_Butchering_Description.EN: Increases the quality of meat harvested from animals.
IGUI_perks_Butchering_Description.CN: 提高从动物身上获取的肉类质量.

IGUI_perks_Carpentry_Description.EN: Allows the building of wooden constructions.

IGUI_perks_Carving_Description.EN: Allows the creation of small wooden objects.

IGUI_perks_Cooking_Description.EN: Allows the creation of more nutritious and delicious food.
IGUI_perks_Cooking_Description.CN: 允许制作更有营养, 更美味的食物.

IGUI_perks_Electrical_Description.EN: Allows the creation and maintenance of electrical devices.
IGUI_perks_Electrical_Description.CN: 允许创建和维护电子设备.

IGUI_perks_First Aid_Description.EN: Increases the available information for injuries, and the quality of medical treatments.
IGUI_perks_First Aid_Description.CN: 增加对伤害的可用信息, 以及医疗治疗的质量.

IGUI_perks_Fishing_Description.EN: Increases your chance of catching a fish, the quality of your catches, and makes your fishing equipment less likely to break.
IGUI_perks_Fishing_Description.CN: 提高你钓鱼成功的几率, 以及捕获物的质量, 并减少你的钓鱼装备损坏的可能性.

IGUI_perks_Fitness_Description.EN: Increases melee attack speed, and speed and success chance of climbing. Decreases exhaustion rate.
IGUI_perks_Fitness_Description.CN: 提高近战攻击速度, 攀爬的速度和成功几率. 减少疲劳率.

IGUI_perks_Foraging_Description.EN: Increases the quality of items found using Search Mode, available search categories, and the search radius.
IGUI_perks_Foraging_Description.CN: 提高使用搜索模式时找到的物品质量, 可用搜索类别, 以及搜索半径.

IGUI_perks_Glassmaking_Description.EN: Allows the creation of glass and glass objects.
IGUI_perks_Glassmaking_Description.CN: 允许制作玻璃及其制品.

IGUI_perks_Knapping_Description.EN: Allows the creation of small stone objects.

IGUI_perks_Lightfooted_Description.EN: Decreases the noise of your footsteps, whether running, walking, or crouching.
IGUI_perks_Lightfooted_Description.CN: 减少你跑步, 走路或蹲下时的脚步声.

IGUI_perks_Long Blade_Description.EN: Increases attack speed and damage when using long blade weapons, and reduces their muscle strain.
IGUI_perks_Long Blade_Description.CN: 提高使用长刀时的攻击速度和伤害, 并减少肌肉劳损.

IGUI_perks_Long Blunt_Description.EN: Increases attack speed and damage when using long blunt weapons, and reduces their muscle strain.
IGUI_perks_Long Blunt_Description.CN: 提高使用长棍时的攻击速度和伤害, 并减少肌肉劳损.

IGUI_perks_Maintenance_Description.EN: Decreases the chance of melee weapons being damaged. Trained through melee combat.
IGUI_perks_Maintenance_Description.CN: 减少近战武器损坏的几率. 通过近战战斗进行训练.

IGUI_perks_Masonry_Description.EN: Allows the creation of better and stronger brick and stone constructions.
IGUI_perks_Masonry_Description.CN: 允许创建更好, 更坚固的砖石结构.

IGUI_perks_Mechanics_Description.EN: Increases the effectiveness of vehicle repairs.

IGUI_perks_Metalworking_Description.CN: 允许制作金属物品和制品.

IGUI_perks_Nimble_Description.EN: Increases how quickly you move when in a "combat stance", and decreases footstep noise.
IGUI_perks_Nimble_Description.CN: 提高你在"战斗姿态"下的移动速度, 并减少脚步声.

IGUI_perks_Pottery_Description.EN: Allows the creation of clay and pottery objects.
IGUI_perks_Pottery_Description.CN: 允许制作粘土和陶器制品.

IGUI_perks_Reloading_Description.EN: Increases the speed you reload firearms and magazines. Trained by reloading firearms.
IGUI_perks_Reloading_Description.CN: 增加你重新装填枪械和弹匣的速度. 通过装填枪械进行训练.

IGUI_perks_Running_Description.EN: Increases how quickly you move when running.

IGUI_perks_Short Blade_Description.EN: Increases attack speed and damage when using short blade weapons, and reduces their muscle strain.
IGUI_perks_Short Blade_Description.CN: 提高使用短刀时的攻击速度和伤害, 并减少肌肉劳损.

IGUI_perks_Short Blunt_Description.EN: Increases attack speed and damage when using short blunt weapons, and reduces their muscle strain.
IGUI_perks_Short Blunt_Description.CN: 提高使用短棍时的攻击速度和伤害, 并减少肌肉劳损.

IGUI_perks_Sneaking_Description.EN: Decreases the distance at which zombies spot you and the sound of your footsteps while crouching.
IGUI_perks_Sneaking_Description.CN: 减少僵尸发现你的距离, 以及你蹲下时的脚步声.

IGUI_perks_Spear_Description.EN: Increases attack speed and damage when using spear-type weapons, and reduces their muscle strain.
IGUI_perks_Spear_Description.CN: 提高使用长矛时的攻击速度和伤害, 并减少肌肉劳损.

IGUI_perks_Strength_Description.EN: Increases melee attack damage and knockback and your inventory encumbrance limit. Reduces muscle strain.
IGUI_perks_Strength_Description.CN: 提高近战攻击伤害和击退效果, 以及你的背包负重限制. 减少肌肉劳损.

IGUI_perks_Tailoring_Description.EN: Increases the quality of clothing repairs, and defensive padding of clothes.
IGUI_perks_Tailoring_Description.CN: 提高衣物修复的质量, 以及衣物的防御性填充.

IGUI_perks_Tracking_Description.EN: Increases the available information on wild animal clues found in Search Mode, and allows smaller clues to be found.
IGUI_perks_Tracking_Description.CN: 提高在搜索模式中找到的野生动物线索的可用信息, 并允许找到更小的线索.

IGUI_perks_Trapping_Description.EN: Increases the chances of catching an animal in a trap, and allows better traps to be crafted.
IGUI_perks_Trapping_Description.CN: 提高在陷阱中捕获动物的几率, 并允许制作更好的陷阱.

IGUI_perks_Welding_Description.EN: Allows the building of crude metal barricades and objects.
IGUI_perks_Welding_Description.CN: 允许建造简陋的金属障碍物和物品.

Moodles_Bleeding_desc_lvl3.CN: 因大量失血而极度虚弱.

Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl1.CN: 找些事来打发时间, 或者娱乐娱乐.

Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl2.EN: Why does nothing interesting ever happen around here?
Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl2.CN: 为什么一点有趣的事情都没有?

Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl3.EN: Can barely take it any more. Isn't there ANYTHING fun to do?
Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl3.CN: 受不了了. 不能做点有意思的事情吗?

Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl4.EN: They never said the end of the world would be like this.
Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl4.CN: 怎么没人告诉我世界末日这么无聊啊…

Moodles_CantSprint_Desc.CN: 厚重的衣服, 笨重的袋子或大件物品让你速度降低!

Moodles_CantSprint_desc_lvl1.EN: Heavy clothing, bulky bags, or large items are making you unable to sprint.
Moodles_CantSprint_desc_lvl1.CN: 厚重的衣物, 臃肿的背包或携带大型物品使你无法冲刺.

Moodles_Dead_desc_lvl4.EN: This is how you died. High risk of becoming rat food.
Moodles_Dead_desc_lvl4.CN: 这就是你生命的终点. 马上就要成为鼠群的盘中餐了.

Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl2.EN: Had one too many. Co-ordination slightly impaired.
Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl2.CN: 喝得稍微有点多. 身体协调能力轻微受影响.

Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl3.EN: Had a few too many. Co-ordination impaired.
Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl3.CN: 喝多了. 身体协调能力出现严重影响.

Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl4.EN: 'Iss you an' me 'gainst the wurld. I love you. I LOVE YOU.'
Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl4.CN: 只有你…和我….抵抗…这一切…世界…爱你…我…爱你.

Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl1.EN: Hard to run or swing a weapon. Why not have a rest in a comfy chair?
Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl1.CN: 很难奔跑或挥舞武器. 为什么不在舒服的椅子上休息一会儿?

Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl2.EN: Can barely jog or swing a weapon.
Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl2.CN: 几乎无法奔跑或挥舞武器.

Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl3.EN: Can barely walk or swing a weapon.
Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl3.CN: 几乎无法走动或挥舞武器

Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl4.EN: Can barely move or swing a weapon.
Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl4.CN: 几乎无法移动或挥舞武器.

Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl1.EN: Gnawing hunger entirely absent. For now.
Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl1.CN: 不再感到饥饿了. 至少暂时如此.

Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl2.EN: Tummy full. Goodness making its way through your system.
Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl2.CN: 肚子饱饱. 营养对你的身体有帮助.

Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl3.EN: Stomach contented. You feel healthier and stronger.
Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl3.CN: 肚子好撑. 力量和生命恢复提升.

Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl4.EN: Couldn't manage another single, solitary bite.

Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl3.EN: Sneezing and coughing. You feel sick and slow.
Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl3.CN: 伴随打喷嚏和咳嗽. 你感到不适且行动迟缓.

Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl4.EN: Continually coughing and sneezing. You'd better look after yourself.
Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl4.CN: 不断咳嗽和打喷嚏. 你最好照顾好自己.

Moodles_Hasacold_desc_lvl3.CN: 打喷嚏和咳嗽. 速度和生命恢复降低.

Moodles_Hasacold_desc_lvl4.CN: 打喷嚏和咳嗽. 速度和生命恢复严重降低.

Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl2.EN: Carrying too much. You're slowed by the weight.
Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl2.CN: 拿得太多了. 因负重而减速.

Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl3.EN: Carrying far too much. You can barely move.
Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl3.CN: 拿得实在太多了. 快动不了了.

Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl4.EN: Can't take much more! You're going to hurt yourself carrying all that.
Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl4.CN: 不能再拿了! 拿这么多会伤到自己的!

Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl1.EN: Could do with a bite to eat.

Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl2.EN: Could eat a horse right now. Growing weaker.

Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl4.EN: Just a crumb, a berry, a cockroach, anything.
Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl4.CN: 一点面包屑, 一颗浆果, 一只蟑螂, 啥都行…

Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lvl1.EN: Consider wearing less clothing. You feel thirstier.
Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lvl1.CN: 考虑脱掉一些衣服. 更易口渴.

Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lvl2.CN: 口渴. 出汗. 过度暴露在阳光下.

Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lvl3.EN: Nauseous, unable to concentrate, and desperate for liquids.
Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lvl3.CN: 心跳加快, 无法集中精神, 急需喝水.

Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lvl4.EN: Delirious. The heat is melting your life away. Get somewhere colder!
Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lvl4.CN: 因过热已经无法正常思考. 极度危险. 快去个凉快的地方!

Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lvl1.EN: It feels a bit nippy round here.

Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lvl2.EN: You need to find ways to keep warm.

Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lvl3.EN: Man alive, it is SO cold.
Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lvl3.CN: 还活着. 真的太冷了.

Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lvl4.EN: You're going out. You may be some time.

Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl2.CN: 因受伤或疾病而感到虚弱.

Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl3.EN: Severely weakened by injuries or illness.
Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl3.CN: 因受伤或疾病而感到十分虚弱.

Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl4.EN: Not going gently into that good night.

Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lvl1.CN: 哎呀, 有东西发出难闻的气味.

Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lvl2.CN: 真恶心, 有东西发出刺鼻的臭味.

Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lvl3.EN: A vile stink makes you feel ill.
Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lvl3.CN: 一种令人作呕的恶臭让你感到不适.

Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lvl4.EN: You can't breathe. Get away from here!
Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lvl4.CN: 你无法呼吸. 快离开这里!

Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl2.EN: Throbbing pain. It's hard to keep focused.
Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl2.CN: 疼痛. 很难保持注意力.

Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl3.EN: The pain brings tears to your eyes. It's hard to go on.
Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl3.CN: 疼出了眼泪. 坚持不下去了.

Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl4.EN: Searing pain shoots through your body. It's hard to even think.
Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl4.CN: 灼痛感传遍全身. 无法思考.

Moodles_Panic_desc_lvl1.EN: Do your best to remain calm.

Moodles_Panic_desc_lvl2.CN: 焦虑不已, 手在发抖.

Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl3.CN: 很虚弱, 非常不舒服.

Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl4.EN: Increasing danger of becoming rat food.

Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl2.CN: 心在狂跳. 思维混乱.

Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl3.EN: Shaking hands. Impossible to think straight. Make it stop!
Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl3.CN: 手在发抖, 无法正常思考. 快冷静下来!

Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl4.EN: You're at your limit! This can't go on.
Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl4.CN: 到达极限了! 别再这样了…

Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl2.EN: It's well past your bedtime. Growing weak with tiredness.
Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl2.CN: 已经过了平时睡觉的时间了. 开始因困倦而虚弱.

Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl3.EN: Can barely think straight. Weak with tiredness.
Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl3.CN: 快不能思考了. 因困倦而虚弱.

Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl4.EN: So weak and tired. Desperately, inhumanly tired.
Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl4.CN: 虚弱而困倦. 让人绝望的疲倦.

Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_lvl2.EN: Your clothes, the environment, or something else is making you uncomfortable and unhappy.
Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_lvl2.CN: 你的衣服, 环境或其他东西让你感到不舒服和不开心.

Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_lvl3.EN: Your clothes, the environment, or something else is making you very uncomfortable and unhappy.
Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_lvl3.CN: 你的衣服, 环境或其他东西让你感到非常不舒服和不开心.

Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_lvl4.EN: Your clothes, the environment, or something else is making you extremely uncomfortable and unhappy.
Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_lvl4.CN: 你的衣服, 环境或其他东西让你感到极度不舒服和不开心.

Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl1.EN: Having a hard time lately. Seek some way to forget your troubles.
Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl1.CN: 最近压力很大. 找些事干, 忘掉烦恼.

Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl2.EN: You always feel on the edge of tears. Nothing seems to go your way.
Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl2.CN: 泪腺已经在爆发的边缘了. 一切都如此不顺.

Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl3.EN: Ravaged by mourning and desperation. You're losing hope.
Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl3.CN: 被抑郁和悲伤折磨. "希望"对你来说如此陌生.

Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl4.EN: What's the point in going on? Nothing good will ever happen.
Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl4.CN: 继续活着的意义是什么? 好事从来都不会发生…

Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl1.EN: Slightly damp from rain, sweat, or something else.
Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl1.CN: 有点湿湿的. 下雨还是出汗?

Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl2.EN: Damp from rain, sweat, or something else.
Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl2.CN: 流更多汗了, 还是淋更多雨了?

Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl4.EN: You're going to catch a cold!

Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl1.EN: The wind's making it feel a little colder.

Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl2.EN: The wind's making it feel somewhat colder.

Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl3.EN: The wind's making it feel a lot colder.

Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl4.EN: The wind feels like you're being stabbed with icicles.
Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl4.CN: 感觉仿佛已被寒冰包围.

Moodles_Zombie_desc_lvl4.EN: Sudden attraction to gunshots, house alarms, and human flesh.
Moodles_Zombie_desc_lvl4.CN: 突然对枪声, 房屋警报和人类血肉产生兴趣.

Hundreds of military personnel, fully armed and in battle gear, arrived in the area early Tuesday morning, encircling thou- sands of civilians within the cordon, as well as displacing hundreds of people who live outside the boundary. Rumors abound of a military exercise, but all calls to army officials went unanswered.                      Telephone lines have also been down in the area for the last several days, making communication with the cordoned-off area almost impossible.                     One West Point resi- dent, Larry Stoddard, said that after finishing his usual night shift as a nurse in Louisville, he saw, "soldiers  in  the  distance.<type:text, x:180, y:716, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, scaleX:0.4, scaleY:0.4, autoWidth:375, textTracking:0.5, textLeading:3, font:UIFont.SdfOldRegular>Not unusual in Knox, but then I saw them putting up a fence all along the road. Print_Text_Coalfield_info.EN:
Coalfield, Kentucky

A Taste of the Wild West

Founded in the 1850s as a stop for travelers heading east, Coalfield became notorious for a series of conflicts between Sheriff Everett Holloway and Irvin Bradshaw and his gang.
The feud culminated with a massive shootout on the night of August 11, 1882, which ended when the Lawman's Distillery caught fire and exploded, taking many buildings with it. No sign of Everett Holloway or Irvin Bradshaw was ever found.

Now you can visit the original site of Coalfield, renovated accurately. Visit our general store, have a drink in the saloons, experience life as a blacksmith, tour period cabins, and see what the Old West was really like!

Come along every Saturday for a reenactment of the shootout between Holloway's lawmen and the Bradshaw gang!

肯塔基州, 煤田镇 

 西部荒野风情 

 煤田镇建于 19 世纪 50 年代, 作为向东行进的旅行者的停靠点, 因治安官埃弗雷特·霍洛韦与欧文·布拉德肖及其帮派之间的一系列冲突而声名狼藉. 
 这场争斗在 1882 年 8 月 11 日晚达到高潮, 一场大规模枪战爆发, 劳曼酿酒厂起火爆炸, 许多建筑随之被毁. 此后, 再也没人见过埃弗雷特·霍洛韦或欧文·布拉德肖. 

 现在开放参观经过精确修复的煤田镇原址. 参观综合商店, 或在酒吧小酌一杯, 体验铁匠生活, 参观复古小木屋, 看看真正的旧西部是什么样子! 

 每周六都有霍洛韦的执法者与布拉德肖帮派枪战的表演!

Print_Text_ColdWarBunker_info.EN:
Tour a Future that didn't happen!

Just off Adams Road in northern March Ridge sits a fenced area with a small shed and a radio tower.

For decades, this was the entrance to a top secret nuclear bunker, built to house Fort Knox's military leaders.

Built four storeys underground in 1960, with thick steel doors, the bunker was made to withstand a direct nuclear hit on Fort Knox itself.

Space was limited, with beds for only forty people. It's unlikely the bunker would have survived for long without resupply.

Thankfully, armageddon did not arrive.

The bunker was decommissioned in 1991 and is now available for weekend tours!

Book ahead on 943-555-7843.

Note: Tour not suitable for the claustrophobic or young children. Bunker has not been fully checked for asbestos and some forms of poisoning. Waivers must be signed on entry.

5671 Adams Road, March Ridge, Kentucky
Print_Text_ColdWarBunker_info.CN:
参观一个未曾实现的未来! 

 在三月岭社区北部的亚当斯路旁, 有一处围起来的区域, 这里有一个小棚屋和一座无线电塔. 

 几十年来, 此处是一个绝密核地堡入口, 该地下堡垒为诺克斯堡的军事领导人打造. 

 建于 1960 年, 位于地下四层, 配有厚重钢门, 能够承受直接命中诺克斯堡的核打击. 

 空间有限, 仅能容纳 40 人. 如果没有补给, 这个地堡无法维持很长时间. 

 幸运的是, 世界末日并未到来. 

 该地下堡垒于 1991 年退役, 现在周末可提供参观! 

 请提前拨打 943-555-7843 预约.

Print_Text_Delilah_info.EN:
Come onboard the Delilah!

Grandpappy grew up on the riverboats of the Mississippi, and now you can live that life too.
He never forgot the smooth, easy sailing of those old boats. In 1932 he found the wreck of a paddle steamer stuck in the mud near St. Louis. With his two brothers, he bought the wreck and got to work.
My grandpappy's dream came true. His name was Adam Jones, and he named his ship the Delilah after his beloved wife.
I am Captain Adam Jones III. I am proud to keep that dream alive.
The Delilah is now docked in your area. See the attached map for details.

We are now docked at River Front Park in Brandenburg!
Print_Text_Delilah_info.CN:

WHO: "GROUND ALL FLIGHTS"
By Molly Aoide
Staff Writer

[image] - Millions of travelers worldwide could be stranded.

GENEVA, Switzerland - Millions of travelers were thrown into limbo when the World Health Organization on Sunday advised that all flights, excluding military and medical ones, be suspended worldwide to stop the "Knox Virus" spreading.
 Though the WHO lacks any legal authority to enforce the advice, all flights were grounded almost immediately by airlines shocked at the sudden nature of the announcement.
 In a White House briefing, the President has called the WHO's announcement "unwelcome and economically unsound".
 Air Erin CEO Ryan Byrne said, "We knew this was coming, but we thought we'd at least have time to prepare. We have to comply. None of us want to be responsible for an outbreak, but we have businesses to run. The cure can't be worse than the disease.
 Meanwhile, the European Community has advised all its member countries to close their internal and external borders as a precaution. It's understood that all EC member states will comply with the advice, though the United Kingdom has asked for a short delay before implementation.

By Molly Aoide
Staff Writer

[image] - The Iraqi president speaking to international media in Baghdad.

BAGHDAD, Iraq - In a press conference on Monday, the Iraqi president said that the country may stop cooperating with the United Nations on the destruction of non-conventional weapons if a stand-off over missile site monitoring is not quickly resolved.
 "The Americans think we are weak," said the president from his palace. "We have weapons of such awesome power that they would cry like dogs were they even to learn of them. And yet, we are willing to give up such things, and pursue a path of peace, if we are dealt with fairly." A spokesman for the US president refused to comment on speculation that the president's cancellation of his attendance at the G7 meetings in Tokyo, scheduled to begin on Wednesday, were related to the Iraqi announcement.
 The other six G7 member countries - Japan, Canada, France, Italy, Germany, and the UK, along with the European Community - are expected to discuss a range of international issues, including aid for further business privatizations in Russia, nuclear weapons in the former Soviet Union and North Korea, and the deteriorating situation in the area formerly known as Yugoslavia. This G7 meeting, the 19th, will be the first for President.
