Sandbox_HoursForLootRespawn_tooltip.CN: 如果此参数大于 0, 在 X 小时后, 世界上城镇和拖车公园中的所有容器将重新生成物品. \n要生成物品, 容器必须至少被搜刮过一次. 物品刷新不受可见性或后续搜刮的影响.

Sandbox_HoursForWorldItemRemoval_tooltip.EN: Number of hours since an item was dropped on the ground before it is removed. \nItems are removed the next time that part of the map is loaded.  \nZero means items are not removed.
Sandbox_HoursForWorldItemRemoval_tooltip.CN: 物品掉落在地上的小时数, 然后才会被移除. \n 物品会在下次加载地图的那个部分时被移除. \n数值 0 意味着物品不会被移除.

Sandbox_HouseAlarmFrequency_tooltip.EN: How likely the player is to activate a house alarm when breaking into a new house.
Sandbox_HouseAlarmFrequency_tooltip.CN: 玩家在闯入新房子时激活房屋警报的可能性.

Sandbox_Husbandry_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Animal Care skill levels up.

Sandbox_InitialGas_tooltip.EN: How full the gas tank of discovered vehicles will be.
Sandbox_InitialGas_tooltip.CN: 控制发现的汽车的油箱装满程度.

Sandbox_InjurySeverity_tooltip.EN: The impact that injuries have on your body, and their healing time.
Sandbox_InjurySeverity_tooltip.CN: 增加和减少伤害对你身体的影响, 以及它们的愈合时间.

Sandbox_ItemRemovalListBlacklistToggle_t.EN: If true, any items *not* in WorldItemRemovalList will be removed.
Sandbox_ItemRemovalListBlacklistToggle_t.CN: 如果设置为"是",那么任何不在世界物品移除列表中的项目将被删除.

Sandbox_KeyLootNew_tooltip.EN: Keys for buildings/cars, key rings, and locks.
Sandbox_KeyLootNew_tooltip.CN: 建筑物/汽车的钥匙, 钥匙圈和锁.

Sandbox_KillInsideCrops_tooltip.EN: When enabled, crops and herbs grown inside buildings will die. Does not affect houseplants.
Sandbox_KillInsideCrops_tooltip.CN: 当启用时, 建筑物内玩家种植的作物和草药将会死亡. 不影响室内植物.

Sandbox_LevelForDismantleXPCutoff.CN: 拆解所能达到的最高经验等级

Sandbox_LevelForDismantleXPCutoff_toolti.EN: When a skill is at this level or above, scrapping furniture does not provide XP for the relevant skill. Does not apply to Electrical.
Sandbox_LevelForDismantleXPCutoff_toolti.CN: 当技能达到此等级或以上时, 拆除家具不再为相关技能提供经验. 不适用于电气.

Sandbox_LevelForMediaXPCutoff.CN: 阅读媒体所能达到的最高经验等级

Sandbox_LevelForMediaXPCutoff_tooltip.EN: When a skill is at this level or above, television/VHS/other media\n will not provide XP for it.
Sandbox_LevelForMediaXPCutoff_tooltip.CN: 当技能达到此等级或以上时, 电视/录像带/其他媒体\n将不再为其提供经验.

Sandbox_LightBulbLifespan_tooltip.EN: The higher the value, the longer lightbulbs last before breaking. \nIf 0, lightbulbs will never break. \nDoes not affect vehicle headlights.
Sandbox_LightBulbLifespan_tooltip.CN: 数值越高, 灯泡在损坏前持续的时间越长. \n如果是0, 灯泡将永远不会坏\n不会影响车灯.

Sandbox_Lightfoot_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Lightfooted skill levels up.

Sandbox_LiteratureCooldown_tooltip.EN: Number of days before one can benefit from reading previously read literature items.
Sandbox_LiteratureCooldown_tooltip.CN: 在能够从阅读以前阅读过的文学作品中重新获得收益之前的天数.

Sandbox_LiteratureLootNew_tooltip.EN: All items that can be read, includes fliers
Sandbox_LiteratureLootNew_tooltip.CN: 所有可阅读物品 (含传单)

Sandbox_LockedCar_tooltip.EN: How likely cars will be locked

Sandbox_LockedHouseFrequency_tooltip.EN: How frequently the doors of homes and buildings will be locked when discovered.
Sandbox_LockedHouseFrequency_tooltip.CN: 决定房屋门窗上锁几率.

Sandbox_LongBlade_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Long Blade skill levels up.

Sandbox_LootCannedFood_tooltip.EN: Food that will never rot eg. canned food.
Sandbox_LootCannedFood_tooltip.CN: 不易腐烂的食物, 例如罐头食品.

Sandbox_LootClothing_tooltip.CN: 普通服装, 例如衬衫.

Sandbox_LootContainer_tooltip.EN: Backpacks and other wearable/equippable containers, eg. cases.
Sandbox_LootContainer_tooltip.CN: 背包和其他可穿戴/可装备的容器, 例如箱子.

Sandbox_LootFood_tooltip.EN: Food that can rot eg. vegetables.
Sandbox_LootFood_tooltip.CN: 易腐烂的食物, 例如蔬菜.

Sandbox_LootItemRemovalList_tooltip.EN: A comma-separated list of item types that won't spawn as ordinary loot.
Sandbox_LootItemRemovalList_tooltip.CN: 一个逗号分隔的物品类型列表, 这些物品不会作为普通物品生成.

Sandbox_LootKey_tooltip.EN: Keys for buildings/cars, key rings, and locks.
Sandbox_LootKey_tooltip.CN: 建筑物/汽车的钥匙, 钥匙圈和锁.

Sandbox_LootMechanics_tooltip.CN: 车辆维护物品, 例如轮胎.

Sandbox_LootMedical_tooltip.CN: 医疗物品, 例如绷带.

Sandbox_LootOther_tooltip.EN: Everything else. Also affects foraging for all items in Town/Road zones.
Sandbox_LootOther_tooltip.CN: 其他所有物品. 同样影响城镇/道路区域的所有物品的搜寻.

Sandbox_LootRespawn_tooltip.EN: How often items will respawn in already-looted containers in towns and trailer parks.\nItems will not respawn in player-made containers.
Sandbox_LootRespawn_tooltip.CN: 物品将在城镇和停车场中已经被搜刮的容器里刷新. 物品不会在玩家制造的容器中刷新.

Sandbox_LootSurvivalGears_tooltip.EN: Seeds, Nails, Saws, Fishing Rods, various tools, etc.
Sandbox_LootSurvivalGears_tooltip.CN: 种子, 锯子, 钉子, 各种工具, 维修物品, 钓鱼竿, 等等.

Sandbox_LootWeapon_tooltip.EN: Hand-to-hand combat weapons eg. baseball bats.
Sandbox_LootWeapon_tooltip.CN: 近战武器, 例如棒球棒.

Sandbox_MaggotSpawn_tooltip.EN: If/when maggots can spawn in corpses.
Sandbox_MaggotSpawn_tooltip.CN: 蛆可以在尸体中生成的条件.

Sandbox_Maintenance_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Maintenance skill levels up.

Sandbox_MapAllKnown_tooltip.EN: If enabled, the world map will be completely filled in on starting the game.
Sandbox_MapAllKnown_tooltip.CN: 如果启用, 游戏开始时大地图将完全显示.

Sandbox_MapNeedsLight_tooltip.EN: If enabled, maps can't be read unless there's a source of light available.
Sandbox_MapNeedsLight_tooltip.CN: 如果启用, 除非有光源, 否则无法阅读地图.

Sandbox_Masonry_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Masonry skill levels up.

Sandbox_MaterialLootNew_tooltip.EN: Items and weapons that are used as ingredients for crafting or building.\nThis is a general category that does not include items belonging to other categories such as Cookware or Medical. Does not include Tools.
Sandbox_MaterialLootNew_tooltip.CN: 用于制作或建筑的物品和武器. \n这是一个通用类别, 不包括属于其他类别的物品, 如烹饪用具或医疗用品. 不包括工具.

Sandbox_MaxItemsForLootRespawn_tooltip.EN: Containers with a number of items greater, or equal to, this setting will not respawn.
Sandbox_MaxItemsForLootRespawn_tooltip.CN: 当容器中的物品数量大于或等于此设置时, 将不会刷新.

Sandbox_MaximumDiminishedLoot_tooltip.EN: The maximum loot that won't spawn when Days Until Maximum Diminished Loot is reached.\nCheck the "Advanced" box below to use an exact percentage.
Sandbox_MaximumDiminishedLoot_tooltip.CN: 当达到最大减少物品天数时, 将不会生成的最大物品. \n勾选下方的"高级"选项以使用确切的百分比.

Sandbox_MaximumFireFuelHours_tooltip.EN: The maximum hours of fuel that can be placed in a campfire, wood stove etc.
Sandbox_MaximumFireFuelHours_tooltip.CN: 可以放入篝火, 木炉等的最大燃料小时数.

Sandbox_MaximumLootedBuildingRooms.CN: 最大已掠夺建筑房间数

Sandbox_MaximumLootedBuildingRooms_toolt.EN: If a building has more than this amount of rooms it will not be looted.
Sandbox_MaximumLootedBuildingRooms_toolt.CN: 若建筑物的房间数量超过此数值, 则不会被掠夺.

Sandbox_MaximumLooted_tooltip.EN: The chance that any building will already be looted when found.\nCheck the "Advanced" box below to use a custom number.
Sandbox_MaximumLooted_tooltip.CN: 任何建筑在被发现时已经被掠夺的几率. \n勾选下方的"高级"选项以使用自定义数字.

Sandbox_MaximumRatIndex_tooltip.EN: The frequency and intensity of eg. rats in infested buildings.
Sandbox_MaximumRatIndex_tooltip.CN: 例如, 受感染建筑物中老鼠的频率和强度.

Sandbox_MechanicsLootNew_tooltip.EN: Vehicle parts and the tools needed to install them.

Sandbox_Mechanics_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Mechanics skill levels up.

Sandbox_MedicalLootNew_tooltip.EN: Medicine, bandages and first aid tools.
Sandbox_MedicalLootNew_tooltip.CN: 药品, 绷带和急救工具.

Sandbox_MementoLootNew_tooltip.EN: Spiffo items, plushies, and other collectible keepsake items eg. Photos.
Sandbox_MementoLootNew_tooltip.CN: 精美物品, 毛绒玩具和其他可收藏的纪念品, 例如照片.

Sandbox_MetaEvent_tooltip.EN: How often zombie-attracting metagame events like distant gunshots will occur.
Sandbox_MetaEvent_tooltip.CN: 僵尸吸引元游戏事件的频率有多高, 比如远处的枪声.

Sandbox_MetaKnowledge_tooltip.EN: If a piece of media hasn't been fully seen or read, this setting determines\nwhether it's displayed fully, displayed as \"???\", or hidden completely.
Sandbox_MetaKnowledge_tooltip.CN: 如果媒体内容没有被完全观看或阅读, 此设置决定是否将媒体内容完全显示, 显示为 \"???\" 或完全隐藏.

Sandbox_MetalWelding_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Welding skill levels up.

Sandbox_MinMaxDefault.CN: 最小值=%1 最大值=%2 默认=%3

Sandbox_MinutesPerPage.CN: 阅读每页书籍所需分钟数

Sandbox_MinutesPerPage_tooltip.EN: The number of in-game minutes it takes to read one page of a skill book.
Sandbox_MinutesPerPage_tooltip.CN: 在游戏中阅读每一页书籍所需的分钟数.

Sandbox_MultiHitZombies_tooltip.EN: If certain melee weapons will be able to strike multiple zombies in one hit.
Sandbox_MultiHitZombies_tooltip.CN: 当启用时, 部分近战武器能横扫多个僵尸.

Sandbox_MuscleStrainFactor_tooltip.EN: Functions as a multiplier when applying muscle strain from swinging weapons or carrying heavy loads.
Sandbox_MuscleStrainFactor_tooltip.CN: 作为挥舞武器或搬运重物时施加肌肉拉伤的倍率.

Sandbox_NatureAmount_tooltip.EN: The abundance of items found in Foraging mode.
Sandbox_NatureAmount_tooltip.CN: 影响钓鱼/搜寻的丰饶程度.

Sandbox_NegativeTraitsPenalty_option2.EN: 1 point penalty for every 3 negative traits selected
Sandbox_NegativeTraitsPenalty_option2.CN: 每选择 3 个负面特质则减少 1 点

Sandbox_NegativeTraitsPenalty_option3.EN: 1 point penalty for every 2 negative traits selected
Sandbox_NegativeTraitsPenalty_option3.CN: 每选择 2 个负面特质则减少 1 点

Sandbox_NegativeTraitsPenalty_option4.EN: 1 point penalty for every negative trait selected after the first
Sandbox_NegativeTraitsPenalty_option4.CN: 在选择第一个负面特质后, 每选择一个负面特质则减少 1 点

Sandbox_NegativeTraitsPenalty_tooltip.EN: If there are diminishing returns on bonus trait points provided from selecting multiple negative traits.
Sandbox_NegativeTraitsPenalty_tooltip.CN: 如果从选择多个负面特质中获得的额外特质点数会衰减.

Sandbox_NightDarkness_tooltip.EN: The level of ambient lighting at night.

Sandbox_NightLength_tooltip.EN: The time from dusk to dawn.

Sandbox_Nimble_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Nimble skill levels up.

Sandbox_NoBlackClothes_tooltip.EN: If true clothing with randomized tints will not be so dark to be virtually black.
Sandbox_NoBlackClothes_tooltip.CN: 如果为真, 随机色调的服装不会暗到几乎是黑色.

Sandbox_Nutrition_tooltip.EN: Nutritional value of food affects the player's condition. Turning this off with stop the player gaining or losing weight.
Sandbox_Nutrition_tooltip.CN: 食物的营养价值影响玩家的身体状况.

Sandbox_OtherLootNew_tooltip.EN: Everything else. Also affects foraging for all items in Town/Road zones.
Sandbox_OtherLootNew_tooltip.CN: 其他所有物品. 同样影响城镇/道路区域的所有物品的搜寻.

Sandbox_PlaceDirtAboveground_tooltip.EN: <BHC> [!] It is recommended that you DO NOT change this. Changing this can result in performance issues. [!] <RGB:1,1,1>\n\n When enabled, dirt can be placed, and farming performed on other than the ground level.
Sandbox_PlaceDirtAboveground_tooltip.CN: <BHC> [!] 建议不要更改此设置. 更改此设置可能会导致性能问题. [!] <RGB:1,1,1>\n\n当启用时, 可以在非地表放置泥土并进行耕作.

Sandbox_PlantAbundance_tooltip.EN: The yield of plants when harvested.
Sandbox_PlantAbundance_tooltip.CN: 影响作物收获时的产量.

Sandbox_PlantGrowingSeasons_tooltip.EN: When enabled, the growth of plants is affected by seasons.
Sandbox_PlantGrowingSeasons_tooltip.CN: 当启用时, 作物的生长受季节影响.

Sandbox_PlantResilience_tooltip.EN: How much water plants will lose per day, and their ability to avoid disease.
Sandbox_PlantResilience_tooltip.CN: 会影响植物每天损失多少水分以及它们避免疾病的能力.

Sandbox_PlantScavenging_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Foraging skill levels up.

Sandbox_PlayerDamageFromCrash_tooltip.EN: If the player can get injured from being in a car accident.
Sandbox_PlayerDamageFromCrash_tooltip.CN: 启用或禁用玩家在车祸中受到伤害.

Sandbox_PopulationMultiplier_help.EN: Set by the \"Zombie Count\" population option, or by a custom number here.\nInsane = 2.5, Very High = 1.6, High = 1.2, Normal = 0.65, Low = 0.15, None = 0.0.
Sandbox_PopulationMultiplier_help.CN: 由"僵尸数量"设定的僵尸数量选项. \n4.0 = 疯狂, 3.0 = 非常多, 2.0 = 多, 1.0 = 普通, 0.35 = 少, 0.0 = 没有.

Sandbox_PopulationPeakDay_help.EN: The day when the population reaches its peak.
Sandbox_PopulationPeakDay_help.CN: 多少天后达到僵尸数目峰值.

Sandbox_PopulationPeakMultiplier_help.EN: A multiplier for the desired zombie population on the peak day.\nInsane = 3.0, Very High = 2.0, High = 1.5, Normal = 1.0, Low = 0.5, None = 0.0.
Sandbox_PopulationPeakMultiplier_help.CN: 调整在峰值日时想要的僵尸密度.

Sandbox_PopulationStartMultiplier_help.EN: A multiplier for the desired zombie population at the start of the game.\nInsane = 3.0, Very High = 2.0, High = 1.5, Normal = 1.0, Low = 0.5, None = 0.0.
Sandbox_PopulationStartMultiplier_help.CN: 调整游戏开局时想要的僵尸密度.

Sandbox_Pottery_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Pottery skill levels up.

Sandbox_RagdollPhysicHitReactionFrequenc.CN: 物理打击效果比动画更频繁地使用的程度。

Sandbox_RagdollPhysicHitReactionStrength.CN: 应用于僵尸打击效果的物理冲量强度。

Sandbox_RallyGroupRadius_help.EN: How close members of a zombie group stay to the group's \"leader\".
Sandbox_RallyGroupRadius_help.CN: 一组僵尸与其"领导者"之间站得有多近.

Sandbox_RallyGroupSizeVariance_help.EN: The amount, as a percentage, that zombie groups can vary in size from the default (both larger and smaller). \n For example, at 50% variance with a default group size of 20, groups will vary in size from 10-30.
Sandbox_RallyGroupSizeVariance_help.CN: 僵尸群组大小相对于默认值 (更大和更小) 可以变化的百分比. \n例如, 默认群组大小为 20, 变异为 50% 时, 群组大小将在 10-30 之间变化.

Sandbox_RallyGroupSize_help.EN: The size of groups real zombies form when idle. 0 means zombies don't form groups.\nGroups don't form inside buildings or forest zones.
Sandbox_RallyGroupSize_help.CN: 僵尸在空闲时形成群组的实际大小. 0 表示僵尸不会成群结队. \n在建筑物内或森林区域不会成群结队.

Sandbox_RallyTravelDistance_help.EN: The distance real zombies travel to form groups when idle.
Sandbox_RallyTravelDistance_help.CN: 僵尸在空闲时走向群组的实际距离.

Sandbox_RearVulnerability_tooltip.EN: Chance of being bitten when a zombie attacks from behind.
Sandbox_RearVulnerability_tooltip.CN: 僵尸从背后攻击时被咬的可能性.

Sandbox_RecentlySurvivorVehicles_tooltip.EN: Whether a player can discover a car that has been cared for\n after the Knox infection struck.
Sandbox_RecentlySurvivorVehicles_tooltip.CN: 控制玩家是否可以发现一辆在感染发生后已被维护和保养的汽车.

Sandbox_RedistributeHours_help.EN: The number of hours that must pass before zombies migrate\n to empty parts of the same cell.\nIf 0, migration is disabled.
Sandbox_RedistributeHours_help.CN: 僵尸迁移到同一单元格的空位之前必须经过的小时数. \n如果为 0, 则禁用迁移.

Sandbox_Reloading_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Reloading skill levels up.

Sandbox_RemoveStoryLoot.CN: 移除不需要的故事物品

Sandbox_RemoveStoryLoot_tooltip.EN: If enabled, items on the Loot Item Removal List, or that have their rarity set to 'None', will not spawn in randomised world stories.
Sandbox_RemoveStoryLoot_tooltip.CN: 如果启用, 物品物品移除列表上的物品, 或者将稀有度设置为'无'的物品, 将不会在随机世界故事中生成.

Sandbox_RemoveZombieLoot.CN: 移除不需要的僵尸物品

Sandbox_RemoveZombieLoot_tooltip.EN: If enabled, items on the Loot Item Removal List, or that have their rarity set to 'None', will not spawn worn by, or attached to, zombies.
Sandbox_RemoveZombieLoot_tooltip.CN: 如果启用, 物品物品移除列表上的物品, 或者将稀有度设置为"无"的物品, 将不会穿戴在僵尸身上, 或附着在僵尸上.

Sandbox_RespawnHours_help.EN: The number of hours that must pass before zombies may respawn in a cell.\nIf 0, spawning is disabled.
Sandbox_RespawnHours_help.CN: 僵尸在单元格中重生之前必须经过的小时数. \n如果为 0, 则禁用重生.

Sandbox_RespawnMultiplier_help.EN: The fraction of a cell's desired population that may respawn every RespawnHours.
Sandbox_RespawnMultiplier_help.CN: 可在每个固定刷新时间在每个区块想要的人口密度中生成的比例.

Sandbox_RespawnUnseenHours_help.EN: The number of hours that a chunk must be unseen before zombies may respawn in it.
Sandbox_RespawnUnseenHours_help.CN: 一个区块在僵尸可能在其中重生之前必须未被巡视的小时数.

Sandbox_RollsMultiplier_tooltip.EN: <BHC> [!] It is recommended that you DO NOT change this. [!] <RGB:1,1,1>\n\n Can be used to adjust the number of rolls made on loot tables when spawning loot. Will not reduce the number of rolls below 1. Can negatively affect performance if set to high values. It is highly recommended that this not be changed.
Sandbox_RollsMultiplier_tooltip.CN: <BHC> [!] 建议不要更改此设置. [!] <RGB:1,1,1>\n\n 可用于调整生成物品时在物品表上进行的掷骰子次数. 不会将掷骰子次数减少到 1 以下. 如果设置为高值, 可能会对性能产生负面影响. 强烈建议不要更改此设置.

Sandbox_RuralLooted.CN: 乡村建筑被掠夺几率倍率

Sandbox_RuralLooted_tooltip.EN: The chance that any rural building will already be looted when found.\nCheck the "Advanced" box below to use a custom number.
Sandbox_RuralLooted_tooltip.CN: 任何乡村建筑在被发现时已经被掠夺的几率. \n勾选下方的"高级"选项以使用自定义数字.

Sandbox_SeeNotLearntRecipe_tooltip.EN: If true, you will be able to see any recipes that can be done with a station, even if you haven't learnt them yet.
Sandbox_SeeNotLearntRecipe_tooltip.CN: 如果开启, 即便没有阅读相关配方杂志, 你也能查看可以制作的任何配方.

Sandbox_SeenHoursPreventLootRespawn_tool.EN: When greater than 0, loot will not respawn in zones that have been visited within this number of in-game hours.
Sandbox_SeenHoursPreventLootRespawn_tool.CN: 当 >0 时, 物品将不会在此小时内访问过的区域中重新生成.

Sandbox_SirenEffectsZombies_tooltip.EN: If zombies will head towards the sound of vehicle sirens.
Sandbox_SirenEffectsZombies_tooltip.CN: 僵尸是否会朝向车辆警报器的声音方向前进.

Sandbox_SirenShutoffHours_tooltip.EN: How many in-game hours before a wailing siren shuts off.

Sandbox_SleepingEvent_tooltip.EN: How often events during the player's sleep, like nightmares, occur.
Sandbox_SleepingEvent_tooltip.CN: 控制玩家睡眠期间的夜间元游戏事件.

Sandbox_SlowInCold_tooltip.EN: When enabled, all zombies are Slow Shamblers during winter or cold weather.
Sandbox_SlowInCold_tooltip.CN: 如果启用, 在冬季或寒冷天气期间所有僵尸都是缓慢的行尸.

Sandbox_SmallBlade_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Short Blade skill levels up.

Sandbox_SmallBlunt_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Short Blunt skill levels up.

Sandbox_Sneak_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Sneaking skill levels up.

Sandbox_SpawnHouseStories_tooltip.EN: <BHC> [!] It is recommended that you DO NOT change this. Changing this can result in spawning in destroyed buildings or next to zombies.[!]
Sandbox_SpawnHouseStories_tooltip.CN: <BHC> [!] 建议不要更改此设置. 更改此设置可能导致在被摧毁的建筑物内或僵尸旁边生成. [!]

Sandbox_Spear_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Spear skill levels up.

Sandbox_SpottedLogic_tooltip.EN: Activates the new advanced stealth mechanics, which allows you to hide from zombies behind cars, takes traits and weather into account, and much more.
Sandbox_SpottedLogic_tooltip.CN: 激活新的高级潜行机制, 允许你躲在汽车后面躲避僵尸, 考虑特质和天气等因素, 等等.

Sandbox_Sprinting_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Sprinting skill levels up.

Sandbox_StartDay_tooltip.EN: Day of the month in which the games starts.
Sandbox_StartDay_tooltip.CN: 游戏开始的月份中的日期.

Sandbox_StartErosion_tooltip.CN: 选择"永无"来禁用世界侵蚀.

Sandbox_StartMonth_tooltip.EN: Month in which the game starts.

Sandbox_StartTime_tooltip.EN: Hour of the day in which the game starts.
Sandbox_StartTime_tooltip.CN: 游戏开始的当天小时数.

Sandbox_StarterKit_tooltip.EN: Spawn with Chips, a Water Bottle, a Small Backpack, a Baseball Bat, and a Hammer.
Sandbox_StarterKit_tooltip.CN: 带着薯片, 水瓶, 书包, 棒球棒和铁锤开局.

Sandbox_StatDecrease_tooltip.EN: How fast the player's hunger, thirst, and fatigue will decrease.
Sandbox_StatDecrease_tooltip.CN: 角色的饥饿, 口渴和疲劳会以多快的速度减少.

Sandbox_Strength_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Strength skill levels up.

Sandbox_SurvivalGearsLootNew_tooltip.EN: Fishing Rods, Tents, camping gear etc.
Sandbox_SurvivalGearsLootNew_tooltip.CN: 鱼竿, 帐篷, 野营装备等.

Sandbox_SurvivorHouseChance_tooltip.EN: The chance of finding randomized buildings on the map (eg. burnt out houses, \nones containing loot stashes or dead bodies).
Sandbox_SurvivorHouseChance_tooltip.CN: 在地图上发现随机安全屋的概率 (例如被烧毁的房屋, 或者包含战利品及尸体的房屋).

Sandbox_Tailoring_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Tailoring skill levels up.

Sandbox_ThumpNoChasing_tooltip.EN: If zombies that have not seen/heard player can attack doors and constructions while roaming.
Sandbox_ThumpNoChasing_tooltip.CN: 没有见到/听到玩家时僵尸可以在漫游时攻击门和建筑物.

Sandbox_ThumpOnConstruction_tooltip.EN: If zombies can destroy player constructions and defenses.
Sandbox_ThumpOnConstruction_tooltip.CN: 控制僵尸是否可以摧毁玩家的建筑和防御.

Sandbox_TimeSinceApo_tooltip.EN: How long after the end of the world to begin.\nThis will affect starting world erosion and food spoilage.\nDoes not affect the starting date.
Sandbox_TimeSinceApo_tooltip.CN: 这将影响开局时的世界腐蚀和食物变质.

Sandbox_ToolLootNew_tooltip.EN: Items and weapons which are Tools but don't fit in other categories such as Mechanics or Farming.
Sandbox_ToolLootNew_tooltip.CN: 属于工具的物品和武器, 但不包括机械或农业等其他类别.

Sandbox_Tracking_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Tracking skill levels up.

Sandbox_TrafficJam_tooltip.EN: If traffic jams consisting of wrecked cars \nwill appear on main roads.
Sandbox_TrafficJam_tooltip.CN: 启用或禁用 在地图主干道上生成的堵车.

Sandbox_Trapping_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Trapping skill levels up.

Sandbox_TriggerHouseAlarm_tooltip.EN: If zombies trigger house alarms when breaking through windows or doors.
Sandbox_TriggerHouseAlarm_tooltip.CN: 允许僵尸在破坏门窗时触发防盗警报.

Sandbox_UniqueHomeVHS_tooltip.EN: If true only one instance of an individual Home VHS tape will normally spawn.
Sandbox_UniqueHomeVHS_tooltip.CN: 启用时, 每种家庭录像带通常仅会生成一份副本.

Sandbox_VehicleEasyUse_tooltip.EN: Whether found vehicles are locked, need keys to start etc.
Sandbox_VehicleEasyUse_tooltip.CN: 汽车是否被锁住, 是否需要钥匙才能启动等.

Sandbox_VehicleStoryChance.CN: 随机车辆故事发生几率

Sandbox_VehicleStoryChance_tooltip.EN: The chance of road stories (eg. police roadblocks) spawning.
Sandbox_VehicleStoryChance_tooltip.CN: 道路事件 (例如, 警察路障) 生成的几率.

Sandbox_WaterShut_tooltip.EN: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that plumbing fixtures (eg. sinks) stop being infinite sources of water.
Sandbox_WaterShut_tooltip.CN: 默认开始日期(1993年7月9日)后多久, 水管装置(例如, 水槽)停止成为无限水源.

Sandbox_WeaponLootNew_tooltip.EN: Weapons that are not tools in other categories.
Sandbox_WeaponLootNew_tooltip.CN: 不属于其他类别的武器.

Sandbox_Woodwork_tooltip.EN: Rate at which Carpentry skill levels up.

Sandbox_WorldItemRemovalList_tooltip.EN: A comma-separated list of item types that will be removed after HoursForWorldItemRemoval hours.
Sandbox_WorldItemRemovalList_tooltip.CN: 将在 移除清单的时间 设置的小时后删除. \n 以逗号分隔的项目类型列表.

Sandbox_WoundInfectionFactor_tooltip.EN: If greater than zero damage can be taken from serious wound infections.
Sandbox_WoundInfectionFactor_tooltip.CN: 如果大于零, 则可能因严重伤口感染而受到伤害.

Sandbox_XpMultiplierAffectsPassive.CN: 经验倍率能影响被动技能

Sandbox_XpMultiplierAffectsPassive_toolt.EN: Determines if the XP multiplier affects passively levelled skills eg. Fitness and Strength.
Sandbox_XpMultiplierAffectsPassive_toolt.CN: 经验倍率是否影响被动升级的技能, 例如体格/力量.

Sandbox_XpMultiplier_tooltip.EN: Modifies the base XP gained from actions by this number.
Sandbox_XpMultiplier_tooltip.CN: 修改此项来改变经验收益.

Sandbox_ZCrawlUnderVehicle_tooltip.EN: How often zombies can crawl under parked vehicles.
Sandbox_ZCrawlUnderVehicle_tooltip.CN: 僵尸可以在车底爬行的频率.

Sandbox_ZDecomposition_tooltip.CN: 随时间推移的弱化效果.

Sandbox_ZInfectionMortality_tooltip.EN: How quickly the infection takes effect.

Sandbox_ZMemory_tooltip.EN: How long zombies remember a player after seeing or hearing them.
Sandbox_ZMemory_tooltip.CN: 僵尸听/看到玩家的记忆保留时间.

Sandbox_ZReanimateTime_tooltip.EN: How quickly infected corpses rise as zombies.

Sandbox_ZSpawnRemoval_option1.EN: Inside the building and around it
Sandbox_ZSpawnRemoval_option1.CN: 在建筑物内部及其周围

Sandbox_ZSpawnRemoval_option4.CN: 僵尸可以在任何地方生成

Sandbox_ZSpawnRemoval_tooltip.EN: Zombies will not spawn where players spawn.
Sandbox_ZSpawnRemoval_tooltip.CN: 僵尸不会在玩家生成的地方出现.

Sandbox_ZSprinterPercentage_tooltip.EN: If Random Speed is enabled, this controls what percentage of zombies are Sprinters.\nCheck the "Advanced" box below to use a custom percentage.
Sandbox_ZSprinterPercentage_tooltip.CN: 如果启用随机速度, 那么这会控制跑尸的百分比. \n在下方勾选"高级"选项以使用自定义百分比.

Sandbox_ZStrength_tooltip.EN: The damage zombies inflict per attack.
Sandbox_ZStrength_tooltip.CN: 僵尸每次攻击造成的伤害.

Sandbox_ZToughness_tooltip.EN: The difficulty of killing a zombie.

Sandbox_ZombieAttractionMultiplier_toolt.CN: 用此来放大或降低发动机的总体响度.

Sandbox_ZombieCount_tooltip.EN: Changing this also sets the \"Population Multiplier\" in Advanced Zombie Options.
Sandbox_ZombieCount_tooltip.CN: 修改此项会改变高级设置中\"僵尸数目倍率\"的设定.

Sandbox_ZombieDistribution_tooltip.EN: How zombies are distributed across the map.
Sandbox_ZombieDistribution_tooltip.CN: 僵尸如何在地图上分布.

Sandbox_ZombieHealthImpact_tooltip.EN: Whether nearby "living" zombies have the same impact on the player's health and emotions.
Sandbox_ZombieHealthImpact_tooltip.CN: 附近的"活"僵尸是否对玩家的健康和情绪有相同的影响.

Sandbox_ZombieMigrate_tooltip.EN: Zombie allowed to migrate to empty cells.
Sandbox_ZombieMigrate_tooltip.CN: 允许僵尸迁移到空区块.

Sandbox_ZombiePopLootEffect_tooltip.EN: If greater than 0, the spawn of loot is increased relative to the number of nearby zombies, \nwith the effect multiplied by this number.
Sandbox_ZombiePopLootEffect_tooltip.CN: 如果大于 0, 物品的生成将根据附近僵尸的数量增加, \n效果将乘以这个数字.

Sandbox_ZombieRespawnPercent_tooltip.EN: Percentage of starting zombie numbers that respawn each interval.

Sandbox_ZombieRespawn_tooltip.EN: How frequently new zombies are added to the world.
Sandbox_ZombieRespawn_tooltip.CN: 这将改变游戏中僵尸刷新的时间.

Sandbox_ZombieVoronoiNoise_tooltip.EN: Controls whether some randomization is applied to zombie distribution.
Sandbox_ZombieVoronoiNoise_tooltip.CN: 控制是否对僵尸分布应用随机化算法.

Sandbox_ZombiesArmorFactor_tooltip.EN: Serves as a multiplier when determining the effectiveness of armor worn by zombies.
Sandbox_ZombiesArmorFactor_tooltip.CN: 作为确定僵尸所穿护甲效果的一个倍率.

Sandbox_ZombiesCountBeforeDelete_tooltip.EN: How many zombies can occupy a certain area.
Sandbox_ZombiesCountBeforeDelete_tooltip.CN: 特定区域内允许存在的最大僵尸数量

Sandbox_ZombiesCrawlersDragDown_tooltip.EN: If crawler zombies beside a player contribute to the chance of being dragged down and killed by a group of zombies.
Sandbox_ZombiesCrawlersDragDown_tooltip.CN: 如果爬行僵尸在玩家旁边, 是否会增加被一群僵尸拖倒并杀死的几率.

Sandbox_ZombiesDragDown_tooltip.EN: If multiple attacking zombies can drag you down and kill you. \nDependent on zombie strength.
Sandbox_ZombiesDragDown_tooltip.CN: 启用后, 如果有多个僵尸同时攻击, 则根据僵尸的力量, 它们可以把你拉倒吃掉.

Sandbox_ZombiesFallDamage_tooltip.EN: How much damage zombies take when falling from height.
Sandbox_ZombiesFallDamage_tooltip.CN: 僵尸从高处跌落时受到的伤害.

Sandbox_ZombiesFenceLunge_tooltip.EN: If zombies have a chance to lunge at you after climbing\nover a fence or through a window if you're too close.
Sandbox_ZombiesFenceLunge_tooltip.CN: 启用后, 当你离翻越障碍中的僵尸太近时, 翻越的僵尸会选择向你冲刺一段距离.

Sandbox_ZombiesMaxDefense_tooltip.EN: The maximum defense percentage that any worn protective garments can provide to a zombie.
Sandbox_ZombiesMaxDefense_tooltip.CN: 任何穿戴的防护服能为僵尸提供的最大程度防御百分比.

Sandbox_ZoneStoryChance.CN: 随机区域故事发生几率

Sandbox_ZoneStoryChance_tooltip.EN: The chance of stories specific to map zones (eg. a campsite in a forest) spawning.
Sandbox_ZoneStoryChance_tooltip.CN: 特定地图区域事件 (例如, 森林中的营地) 生成的几率.

SawCopperSheetIntoSmallSheets.EN: Saw Copper Sheet Into Small Sheets

SawWoodenRod.EN: Saw Wooden Rod Into Small Handles

SewHidePants2.EN: Sew Hide Pants from Smaller Pieces

Small_Table.EN: Small Red Oak Table with Drawer

Smith_Sign.CN: H·史密斯律师事务所标牌

Spiffos_Logo_Large_Sign.CN: 大型斯皮福餐厅标志标牌

Spiffos_Type_A_Table.CN: 带金属支架的橙色桌子

Spiffos_Type_B_Table.EN: Orange Double Table with Metal Stand
Spiffos_Type_B_Table.CN: 带金属支架的橙色双人桌

Stash_BBurgMap6_Text1.EN: I had an affair with Derek
Stash_BBurgMap6_Text1.CN: 我和德里克有过一段情

Stash_BBurgMap8_Text1.EN: Olive, I've moved here, near Brandenburg
Stash_BBurgMap8_Text1.CN: 奥利弗, 我搬到这里了, 靠近勃兰登堡

Stash_BBurgMap8_Text2.EN: Mom was sick. I didn't want her to turn
Stash_BBurgMap8_Text2.CN: 妈妈生病了. 我不想让她变成

Stash_EkronMap8_Text2.CN: 忘了他们! 快点到这里来

Stash_IrvingtonMap2_Text3.CN: 你对安所做的付出代价

Stash_IrvingtonMap3_Text1.CN: 别跑! 他们会追你的

Stash_IrvingtonMap3_Text2.EN: radio us if you need to
Stash_IrvingtonMap3_Text2.CN: 如果需要, 用无线电联系我们

Stash_IrvingtonMap4_Text1.EN: How quaint and curious war is

Stash_IrvingtonMap4_Text3.EN: you'd treat if met where any bar is
Stash_IrvingtonMap4_Text3.CN: 若在酒馆相遇, 本会请他喝一杯

Stash_IrvingtonMap4_Text4.EN: or help to half a crown

Stash_IrvingtonMap5_Text2.CN: 除非特蕾莎把它们全拿走了

Stash_IrvingtonMap8_Text3.EN: I can't be the only one left
Stash_IrvingtonMap8_Text3.CN: 我不会是唯一剩下的人

Stash_IrvingtonMap9_Text1.CN: 我们可以在这里加强防御

Stash_LVMap10_Text1.EN: old fuck with house full of food
Stash_LVMap10_Text1.CN: 老混蛋房子里都是食物

Stash_LVMap14_Text1.EN: barricade with the planks I brought you

Stash_LVMap14_Text2.EN: otherwise those things will get in

Stash_LVMap14_Text4.EN: don't let anyone in while I'm away!
Stash_LVMap14_Text4.CN: 我不在的时候不要让任何人进来!

Stash_LVMap14_Text6.EN: any longer, call the Edwards on the radio
Stash_LVMap14_Text6.CN: 等一下, 用无线电打电话给爱德华兹

Stash_LVMap15_Text1.EN: Whoever finds this, I was Natalie Sigmundsson
Stash_LVMap15_Text1.CN: 如果有谁发现了这张地图, 我是娜塔莉·西格蒙德森

Stash_LVMap15_Text2.EN: lecturer in Art History at LSU
Stash_LVMap15_Text2.CN: 路易斯安那州立大学艺术史讲师

Stash_LVMap15_Text3.EN: I'm already dead but I have a final request
Stash_LVMap15_Text3.CN: 我已经死了, 但我有一个最后的请求

Stash_LVMap15_Text4.EN: This is only the end of the world if we allow it to be.
Stash_LVMap15_Text4.CN: 只有每个人都放任不管时, 世界末日才会真的到来.

Stash_LVMap15_Text5.EN: We must secure the treasures in the art gallery or
Stash_LVMap15_Text5.CN: 我们必须保护美术馆中的宝藏

Stash_LVMap15_Text6.CN: 否则, 我们就真的一无所有了

Stash_LVMap15_Text8.EN: Let no-one say that humanity is lost forever.
Stash_LVMap15_Text8.CN: 不要让人类永远迷失下去.

Stash_LVMap16_Text2.CN: 他们把你的儿子弄来了

Stash_LVMap16_Text3.EN: come to us, it's safe now
Stash_LVMap16_Text3.CN: 来找我们吧, 现在很安全

Stash_LVMap2_Text3.CN: 去奶奶的坟墓, 如果你能做到的话

Stash_LVMap2_Text4.EN: say a prayer for us all

Stash_LVMap3_Text2.CN: 怪异看门人的卡车应该在这里

Stash_LVMap5_Text1.CN: 卡林一家搬到了这里, 黛比

Stash_LVMap5_Text2.EN: Go to them if you need help!
Stash_LVMap5_Text2.CN: 如果你需要帮助就去找他们!

Stash_LVMap6_Text1.CN: 金窝银窝, 不如自己的狗窝

Stash_LVMap8_Text3.EN: THEY'RE ALL OVER HERE DON'T GO
Stash_LVMap8_Text3.CN: 它们都在这里, 别去

Stash_LVMap9_Text1.EN: guns and food in far stable

Stash_MarchRidgeMap10_Text2.CN: 愿你再远离地狱一段时间

Stash_MarchRidgeMap2_Text2.CN: 商店看起来还有一些补给品.

Stash_MarchRidgeMap2_Text3.CN: 它们在迁移吗? 好像要去这里.

Stash_MarchRidgeMap3_Text3.CN: 我最后一次看见她的地方.

Stash_MarchRidgeMap4_Text1.EN: If you can make it before you turn. There's something here
Stash_MarchRidgeMap4_Text1.CN: 如果你能在尸变之前到这里的话, 可以拿走这里的物资

Stash_MarchRidgeMap4_Text11.EN: to help. We'll be back together. Somehow.
Stash_MarchRidgeMap4_Text11.CN: 没准有一些帮助. 我们会一起回来. 如果可能的话

Stash_MarchRidgeMap4_Text2.EN: You'll find me here. I love you.
Stash_MarchRidgeMap4_Text2.CN: 你会在这儿找到我的尸体, 我爱你们!

Stash_MarchRidgeMap4_Text3.EN: Wish to God you'd never been stationed here.
Stash_MarchRidgeMap4_Text3.CN: 但愿上帝保佑, 千万别去这里!

Stash_MarchRidgeMap5_Text1.EN: stuff you can use as weapons here
Stash_MarchRidgeMap5_Text1.CN: 这里有一些能当武器用的玩意儿

Stash_MarchRidgeMap6_Text1.EN: stuff we can use to secure building
Stash_MarchRidgeMap6_Text1.CN: 我们可以用来保护建筑的东西

Stash_MarchRidgeMap6_Text3.CN: 这里什么鬼都被扫光了

Stash_MarchRidgeMap7_Text1.EN: Where I think he hid out

Stash_MarchRidgeMap7_Text3.EN: Saw him here. No bite, but had the fever.
Stash_MarchRidgeMap7_Text3.CN: 他在这里, 没有被咬, 不过仍在发烧!

Stash_MarchRidgeMap8_Text1.CN: 把我的旧工具留在这里

Stash_MarchRidgeMap9_Text1.EN: survivors welcome to join us - always

Stash_MarchRidgeMap9_Text2.EN: need food and guns and stuff
Stash_MarchRidgeMap9_Text2.CN: 需要更多的食物, 枪支和其他东西

Stash_MarchRidgeMap9_Text3.EN: kill some on the way in for kudos!

Stash_MulMap10_Text3.CN: 这里似乎已经被洗劫一空!

Stash_MulMap12_Text1.CN: 这里有霰弹枪, 也许还有些吃的在厨房里

Stash_MulMap13_Text1.EN: got halfway but had to leave it all - too heavy
Stash_MulMap13_Text1.CN: 不得不放弃了一些东西, 太重了.

Stash_MulMap13_Text2.EN: plenty of gear still in hardware store
Stash_MulMap13_Text2.CN: 五金店里还有很多物资.

Stash_MulMap14_Text3.CN: 不要开枪 - 声音会吸引他们

Stash_MulMap15_Text21.CN: 这是 J 被咬的地方

Stash_MulMap16_Text2.EN: I miss TV and cold beer, fuck this
Stash_MulMap16_Text2.CN: 我想念电视和冰镇啤酒, 去他妈的这个世界

Stash_MulMap17_Text3.EN: be careful mom, dad's still here
Stash_MulMap17_Text3.CN: 妈妈小心, 爸爸还在这里

Stash_MulMap18_Text11.CN: 听说他已经变成了它们中的一员

Stash_MulMap18_Text12.CN: 希望他所有的枪都还在

Stash_MulMap1_Text1.CN: 这里的地板下藏有某些东西.

Stash_MulMap3_Text1.CN: 这里藏着霰弹枪和弹药.

Stash_MulMap6_Text1.EN: Bob, I want this place fortified like HELL.
Stash_MulMap6_Text1.CN: 我不想再回到这地狱一般的地方!

Stash_MulMap6_Text21.CN: 这里应该有有一些抗生素和绷带.

Stash_MulMap6_Text3.EN: O Saw a herd of them headed this way - Avoid!
Stash_MulMap6_Text3.CN: 看到一群僵尸正朝这里行进!

Stash_MulMap7_Text2.CN: 商店, 仍然有很多资源.

Stash_MulMap8_Text1.CN: 拿走我的东西吧, 如果安全的话希望你能安葬我.

Stash_MulMap8_Text2.CN: 如果需要饮料, 可以来这里!

Stash_MulMap8_Text3.EN: big crowd, hasn't moved in days
Stash_MulMap8_Text3.CN: 有一大堆僵尸在这待了好几天

Stash_RiversideStashMap10_Text21.CN: 你的斧头看起来有点松了

Stash_RiversideStashMap10_Text3.EN: heading west out of town soon
Stash_RiversideStashMap10_Text3.CN: 马上向西出城, 你知道在哪里可以找到我

Stash_RiversideStashMap2_Text11.CN: 还记得我们花了一整天时间盯着河流吗?

Stash_RiversideStashMap4_Text1.CN: 达里尔病了, 把他留在了这里

Stash_RiversideStashMap4_Text11.EN: get natalie, she'll know what to do
Stash_RiversideStashMap4_Text11.CN: 去找娜塔莉, 她会知道该怎么做的

Stash_RiversideStashMap4_Text2.EN: saw them drag down two people here
Stash_RiversideStashMap4_Text2.CN: 看到他们把两个人拖到这里, 太可怕了

Stash_RiversideStashMap5_Text2.CN: 这些混蛋杀死了弗兰克并咬了我

Stash_RiversideStashMap6_Text11.EN: Fucker'd take over if he wasn't sick
Stash_RiversideStashMap6_Text11.CN: 如果他没生病一定会带我们远离镇子

Stash_RiversideStashMap6_Text12.EN: Hope that psycho Vicky didn't get them
Stash_RiversideStashMap6_Text12.CN: 希望那个变态的维科没有找到他们

Stash_RiversideStashMap7_Text21.EN: Don't fight with June when I'm gone
Stash_RiversideStashMap7_Text21.CN: 我不在的时候不要和桑德拉打架

Stash_RiversideStashMap8_Text3.CN: 我在哪里见过那群人 (现在可能已经死了)

Stash_RiversideStashMap9_Text3.CN: D 的情况不太好 - 需要抗生素

Stash_RosewoodStashMap3_Text1.EN: help us fortify while we wait it out.
Stash_RosewoodStashMap3_Text1.CN: 记得在我们不在的时候加固这里.

Stash_RosewoodStashMap3_Text11.EN: Mom's old place. see you there x
Stash_RosewoodStashMap3_Text11.CN: 妈妈的老家. 我会在那里等你 x

Stash_RosewoodStashMap4_Text3.EN: take what you can and head into forest
Stash_RosewoodStashMap4_Text3.CN: 拿走你能带的东西然后消失在森林里

Stash_RosewoodStashMap5_Text3.CN: 永远铭记邓肯先生的遭遇

Stash_WorldMap11_Text1.CN: 2 号塔上的 3 号天线 - 丢失信号

Stash_WorldMap11_Text11.CN: 在 6 GHz 频段上丢失信号 - 电源问题

Stash_WorldMap11_Text2.EN: Get HQ to test with Lexington
Stash_WorldMap11_Text2.CN: 让总部和列克星敦一起测试

Stash_WorldMap12_Text11.EN: has all we need (except Jane's pills)
Stash_WorldMap12_Text11.CN: 我们需要一切 (简需要的药丸除外)

Stash_WorldMap12_Text2.EN: We'll all be sitting around a fire
Stash_WorldMap12_Text2.CN: 我们很快就能坐在火堆旁

Stash_WorldMap13_Text1.CN: 哈尔, 我知道这很难

SurvivalGuide_Joypad_entrie10moreinfo.EN:
JUMP IN
If you're lucky, a frantic car owner might have left their keys in the door, the ignition, or the glove box. Alternatively, search nearby zeds in case one of them was the owner. Likewise, if your chosen vehicle is parked outside a house, search it. The key could be inside.
Still no joy? Why not perform a little grand theft auto? Smash the vehicle's window to unlock it. If you have high enough Mechanic and Electrical skills, you'll be able to hotwire it.

TIME TO DRIVE
Use to insert your key and start the engine.
If the car's engine condition isn't high, it may not start first time. If it's refusing to turn over at all, you may be out of gas entirely, and it might be time to inspect the Mechanics window.
Drive cautiously! The louder a car, the wider the radius of nearby zombies that'll be alerted and start to follow the noise.

DASHBOARD
On a vehicle's Dashboard you can see helpful read-outs of information like the fuel levels, speed and RPM.
Icons on top of the dash will also tell you engine status, whether the trunk is open, whether the headlights are operational, and so on.

RADIAL MENU
If you're inside or next to a vehicle press . This will open its radial menu.
From here you can switch seats, lock doors, operate lights, open up the Mechanics window, and more.

MECHANICS WINDOW
An unskilled survivor can check if their battery is still okay, see fuel levels, and notice whether certain parts of the car appear damaged. A survivor with better Mechanic skills will be able to see extra details, and install and uninstall parts.

SurvivalGuide_Joypad_entrie11moreinfo.EN:
CLIMATE CHANGE
Weather patterns in Project Zomboid are realistic. A simulated climate system uses the time of year, and virtual weather fronts, to create the rain, snow, fog and thunderstorms at the relevant times of year. Wear the right clothes to keep you cool in the summer and warm in winter, and remember to keep them in good condition!
Temperature has an impact on your survival. When winter draws in, your resistance to the cold will be highest if you're well fed, not tired and wearing proper winter clothing. It will also help to keep active and be physically fit. Wetness and sickness will both increase the likelihood of you suffering from the cold. During periods of extreme cold it's best to warm up inside a building or with heat sources like campfires, car heaters and stoves. When surviving during hot weather, meanwhile, staying well-hydrated and wearing lighter clothing is advised.

KNOWING TEMPERATURE
Wearing a digital watch will show the temperature on your UI.

WIND CHILL
Being outside, especially during winter months, will make you experience wind chill. Heavy rain or blizzards in mid-winter can severely drop your temperature due to the combination of strong wind and low temperature.
Wind chill affects your body, but won't show a direct difference in temperature on your digital watch. Keep an eye on your moodles to see when it's impacting on you.
"

CLOTHING PROTECTION
Wearing the right clothing could protect you from bites, scratches and lacerations. Use the button menu to open your Player Info view and press to navigate to the Clothing Protection Panel and see an overview of your survivor's current protection levels.
You can repair holes in your clothing with the appropriate materials and Tailoring level, and even add padding to add more protection. Select the clothing item in your inventory and select "Inspect" in the menu to do so. Just make sure you have strips of the appropriate fabric along with a needle and thread in your inventory.

FORAGING / SEARCH SYSTEM
The Investigate Area window shows your zone. This impacts on the loot that can be found. Hover your mouse over the window to inspect the loot categories that are available in your current zone. If you see "?????", then there is nothing of use that can be found. To start searching, select 'Enable Search Mode' from the button menu. The search radius will appear. This is the area in which your survivor can spot items. An arrow pointing to an item will appear when they see something. An eye icon will appear while your character approaches, and sees exactly what it is. Use the menu to pick up a discovered item. IMPROVING YOUR SEARCHING
Looking around (by aiming) and crouching will both increase the search radius. Darkness, inclement weather, skills, item size and negative moodles (stress, injuries, etc) will all affect item visibility. IMPORTANT!
Be sure to check relevant and logical locations! For example, trash can be found in trash piles, chipped stones are often found in cracks and potholes on roads. ",}

SurvivalGuide_Joypad_entrie13moreinfo.EN:
FARM ANIMALS Farm animals include domesticated species like cows, sheep, pigs, and chickens. You'll sometimes find livestock still living at old farms, but they'll probably starve or die without your help.
ZONED OUT
Farm animals need a "Livestock Zone" to figure out where they should stay, and find their food. To create a Livestock Zone, or see existing Zones, click the Zoning icon. Click and drag to create a new Livestock Zone. An animal that is inside a Livestock Zone is automatically assigned to it, and will not leave it, even if the Zone is unfenced. An animal can be led to a Zone, or anywhere else, by right clicking on it and clicking "Attach Animal to Rope". Smaller animals can be picked up and placed.
The Zones menu shows all nearby Livestock Zones. Any animal outside of a Zone will wander randomly, and will not mate. Right click on a Zone to see extra information, such as its assigned animals, and available food and water levels. ANIMAL WELFARE
Animals can die from stress. Stress is caused by events like the animal being attacked, nearby gunfire, or the presence of zombies. Chickens are prone to predation by wild predators, and are best kept in a henhouse at night. Remember to close the door! Note that zombies will never attack animals.
MAKING BABIES A male and a female animal of the same species can breed if in the same Zone, and it's their mating season.

WILD ANIMALS Wild animals such as deer, rabbits, and rats can be found wandering the world in forests, fields, or even in homes. Larger wild animals cannot be tamed or assigned to a Zone.
TRACKING
Wild animals leave droppings, paw prints, and other evidence as they move through the world. You can use Search Mode to find these clues to track down wild animals.
BUTCHERY
After killing a wild or farm animal, the body must be butchered with a knife to get meat and other materials from it.

SurvivalGuide_Joypad_entrie14moreinfo.EN:
FISHING To catch fish, you need a rod or a net. These can be found in the world or, with the proper recipes, crafted. Rods need a line and a hook, both of which can break. They also need bait to be attached to attract fish. FISHING SPOTS
Find a river or lake, and right click to check its fishing information. Not enough fish? You can make Chum to attract more! Create a Chum Base by right-clicking on sand on the ground. Then add bait to the Chum by right-clicking on it in your inventory. Right-click on a body of water and select the option to throw it in.Hold the right mouse button with a rod equipped and left click to throw out your line.
Once a fish takes the bite, hold the left mouse button to reel in your catch. Too much tension of your line, shown by the meter, could break it. Hold the right mouse button to release the line and lower the tension. THINK OF THE ENVIRONMENT
Fish numbers are affected by the weather, time of day, season, the type of water (river or lake), along with noise, which can scare fish away. Fish can also deplete from an area if overfished.

钓 鱼 钓 鱼 需 要 鱼 竿 或 渔 网 . 它 们 可 以 在 世 界 中 找 到 , 也 可 以 在 有 合 适 的 配 方 的 情 况 下 制 作 . 鱼 竿 需 要 一 根 鱼 线 和 一 个 鱼 钩 来 制 作 , 而 鱼 线 和 鱼 钩 都 可 能 断 掉 . 鱼 竿 还 需 要 装 上 钓 饵 来 吸 引 鱼 . 钓 鱼 点
找 一 条 河 或 一 座 湖 , 右 键 就 可 以 查 看 这 里 钓 鱼 的 情 况 . 鱼 不 够 多 ? 你 可 以 制 作 散 饵 来 吸 引 更 多 鱼 ! 右 键 单 击 地 面 上 的 沙 子 可 以 创 建 一 个 " 饵 托 ". 然 后 在 你 的 物 品 栏 中 右 键 单 击 鱼 饵 , 添 加 鱼 饵 . 右 键 单 击 一 片 水 域 , 然 后 选 择 将 鱼 饵 扔 进 去 . 按 住 鼠 标 右 键 , 然 后 点 击 鼠 标 左 键 即 可 抛 出 鱼 线 .
鱼 上 钩 后 , 按 住 鼠 标 左 键 即 可 收 线 . 如 果 显 示 鱼 线 张 力 过 大 , 鱼 线 就 有 可 能 会 断 裂 . 按 住 鼠 标 右 键 即 可 释 放 鱼 线 并 降 低 张 力 . 检 查 环 境
鱼 类 数 量 受 天 气 , 时 间 , 季 节 , 水 体 类 型 ( 河 流 或 湖 泊 ) 以 及 噪 音 的 影 响 , 噪 音 可 能 会 吓 跑 鱼 类 . 如 果 过 度 捕 捞 , 某 个 地 区 的 鱼 类 资 源 也 会 减 少 .

MOVEMENT
To scamper around in Project Zomboid, use .

COMBAT
To attack, use to aim, then press to attack. Without a weapon equipped, you can only shove (you can also press to shove, even with a weapon equipped). See pages 3 and 4 of this guide for more in-depth information on combat.

MOODLES
The little icons that sometimes appear at the upper right of the screen are called moodles. These give an overview of your survivor's condition at a glance.

BASIC CONTROLS
You can interact with nearby objects with a click of . This will, for example, open doors or windows.
Using lets you look around and aim. Open your inventory using , use to navigate, and and to switch containers in either your inventory or the nearest world tile.

HEALTH
Press to open your radial menu and select the heart icon to see your health. From here you can apply first aid - or check for a dreaded bite mark.

DOORS AND WINDOWS
Press by a window to open or close it, and press to climb through if it's already open (or smashed). Pressing beside a closed window will smash it - useful in an emergency, but be careful of broken glass.

CLIMBING
Press to climb over fences. You will also auto-climb over small fences by Jogging or Sprinting towards them (see page 2 of this guide for more information).

CONTEXT MENU
More detailed interaction, such as crafting, can be accessed with the button context menu.

TIME
Time usually flies in Project Zomboid, but if not (and in single-player), the controls in the button radial menu will help. You can use the controls to fast-forward at various speeds if you're standing still or performing an action (like reading or building). You can also use the controls to pause and have a rethink after another disastrous loot run.

MAP
Hold to open your map and its options. As you move around the world, your map will fill in with more detail. You may also have a minimap at the bottom right.

DON'T DIE
Try not to die at all times.

ZOMBIE SENSES
Zombies respond to sight and sound. Be extremely wary of loud noises like sirens, alarms, and gunfire as the horde is sure to arrive to investigate.

RUNNING
Use to Jog, and while Jogging to Sprint. Running generates sound and makes you more noticeable. You can outrun the deadheads for a while, but not forever.

CROUCH
Survivors can crouch by clicking to reduce their visibility, and crouch beside walls and fences to reduce their visibility further (notice your character crouching down lower when in cover). You can also Jog while in this state.
Project Zomboid is not a popularity contest. Zombies don't follow you to get your autograph - they only want to bite you. Also they do not hug.

SurvivalGuide_Joypad_entrie3moreinfo.EN:
COMBAT MECHANICS
Each weapon is capable of dealing a set amount of damage. However, its power and precision is determined by your skills. Or lack of them.
Use to aim, and press to attack. Reload guns using unboxed ammo in your inventory with , and clear a jam by selecting the gun in your inventory and using the menu. Low condition weapons are much more likely to jam.
Aim outlines appear only for firearms by default. A red outline means a low chance to hit, while green means a high chance. To turn on aim outlines for melee weapons as well, or to turn off aim outline completely, use the Aim Outline setting on the Display tab of the Options screen available from the main menu by pressing the menu button twice.
Stabby weapons like knives will sometimes be able to "jaw stab" zombies to kill them in one hit. Don't expect much from the butter knife though.

GROUND ATTACKS
The best way to re-dead a dead person is to knock them to the floor and then get all bashy with their brains.
Zombies can be knocked over by attacks or shoves. In the absence of other attacking zombies, your attacks will be aimed towards downed zombies within your weapon's range.

You can also press when right beside a downed zombie to "stomp" them. This is weaker than attacking with a weapon but means your weapon won't lose condition, or you don't waste ammo. Remember to aim for the head. Stomping zombie's legs will never kill them, and just looks silly.

基 础 知 识
每 把 武 器 都 能 造 成 一 定 的 伤 害 . 但 是 , 它 的 威 力 和 精 度 取 决 于 你 的 技 能 和 你 对 武 器 的 熟 悉 程 度 .
使 用 进 行 瞄 准 , 按 下 进 行 攻 击 . 可 以 使 用 来 用 物 品 栏 中 已 打 开 的 弹 药 重 新 装 填 枪 支 . 状 态 不 佳 的 武 器 更 有 可 能 卡 壳 .
默 认 情 况 下 , 只 有 枪 械 才 会 显 示 瞄 准 轮 廓 . 红 色 轮 廓 表 示 命 中 率 低 , 绿 色 轮 廓 表 示 命 中 率 高 . 要 同 时 启 用 近 战 武 器 的 瞄 准 轮 廓 , 或 完 全 关 闭 瞄 准 轮 廓 , 请 使 用 " 选 项 " 屏 幕 ( 在 主 菜 单 中 按 两 次 菜 单 按 钮 即 可 打 开 ) 中 " 显 示 " 选 项 卡 上 的 " 瞄 准 轮 廓 " 设 置 .
像 刀 子 这 样 的 戳 刺 武 器 有 时 能 " 处 决 " 僵 尸 , 一 击 毙 命 . 不 过 , 黄 油 刀 的 作 用 就 别 太 期 待 了 .

地 面 攻 击
杀 死 活 死 人 的 最 佳 方 式 , 就 是 将 它 们 击 倒 , 然 后 摧 毁 它 们 的 大 脑 .
僵 尸 可 以 通 过 攻 击 或 推 搡 被 击 倒 . 在 没 有 其 他 僵 尸 攻 击 的 情 况 下 , 你 的 攻 击 将 瞄 准 你 武 器 射 程 内 的 倒 地 僵 尸 .

你 也 可 以 在 倒 地 僵 尸 旁 边 按 下 来 踩 它 们 . 这 比 用 武 器 攻 击 要 弱 , 但 是 不 会 让 武 器 减 少 耐 久 , 也 不 会 浪 费 弹 药 . 记 住 瞄 准 僵 尸 的 头 部 . 踩 僵 尸 的 腿 永 远 不 会 杀 死 它 们 , 而 且 看 起 来 很 滑 稽 .

SurvivalGuide_Joypad_entrie5moreinfo.EN:
WATER
The world's water supply, like the electricity, will not last forever. Stockpile water bottles if you don't want to check out later down the line.
Your character will automatically drink water from any container in your inventory.
To drink or to fill a bottle, just use the menu on any in-game item that provides water. Sinks, baths, faucets. all that jazz.
You can also get water by leaving open containers like saucepans outside in the rain, by collecting it from a river, or by building a wooden water container.
Water that is not from a plumbed source like a faucet will be tainted and must be boiled for safe drinking. However, tainted water can be safely used to water crops or wash your clothes.
SurvivalGuide_Joypad_entrie5moreinfo.CN:
水 源
供 水 系 统 就 像 电 力 一 样 , 不 会 取 之 不 尽 . 如 果 你 不 想 因 缺 水 而 渴 死 的 话 , 请 好 好 储 备 水 资 源 …
你 的 角 色 会 自 动 从 你 物 品 栏 中 的 任 何 容 器 中 喝 水 .
要 喝 水 或 装 水 , 只 需 在 游 戏 中 任 何 提 供 水 的 家 具 / 物 品 上 使 用 菜 单 . 例 如 水 槽 , 浴 缸 , 水 龙 头 , 等 等 .
你 也 可 以 把 平 底 锅 等 容 器 放 在 雨 中 收 集 水 源 , 也 可 以 从 河 流 中 收 集 水 资 源 , 还 可 以 建 造 木 制 雨 水 收 集 桶 来 储 水 .
不 过 , 这 样 获 取 的 水 是 被 污 染 的 , 必 须 经 过 煮 沸 才 能 安 全 饮 用 . 被 污 染 的 水 可 以 安 全 地 用 于 浇 灌 庄 稼 或 洗 衣 服 .

SurvivalGuide_Joypad_entrie6moreinfo.EN:
INVENTORY CRAFTING
To craft items in your inventory, simply press while selecting something you're carrying in your inventory pane.
Any craftable items you can create with this, and the other stuff you're carrying, will magically be shown!
A range of cooking, carpentry, medical, and survival recipes will give you the edge in the apocalypse.

BARRICADING
You can barricade doors and windows using the menu. You'll need a hammer, planks and nails in your inventory to barricade with planks, or a propane torch, welding mask, and a metal sheet to barricade with metal.

CARPENTRY AND METALWORKING
As you find resources and become more competent, you can eventually construct entire buildings. For wooden constructions you MUST have a hammer, while metal constructions require a propane torch, a welding mask, and for most metalwork items, welding rods. Simply use the menu to get the build menu.
From here, you can select any piece of furniture that your skills and materials can produce.
Once selected, you will have a transparent representation of the final product will appear and which you can then move around the world and place with .
The process isn't a rapid one, and walls have to be built in multiple stages. PZ is a realism-devoted game, and if you've ever had builders in you'll know these things take time. (Please note we do let you craft cups of tea in-game, if it helps). You can rotate crafted items before placement by pressing or .
REMEMBER: the more you craft, the better you you'll become. Higher skill levels means better quality items, and more useful ones too.

PICKING UP WORLD TILES

Most furniture and static objects in the world can be picked up. Simply select the wooden locker icon on the button menu to pick up a world item, place an item already in your inventory, rotate an object in place, or disassemble it. Hold to change furniture mode.
Picking up and disassembling objects may require tools or a minimum skill level to be successful. Moving objects can be a helpful way to quickly barricade your base (by placing objects in front of doors and windows), or to move useful items like fridges or crates to a new location.
SurvivalGuide_Joypad_entrie6moreinfo.CN:
物 品 制 作
要 加 工 物 品 栏 的 物 品 , 只 需 点 击 即 可 .
任 何 可 制 作 的 物 品 都 会 神 奇 地 展 示 出 来 !
烹 饪 , 木 工 , 医 疗 和 生 存 等 一 系 列 技 巧 将 让 你 在 世 界 末 日 中 占 据 优 势 .

加 固
你 可 以 通 过 单 击 来 加 固 门 窗 . 你 需 要 用 物 品 栏 中 的 锤 子 , 木 板 和 钉 子 来 固 定 木 板 , 或 者 使 用 丙 烷 喷 灯 , 焊 接 面 罩 来 焊 接 金 属 板 .

木 工 和 金 工
当 你 找 到 资 源 并 变 得 更 有 能 力 时 , 便 可 以 建 造 建 筑 . 必 须 要 有 锤 子 才 能 建 造 木 质 结 构 , 而 金 属 结 构 则 需 要 丙 烷 喷 灯 和 焊 接 面 罩 . 对 于 大 部 分 金 工 而 言 , 还 需 要 焊 条 . 可 以 使 用 打 开 建 造 菜 单 .
从 这 里 你 可 以 看 到 所 能 建 筑 的 家 具 .
选 择 后 , 你 将 看 到 建 筑 的 透 明 版 , 然 后 你 可 以 在 世 界 各 地 移 动 , 点 击 放 置 .
这 个 过 程 并 不 快 , 因 为 罗 马 不 是 一 天 建 成 的 . 僵 尸 毁 灭 工 程 是 一 款 以 现 实 主 义 为 核 心 的 游 戏 . 如 果 你 有 过 建 筑 知 识 , 你 就 会 知 道 建 筑 需 要 时 间 . ( 如 果 你 想 的 话 , 你 可 以 在 游 戏 里 倒 杯 茶 放 松 一 下 . ) 你 可 以 在 放 置 前 使 用 或 来 旋 转 所 要 放 置 的 结 构 .
记 住 : 制 作 得 越 多 , 你 就 会 变 得 越 强 . 更 高 的 技 能 水 平 意 味 着 更 好 的 质 量 , 以 及 更 有 用 的 物 品 .

" 捡 " 起 物 品

BLOCK OFF THEIR VIEW
One of the most common mistakes in the zombie apocalypse is to leave the curtains open. Forgetting drapes-closure invites wandering zombies down your garden path, and straight to your brain-stem.
To close curtains or blinds, use the button menu.
Barricading windows also stops zombies viewing light and movement.
If there are no curtains, and you haven't got planks to spare, perhaps you can hang something up instead? Go on, give it a try.

SurvivalGuide_Joypad_entrie8moreinfo.EN:
INVENTORY
So how do you rummage, grab, drop and use in Project Zomboid? Use to open your inventory, and the directional pad to navigate. and will switch between containers in the chosen space (your inventory or the world), and will move the selected object between the two open inventories.
You can also use the menu to 'Loot All' if you're so excited that you have to grab EVERYTHING in a container.

THE GLORY OF BAGS
Bags are important. They help you carry stuff.
To equip one and hurriedly throw your items in, select it in your inventory and use the menu and attach it to your primary hand, secondary hand or (with some bags) on your back.
You'll then see the equipped bag in your inventory, all ready for you to drop your loot into. Vitally, bags will grant you a weight reduction so you can carry more, but be careful: if you put a lot of stuff in your bag, it'll still slow down your movement.

RADIAL MENU
Press the button to open a radial menu allowing you access to your health menu, furniture movement mode, foraging, and more! Use the left directional button to open your weapon menu to quickly equip any weapon in your inventory. Use the down directional button to open your gestures menu. Wave hello a friend, or give your favourite zombie a thumbs up!

SurvivalGuide__Joypadentrie4moreinfo.EN:
SHOOT 'EM UP
Guns are noisy but, in the right hands, they are powerful. Remember: stand your ground, shoot slow, and stay calm.
With a gun equipped, use to aim, then press to attack. The bigger the cursor, the less accurate your shot will be. Your chance of hitting anything is not only influenced by your Skills and Moodles, but also light levels, the weather, and more. A tired, panicked survivor with terrible aiming skills isn't going to hit many zombies on a foggy day - or a sunny one for that matter. Reload guns using unboxed ammo in your inventory with , and clear a jam with . Low condition weapons are much more likely to jam.

TOP TIPS
1. It takes time to shoulder and aim your weapon. Firing too quickly will make you miss.
2. Make sure you're ready for a fight before you fire. Guns are extremely noisy and WILL attract many zombies, so make sure you have a Plan B.
3. You can shoot from a car. However, your aim will be extremely poor in a moving vehicle, or at angles other than directly to the side.
4. A weapon's sight or scope is only effective within a certain range. In certain situations (eg. using a scoped rifle on a close target), you will automatically ignore the scope and aim down the barrel.
SurvivalGuide__Joypadentrie4moreinfo.CN:
射 击
开 火 很 吵 , 但 在 善 用 的 情 况 下 也 很 强 大 . 记 住 , 站 稳 , 冷 静 下 来 , 然 后 慢 慢 开 火 .
装 备 枪 支 后 , 使 用 来 瞄 准 , 然 后 使 用 进 行 攻 击 . 光 标 越 大 , 射 击 精 度 越 低 . 射 击 成 功 率 不 仅 受 技 能 和 情 绪 影 响 , 还 受 光 照 水 平 , 天 气 等 因 素 影 响 … 一 个 疲 惫 不 堪 , 惊 慌 失 措 , 瞄 准 技 术 糟 糕 的 幸 存 者 在 雾 天 ( 阳 光 明 媚 的 日 子 也 一 样 ) 是 不 太 可 能 打 中 僵 尸 的 . 使 用 重 新 装 填 枪 支 ( 物 品 栏 中 需 要 有 已 打 开 的 子 弹 ), 使 用 清 除 武 器 卡 壳 . 状 态 不 佳 的 武 器 更 容 易 卡 壳 .

实 用 技 巧
1. 拿 起 武 器 和 瞄 准 都 需 要 时 间 , 急 着 开 火 会 让 命 中 率 下 降 .
2. 开 火 前 , 确 保 自 己 已 经 准 备 好 应 对 接 下 来 的 大 战 . 开 火 的 声 音 很 大 , 会 吸 引 很 多 僵 尸 , 因 此 一 定 要 准 备 一 个 应 急 方 案 .
3. 你 可 以 在 车 里 射 击 . 但 是 , 在 行 驶 的 车 辆 中 , 或 者 从 侧 面 以 外 的 角 度 射 击 时 , 瞄 准 精 度 会 非 常 差 .
4. 武 器 的 瞄 准 镜 仅 在 特 定 范 围 内 有 效 . 在 某 些 情 况 下 ( 例 如 , 使 用 带 瞄 准 镜 的 步 枪 瞄 准 近 距 离 目 标 ), 你 会 自 动 忽 略 瞄 准 镜 直 接 瞄 准 .

SurvivalGuide_entrie10moreinfo.EN:
JUMP IN
Press to enter an unlocked car. If you're lucky, a frantic car owner might have left their keys in the ignition, the glove box, or near the car. Alternatively, search nearby zeds in case one of them was the owner. Likewise, if your chosen vehicle is parked outside a house, search it. The key could be inside.
Still no joy? Why not perform a little grand theft auto? Smash the vehicle's window to unlock it. If you have high enough Mechanic and Electrical skills, you'll be able to hotwire it.

TIME TO DRIVE
Click on the ignition to insert your key, then click the engine icon on the dashboard (or press ) to start the engine. Alternatively, just press the forward key to get rolling.
If the car's engine condition isn't high, it may not start first time. If it's refusing to turn over at all, you may be out of gas entirely, and it might be time to inspect the Mechanics window.
Drive cautiously! The louder a car, the wider the radius of nearby zombies that'll be alerted and start to follow the noise.

DASHBOARD
On a vehicle's Dashboard you can see helpful read-outs of information like the fuel levels, speed and RPM.
Icons on top of the dash will also tell you engine status, whether the trunk is open, whether the headlights are operational, and so on.

RADIAL MENU
If you're inside or next to a vehicle press . This will open its radial menu.
From here you can switch seats, lock doors, operate lights, open up the Mechanics window, and more.

MECHANICS WINDOW
An unskilled survivor can check if their battery is still okay, see fuel levels, and notice whether certain parts of the car appear damaged. A survivor with better Mechanic skills will be able to see extra details, and install and uninstall parts.
For more information on this and the Mechanic skill, click the info icon in the top left corner of the Mechanic window.

SurvivalGuide_entrie11moreinfo.EN:
CLIMATE CHANGE
Weather patterns in Project Zomboid are realistic. A simulated climate system uses the time of year, and virtual weather fronts, to create the rain, snow, fog and thunderstorms at the relevant times of year. Wear the right clothes to keep you cool in the summer and warm in winter, and remember to keep them in good condition!
Temperature has an impact on your survival. When winter draws in, your resistance to the cold will be highest if you're well fed, not tired and wearing proper winter clothing. It will also help to keep active and be physically fit. Wetness and sickness will both increase the likelihood of you suffering from the cold. During periods of extreme cold it's best to warm up inside a building or with heat sources like campfires, car heaters and stoves. When surviving during hot weather, meanwhile, staying well-hydrated and wearing lighter clothing is advised.

KNOWING TEMPERATURE
Wearing a digital watch will show the temperature on your UI.

WIND CHILL
Being outside, especially during winter months, will make you experience wind chill. Heavy rain or blizzards in mid-winter can severely drop your temperature due to the combination of strong wind and low temperature.
Wind chill affects your body, but won't show a direct difference in temperature on your digital watch. Keep an eye on your moodles to see when it's impacting on you.
"

CLOTHING PROTECTION
Wearing the right clothing could protect you from bites, scratches and lacerations. Press to open the Clothing Protection Panel and see an overview of your survivor's current protection levels.
You can repair holes in your clothing with the appropriate materials and Tailoring level, and even add padding to add more protection. Simply right click on the clothing item in your inventory and click "Inspect", then right click on the area you want to patch or repair. Just make sure you have strips of the appropriate fabric along with a needle and thread in your inventory.
SurvivalGuide_entrie11moreinfo.CN:
气 候 变 化
僵 尸 毁 灭 工 程 中 的 天 气 模 式 是 非 常 真 实 的 . 游 戏 中 的 天 气 和 气 候 系 统 会 根 据 目 前 的 时 间 制 造 雨 , 雪 , 雾 和 雷 暴 等 天 气 , 并 且 拥 有 跟 现 实 世 界 一 样 的 四 季 . 请 穿 对 衣 服 , 保 持 冬 暖 夏 凉 . 记 得 要 善 待 自 己 的 衣 服 !
温 度 会 影 响 生 存 . 冬 季 来 临 时 , 如 果 你 吃 得 够 饱 , 不 疲 倦 , 并 且 穿 着 合 适 的 冬 装 , 你 对 寒 冷 的 抵 抗 力 就 会 提 升 至 最 高 . 保 持 活 动 和 身 体 健 康 也 有 助 于 抵 抗 寒 冷 . 潮 湿 和 疾 病 都 会 增 加 你 患 上 感 冒 的 可 能 性 . 在 极 其 寒 冷 的 天 气 里 , 最 好 待 在 建 筑 物 内 或 使 用 篝 火 , 汽 车 加 热 器 和 炉 灶 等 热 源 取 暖 . 同 时 , 在 炎 热 天 气 中 生 存 时 , 建 议 保 持 充 足 的 水 分 并 穿 着 轻 便 的 衣 服 .

了 解 温 度
佩 戴 电 子 表 时 . 界 面 上 会 显 示 温 度 .

风 寒
在 户 外 , 尤 其 是 在 冬 季 , 你 就 会 感 受 到 刮 风 有 多 冷 . 大 雨 或 隆 冬 时 节 的 暴 风 雪 , 强 风 和 低 温 的 结 合 , 会 使 你 的 体 温 急 剧 下 降 .
风 寒 会 影 响 你 的 身 体 , 但 不 会 在 你 的 电 子 表 上 直 接 显 示 体 温 变 化 . 留 意 你 的 状 态 栏 , 这 样 就 能 了 解 它 何 时 对 你 产 生 影 响 .
"

FORAGING / SEARCH SYSTEM
The Investigate Area window shows your zone. This impacts on the loot that can be found. Hover your mouse over the window to inspect the loot categories that are available in your current zone. If you see "?????", then there is nothing of use that can be found. To start searching, click 'Enable Search Mode'. The search radius will appear. This is the area in which your survivor can spot items. An arrow pointing to an item will appear when they see something. An eye icon will appear while your character approaches, and sees exactly what it is. Double click a discovered item to pick it up. Right click for more pickup options. IMPROVING YOUR SEARCHING
Looking around (by aiming) and crouching will both increase the search radius. Darkness, inclement weather, skills, item size and negative moodles (stress, injuries, etc) will all affect item visibility. IMPORTANT!
Be sure to check relevant and logical locations! For example, trash can be found in trash piles, chipped stones are often found in cracks and potholes on roads.

FARM ANIMALS Farm animals include domesticated species like cows, sheep, pigs, and chickens. You'll sometimes find livestock still living at old farms, but they'll probably starve or die without your help.
ZONED OUT
Farm animals need a "Livestock Zone" to figure out where they should stay, and find their food. To create a Livestock Zone, or see existing Zones, click the Zoning icon. Click and drag to create a new Livestock Zone. An animal that is inside a Livestock Zone is automatically assigned to it, and will not leave it, even if the Zone is unfenced. An animal can be led to a Zone, or anywhere else, by right clicking on it and clicking "Attach Animal to Rope". Smaller animals can be picked up and placed.
The Zones menu shows all nearby Livestock Zones. Any animal outside of a Zone will wander randomly, and will not mate. Right click on a Zone to see extra information, such as its assigned animals, and available food and water levels. ANIMAL WELFARE
Animals can die from stress. Stress is caused by events like the animal being attacked, nearby gunfire, or the presence of zombies. Chickens are prone to predation by wild predators, and are best kept in a henhouse at night. Remember to close the door! Note that zombies will never attack animals.
MAKING BABIES A male and a female animal of the same species can breed if in the same Zone, and it's their mating season.

WILD ANIMALS Wild animals such as deer, rabbits, and rats can be found wandering the world in forests, fields, or even in homes. Larger wild animals cannot be tamed or assigned to a Zone.
TRACKING
Wild animals leave droppings, paw prints, and other evidence as they move through the world. You can use Search Mode to find these clues to track down wild animals.
BUTCHERY
After killing a wild or farm animal, the body must be butchered with a knife to get meat and other materials from it.

SurvivalGuide_entrie14moreinfo.EN:
FISHING To catch fish, you need a rod or a net. Rods need a line and a hook, both of which can break. They also need bait to be attached to attract fish.
FISHING SPOTS
More bubbles on the water means more chance to catch fish in that location. Hold the right mouse button with a rod equipped and left click to throw out your line.
Once a fish takes the bite, hold the left mouse button to reel in your catch. Too much tension of your line, shown by the meter, could break it. Hold the right mouse button to release the line and lower the tension. THINK OF THE ENVIRONMENT
Fish numbers are affected by the weather, time of day, nearby noise, and more. Fish can also deplete from an area if overfished.
You can also make Chum to attract more fish. Create a Chum Base by right-clicking on sand on the ground. Then add bait to the Chum by right-clicking on it in your inventory. Right-click on a body of water and select the option to throw it in.

SurvivalGuide_entrie1moreinfo.EN:
MOVEMENT
To scamper around in Project Zomboid, use the WASD keys.

COMBAT
To attack, first hold RMB or to aim, then press LMB to attack. Without a weapon equipped, you can only shove (you can also press to shove, even with a weapon equipped).
The point you're aiming at will always be towards the isometric cursor, the white circle on the ground near your mouse cursor. See pages 3 and 4 of this guide for more in-depth information on combat.

MOODLES
The little icons that sometimes appear at the upper right of the screen are called moodles. These give an overview of your survivor's condition at a glance. Hover over each icon for more details.

MOUSE CONTROLS
You can interact with nearby objects with a click of LMB. This will, for example, open doors or fling open cupboards you'd like to loot.
Holding RMB lets you look around and aim. Scrolling the mouse wheel, or using the and keys, will zoom in and out.

HEALTH
Click the heart icon at the top left to see your health. From here you can apply first aid - or check for a dreaded bite mark.

INTERACT KEY
Another way to interact is by pressing . This will let you open doors while remaining in an attack stance.
PRESS by a window to open or close it, and HOLD to climb through if it's already open (or smashed). TAPPING while trying to open a window will smash it - useful in an emergency, but be careful of broken glass.

CLIMBING
Press to climb over fences. You will also auto-climb over small fences by Jogging or Sprinting towards them (see page 2 of this guide for more information).

CONTEXT MENU
More detailed interaction, such as crafting, can be accessed with the RMB context menu.

TIME
Time usually flies in Project Zomboid, but if not (and in single-player), the controls at the top right will help. You can use the controls to fast-forward at various speeds if you're standing still or performing an action (like reading or building). You can also use the controls to pause and have a rethink after another disastrous loot run.

MAP
Press or click the map icon at the top left to open your map. As you move around the world, your map will fill in with more detail. You may also have a minimap at the bottom right. Hold to access map-related options, like turning on or off your minimap.

DON'T DIE
Try not to die at all times.
SurvivalGuide_entrie1moreinfo.CN:
移 动
在 僵 尸 毁 灭 工 程 中 , 使 用 WASD 键 来 移 动 .

战 斗
在 攻 击 时 , 先 按 住 鼠 标 右 键 或 来 瞄 准 , 然 后 按 鼠 标 左 键 进 行 攻 击 . 在 没 有 装 备 武 器 时 , 只 能 进 行 推 搡 ( 在 装 备 武 器 时 , 也 可 以 按 下 来 推 搡 ).
你 的 瞄 准 点 始 终 朝 向 " 等 轴 测 投 影 " 视 图 中 的 光 标 位 置 , 即 鼠 标 光 标 附 近 地 面 上 的 白 色 圆 圈 . 有 关 战 斗 的 更 多 详 细 信 息 , 请 参 阅 本 指 南 的 第 3 页 和 第 4 页 .

状 态 栏 位
屏 幕 右 上 角 有 时 会 出 现 一 些 小 图 标 , 这 些 图 标 被 称 为 状 态 栏 位 (Moodle). 它 们 可 以 一 目 了 然 地 展 示 你 的 幸 存 者 状 况 . 你 可 以 提 供 将 鼠 标 悬 停 在 每 个 图 标 上 的 方 式 查 看 更 多 详 细 信 息 .

鼠 标 控 制
可 以 通 过 点 击 鼠 标 左 键 的 方 式 与 附 近 的 物 体 互 动 . 例 如 , 这 可 以 打 开 你 想 要 搜 刮 的 门 或 橱 柜 .
按 住 鼠 标 右 键 可 以 环 视 并 瞄 准 . 滚 动 鼠 标 滚 轮 , 或 使 用 和 键 , 可 以 放 大 或 缩 小 .

健 康 值
可 以 通 过 点 击 右 上 方 的 心 形 图 标 的 方 式 , 来 观 察 你 自 己 的 生 命 值 高 低 . 你 还 可 以 在 这 里 实 施 急 救 , 或 者 看 看 自 己 有 没 有 被 咬 到 !

互 动 键
你 还 可 以 通 过 按 下 键 的 方 式 进 行 互 动 . 这 可 以 让 你 在 保 持 战 斗 模 式 的 前 提 下 开 门 .
按 下 键 可 以 打 开 或 关 闭 窗 户 , 长 按 键 则 可 以 翻 过 打 开 或 已 经 被 打 碎 的 窗 户 . 在 尝 试 打 开 窗 户 时 , 按 下 会 将 其 打 碎 , 这 在 逃 命 时 很 有 用 , 但 要 小 心 碎 玻 璃 .

攀 爬
按 下 可 以 爬 过 栅 栏 . 在 小 跑 或 冲 刺 时 会 自 动 翻 越 栅 栏 ( 参 见 本 教 程 的 第 2 页 ).

上 下 文 菜 单
更 精 细 的 互 动 , 例 如 制 作 , 可 以 通 过 按 下 右 键 打 开 菜 单 的 方 式 进 入 .

时 间
在 僵 尸 毁 灭 工 程 中 , 时 间 通 常 过 得 飞 快 , 但 如 果 时 间 过 得 还 不 够 快 ( 特 别 是 在 单 人 游 戏 中 ), 右 上 角 的 控 件 可 以 让 时 间 过 得 更 快 一 些 . 你 可 以 在 静 止 不 动 或 执 行 操 作 ( 例 如 阅 读 或 建 造 ) 时 使 用 它 们 以 不 同 的 速 度 快 进 . 在 一 次 亡 命 之 旅 后 , 还 可 以 使 用 这 些 控 件 暂 停 游 戏 , 然 后 好 好 反 思 一 下 .

地 图
按 下 或 点 击 左 上 方 的 地 图 图 标 可 以 打 开 地 图 . 在 世 界 中 移 动 时 , 地 图 会 慢 慢 填 充 更 多 细 节 . 右 下 方 还 有 一 份 小 地 图 . 你 可 以 按 下 以 便 查 看 更 多 与 地 图 相 关 的 选 项 , 例 如 开 关 小 地 图 .

DON'T DIE
无 论 何 时 , 千 万 别 死 .

SurvivalGuide_entrie2moreinfo.EN:
ZOMBIE SENSES
Zombies respond to sight and sound. Be extremely wary of loud noises like sirens, alarms, and gunfire as the horde is sure to arrive to investigate.

RUNNING
Use to Jog, and to Sprint. Running generates sound and makes you more noticeable. You can outrun the deadheads for a while, but not forever.

CROUCH
Survivors can crouch by using to reduce their visibility, and crouch beside walls and fences to reduce their visibility further (notice your character crouching down lower when in cover). You can also Jog while in this state.
Project Zomboid is not a popularity contest. Zombies don't follow you to get your autograph - they only want to bite you. Also they do not hug.

奔 跑

SurvivalGuide_entrie3moreinfo.EN:
BASICS
Each melee weapon is capable of dealing a set amount of damage. However, its power and precision is determined by your skills (or lack of them), and your Moodles. You won't squash many heads when you're exhausted, for example.
Hold RMB or to enter aim mode, and press LMB to attack. (To turn on or off aim outlines for melee weapons, use the Aim Outline setting on the User Interface tab of the Options screen.)
Stabby weapons like knives will sometimes be able to "jaw stab" zombies to kill them in one hit. Don't expect much from the butter knife though.

GROUND ATTACKS
Zombies aren't dead just because they're knocked down. You need to get all bashy with their brains!
Zombies can be knocked over by attacks or shoves. In the absence of other attacking zombies, your attacks will be aimed towards downed zombies within your weapon's range.

You can also press when right beside a downed zombie to "stomp" them. This is weaker than attacking with a weapon but means your weapon won't lose condition, or you don't waste ammo. Remember to use the isometric cursor to aim for the head. Stomping zombie's legs will never kill them, and just looks silly.

BREAKING WEAPONS
It's a sad fact that many of the melee weapons you find in the world will just not be very good. They will do little damage, break easily, and you'll throw them away. However, some will actually be useful, and you'll want to keep them in good condition. Each hit will damage a weapon. You can repair it using the Crafting menu. If a weapon breaks entirely, you may end up with broken parts that have to be reattached. Some broken parts can even be equipped as weapons themselves!
SurvivalGuide_entrie3moreinfo.CN:
基 础 知 识
每 把 近 战 武 器 都 能 造 成 一 定 的 伤 害 . 但 是 , 它 的 威 力 和 精 度 取 决 于 你 的 技 能 和 你 对 武 器 的 熟 悉 程 度 .
按 住 右 键 或 以 进 入 瞄 准 模 式 , 然 后 按 左 键 攻 击 . ( 要 开 关 近 战 武 器 的 瞄 准 轮 廓 , 请 使 用 " 选 项 " 屏 幕 的 " 用 户 界 面 " 选 项 卡 上 的 " 瞄 准 轮 廓 " 设 置 . )
像 刀 子 这 样 的 戳 刺 武 器 有 时 能 " 处 决 " 僵 尸 , 一 击 毙 命 . 不 过 , 黄 油 刀 的 作 用 就 别 太 期 待 了 .

地 面 攻 击
僵 尸 不 会 因 为 被 击 倒 而 死 , 你 得 狠 狠 打 击 它 们 的 脑 子 !
僵 尸 可 以 通 过 攻 击 或 推 搡 被 击 倒 . 在 没 有 其 他 僵 尸 攻 击 的 情 况 下 , 你 的 攻 击 将 瞄 准 你 武 器 射 程 内 的 倒 地 僵 尸 .

你 也 可 以 在 倒 地 僵 尸 旁 边 按 下 来 踩 它 们 . 这 比 用 武 器 攻 击 要 弱 , 但 是 不 会 让 武 器 减 少 耐 久 , 也 不 会 浪 费 弹 药 . 记 住 使 用 光 标 瞄 准 僵 尸 的 头 部 . 踩 僵 尸 的 腿 永 远 不 会 杀 死 它 们 , 而 且 看 起 来 很 滑 稽 .

武 器 损 坏
很 遗 憾 , 你 找 到 的 大 多 数 武 器 都 不 是 全 新 的 . 它 们 只 能 造 成 不 多 的 伤 害 , 很 容 易 就 会 损 坏 . 损 坏 之 后 , 就 不 得 不 把 它 们 丢 掉 . 不 过 , 有 一 部 分 武 器 相 当 强 , 需 要 好 好 保 养 . 每 一 次 攻 击 , 都 有 可 能 降 低 武 器 的 耐 久 . 你 可 以 在 制 作 菜 单 中 修 复 它 们 . 如 果 武 器 完 全 损 坏 了 , 你 就 会 得 到 几 个 需 要 重 新 组 合 的 部 件 . 有 一 些 部 件 自 己 就 能 当 作 武 器 使 用 !

SurvivalGuide_entrie4moreinfo.EN:
SHOOT 'EM UP
Guns are noisy but, in the right hands, they are powerful. Remember: stand your ground, shoot slow, and stay calm.
With a gun equipped, hold RMB or to enter aim mode. Your cursor will show where your character is aiming. Press LMB to fire. The bigger the cursor, the less accurate your shot will be. Your chance of hitting anything is not only influenced by your Skills and Moodles, but also light levels, the weather, and more. A tired, panicked survivor with terrible aiming skills isn't going to hit many zombies on a foggy day - or a sunny one for that matter. Reload guns using unboxed ammo in your inventory with , and clear a jam with . Low condition weapons are much more likely to jam.

TOP TIPS
1. It takes time to shoulder and aim your weapon. Firing too quickly will make you miss.
2. Make sure you're ready for a fight before you fire. Guns are extremely noisy and WILL attract many zombies, so make sure you have a Plan B.
3. You can shoot from a car. However, your aim will be extremely poor in a moving vehicle, or at angles other than directly to the side.
4. A weapon's sight or scope is only effective within a certain range. In certain situations (eg. using a scoped rifle on a close target), you will automatically ignore the scope and aim down the barrel.
SurvivalGuide_entrie4moreinfo.CN:
射 击
开 火 很 吵 , 但 在 善 用 的 情 况 下 也 很 强 大 . 记 住 , 站 稳 , 冷 静 下 来 , 然 后 慢 慢 开 火 .
装 备 枪 支 后 , 按 住 鼠 标 右 键 或 进 入 瞄 准 模 式 . 光 标 会 显 示 角 色 瞄 准 的 位 置 . 按 鼠 标 左 键 射 击 . 光 标 越 大 , 射 击 精 度 越 低 . 射 击 成 功 率 不 仅 受 技 能 和 情 绪 影 响 , 还 受 光 照 水 平 , 天 气 等 因 素 影 响 … 一 个 疲 惫 不 堪 , 惊 慌 失 措 , 瞄 准 技 术 糟 糕 的 幸 存 者 在 雾 天 ( 阳 光 明 媚 的 日 子 也 一 样 ) 是 不 太 可 能 打 中 僵 尸 的 . 使 用 重 新 装 填 枪 支 ( 物 品 栏 中 需 要 有 已 打 开 的 子 弹 ), 使 用 清 除 武 器 卡 壳 . 状 态 不 佳 的 武 器 更 容 易 卡 壳 .

实 用 技 巧
1. 拿 起 武 器 和 瞄 准 都 需 要 时 间 , 急 着 开 火 会 让 命 中 率 下 降 .
2. 开 火 前 , 确 保 自 己 已 经 准 备 好 应 对 接 下 来 的 大 战 . 开 火 的 声 音 很 大 , 会 吸 引 很 多 僵 尸 , 因 此 一 定 要 准 备 一 个 应 急 方 案 .
3. 你 可 以 在 车 里 射 击 . 但 是 , 在 行 驶 的 车 辆 中 , 或 者 从 侧 面 以 外 的 角 度 射 击 时 , 瞄 准 精 度 会 非 常 差 .
4. 武 器 的 瞄 准 镜 仅 在 特 定 范 围 内 有 效 . 在 某 些 情 况 下 ( 例 如 , 使 用 带 瞄 准 镜 的 步 枪 瞄 准 近 距 离 目 标 ), 你 会 自 动 忽 略 瞄 准 镜 直 接 瞄 准 .

SurvivalGuide_entrie5moreinfo.EN:
WATER
The world's water supply, like the electricity, will not last forever. Stockpile water bottles if you don't want to check out later down the line.
Your character will automatically drink water from any container in your inventory.
To drink or to fill a bottle, just use the right-click menu on any in-game tile/item that provides water. Sinks, baths, faucets. all that jazz.
You can also get water by leaving open containers like saucepans outside in the rain, by collecting it from a river, or by building a wooden water container.
Water that is not from a plumbed source like a faucet will be tainted and must be boiled for safe drinking. However, tainted water can be safely used to water crops or wash your clothes.

SurvivalGuide_entrie6moreinfo.EN:
CRAFTING INVENTORY ITEMS
To craft items in your inventory, click the Crafting icon at the top left. Any craftable items will magically be shown! A range of cooking, carpentry, medical, and survival recipes will give you the edge in the apocalypse.
To access a wider range of crafting recipes, click the button while standing beside a hard surface like a table.

BARRICADING
You can barricade doors and windows by right-clicking. You'll need a hammer, planks and nails in your inventory to barricade with planks, or a propane torch, welding mask, and a metal sheet to barricade with metal.

BUILDING WORLD OBJECTS
As you find resources and become more competent, you can eventually construct furniture and even entire buildings. Click on the Build icon to get the build menu. From here, you can select any piece of furniture that your skills and materials can produce.
Once selected, a transparent representation of the final product will appear, which you can move around and place with LMB.
The process isn't a rapid one, and walls have to be built in multiple stages. PZ is a realism-devoted game, and if you've ever had builders in you'll know these things take time. (Please note we do let you craft cups of tea in-game, if it helps). You can rotate crafted items before placement by pressing .
REMEMBER: the more you craft, the better you you'll become. Higher skill levels means better quality items, and more useful ones too.

PICKING UP WORLD OBJECTS
Most furniture and static objects in the world can be picked up. Simply hover your cursor on the wooden locker icon at the top left of the screen and click one of the icons that appear to pick up a world item, place an item already in your inventory, rotate an object in place, or disassemble it. While in any of these modes, press Tab to switch to the next one.
Picking up and disassembling objects may require tools or a minimum skill level to be successful. Moving objects can be a helpful way to move useful items like fridges or crates to a new location, or just for decoration.
SurvivalGuide_entrie6moreinfo.CN:
物 品 制 作
要 加 工 物 品 栏 的 物 品 , 只 需 点 击 右 上 方 的 " 制 作 " 图 标 , 打 开 制 作 菜 单 即 可 .
任 何 可 制 作 的 物 品 都 会 神 奇 地 展 示 出 来 !
烹 饪 , 木 工 , 医 疗 和 生 存 等 一 系 列 技 巧 将 让 你 在 世 界 末 日 中 占 据 优 势 .

加 固
你 可 以 通 过 右 键 单 击 来 加 固 门 窗 . 你 需 要 用 物 品 栏 中 的 锤 子 , 木 板 和 钉 子 来 固 定 木 板 , 或 者 使 用 丙 烷 喷 灯 , 焊 接 面 罩 来 焊 接 金 属 板 .

建 造 结 构
当 你 找 到 资 源 并 变 得 更 有 能 力 时 , 便 可 以 建 造 建 筑 . 你 可 以 点 击 " 建 造 " 图 标 来 打 开 建 造 菜 单 . 从 这 里 你 可 以 看 到 所 能 建 筑 的 家 具 .
选 择 后 , 你 将 看 到 建 筑 的 透 明 版 , 然 后 你 可 以 在 世 界 各 地 移 动 , 点 击 鼠 标 左 键 放 置 .
这 个 过 程 并 不 快 , 因 为 罗 马 不 是 一 天 建 成 的 . 僵 尸 毁 灭 工 程 是 一 款 以 现 实 主 义 为 核 心 的 游 戏 . 如 果 你 有 过 建 筑 知 识 , 你 就 会 知 道 建 筑 需 要 时 间 . ( 如 果 你 想 的 话 , 你 可 以 在 游 戏 里 倒 杯 茶 放 松 一 下 . ) 你 可 以 在 放 置 前 摁 住 并 拖 动 来 旋 转 所 要 放 置 的 结 构 .
记 住 : 制 作 得 越 多 , 你 就 会 变 得 越 强 . 更 高 的 技 能 水 平 意 味 着 更 好 的 质 量 , 以 及 更 有 用 的 物 品 .

" 捡 " 起 物 品
世 界 上 大 多 数 家 具 和 静 态 物 品 都 可 以 拾 取 . 只 需 将 光 标 悬 停 在 屏 幕 左 上 角 的 木 质 储 物 柜 图 标 上 , 然 后 点 击 出 现 的 图 标 之 一 , 即 可 拾 取 物 品 , 放 置 物 品 栏 中 的 物 品 , 旋 转 物 品 或 拆 卸 物 品 . 在 任 何 模 式 下 , 按 Tab 键 即 可 切 换 到 下 一 个 模 式 .
拾 取 和 拆 卸 物 品 可 能 需 要 工 具 或 一 定 程 度 的 技 能 才 能 成 功 . 移 动 物 品 可 以 将 冰 箱 或 板 条 箱 等 有 用 物 品 移 到 新 位 置 , 或 者 用 来 装 饰 .

SurvivalGuide_entrie7moreinfo.EN:
BLOCK OFF THEIR VIEW
One of the most common mistakes in the zombie apocalypse is to leave the curtains open. Forgetting drapes-closure invites wandering zombies down your garden path, and straight to your brain-stem.
To close curtains or blinds: use the right click menu.
Barricading windows also stops zombies viewing light and movement.
If there are no curtains, and you haven't got planks to spare, perhaps you can hang something up instead? Go on, give it a try.

SurvivalGuide_entrie8moreinfo.EN:
COOKING
Meat, fish, and many other foods require cooking before eating. As well as reducing the risk of food poisoning, prepared meals are more satisfying, nutritious and will stave off hunger for longer.
To cook up your food, simply place it in a cooker or microwave - or perhaps a campfire if you've fled town.
Turn appliances on with the right-click menu, then retrieve your baked goods from its loot window once it's cooked. Turn off the appliance when you're done though, unless you want to cook your whole house too. Antique stoves, fireplaces, and campfires require fuel, so remember to stock up on wood to burn (or books, if you're illiterate).

FARMING
To grow your own food, simply find a trowel and some seeds. Plough the soil and scatter, and soon you'll be fed and watered by your own survivalist hand.

FORAGING
Can't find anything to eat? Try foraging from nature by clicking on the magnifying glass icon at the top left of the screen, and clicking "Enable Search Mode". See page 12 of this guide to learn more.
SurvivalGuide_entrie8moreinfo.CN:
烹 饪
肉 类 , 鱼 类 和 许 多 生 食 需 要 在 进 食 前 烹 饪 . 除 了 能 降 低 食 物 中 毒 的 风 险 外 , 准 备 好 的 饭 菜 更 令 人 满 意 , 更 有 营 养 , 并 且 可 以 更 长 时 间 地 避 免 饥 饿 .
要 烹 饪 食 物 , 只 需 将 其 放 入 电 炉 或 微 波 炉 中 - 如 果 你 逃 离 了 城 镇 , 那 么 也 可 以 放 在 营 火 中 .
用 右 键 菜 单 打 开 电 器 , 烤 好 后 从 物 品 窗 口 中 取 出 烘 焙 食 品 . 完 成 后 记 得 关 闭 电 器 , 除 非 你 想 把 整 个 房 子 都 做 成 饭 ! 古 董 炉 灶 , 壁 炉 和 营 火 需 要 燃 料 , 所 以 记 得 储 备 木 头 ( 或 者 书 籍 , 如 果 你 不 识 字 的 话 ).

种 植
想 要 自 己 种 植 食 物 , 只 需 一 把 铲 子 和 一 些 种 子 . 犁 地 , 撒 种 , 很 快 你 就 能 用 自 己 的 双 手 获 得 食 物 和 水 .

搜 寻
