SurvivalGuide_entrie9moreinfo.EN:
SELECTING
So how do you rummage, grab, drop and use in Project Zomboid? The primary way is to drag and drop, or alternatively right click to bring up the context menu.
Holding LSHIFT will allow you select multiple items.
Or, why not go CRAZY and drag a square over multiple items with your mouse?

Double-click something in the loot inventory for a quick grab, or click the quick context button on the right of your selection.
There's also 'Loot All' if you're so excited that you have to grab EVERYTHING in a container.

THE GLORY OF BAGS
Bags are important. They help you carry stuff.
To equip one and hurriedly throw your items in: right click and attach it to your primary hand, secondary hand or (with some bags) on your back.
You'll then see the equipped bag in your inventory, all ready for you to drag and drop your loot into. Vitally, bags will grant you a weight reduction so you can carry more, but be careful: if you put a lot of stuff in your bag, it'll still slow down your movement.

BELTS AND HOTKEYS
You can equip certain items to your belt, holster, or back. These items will show in the squares at the bottom of the screen, and can be equipped with the hotkey corresponding to the number shown. Other useful hotkeys include:
: Equips (and turns on) your best light source. Pressing with a light source equipped will switch it on or off, and pressing for longer will let you access other options like removing a battery.
: Reloads an equipped firearm. Press for longer for more advanced options. Press to clear jams/rack your weapon.
: Toggles advanced vehicle options, if in or beside a vehicle.
: Shout. Attracts zombies. Will be quieter if crouching. Hold for longer to access the emote wheel. Wave hello a friend, or give your favorite zombie a thumbs up!
: Toggles foraging's search mode.
SurvivalGuide_entrie9moreinfo.CN:
选 择
如 何 在 僵 毁 里 翻 找 , 拿 取 , 放 置 和 使 用 ? 主 要 的 方 法 是 拖 动 , 或 者 右 键 单 击 以 调 出 菜 单 .
按 住 左 SHIFT 键 就 可 以 选 中 多 个 物 品 .
或 者 , 也 可 以 用 鼠 标 来 框 出 需 要 选 择 的 物 品 .

双 击 储 存 空 间 的 物 品 栏 中 的 某 样 东 西 即 可 快 速 拿 取 , 或 者 , 你 也 可 以 单 击 所 选 内 容 右 侧 的 快 速 上 下 文 按 钮 .
如 果 想 拿 取 容 器 中 的 所 有 东 西 , 那 么 还 有 全 部 拿 取 的 选 项 .

背 包 之 荣 耀
背 包 很 重 要 , 有 助 于 搬 运 物 品 .
想 装 备 背 包 并 快 速 放 入 物 品 ? 只 需 右 键 单 击 并 将 其 放 置 在 主 手 , 副 手 或 ( 只 对 于 某 些 背 包 可 用 ) 背 上 .
然 后 , 你 会 在 物 品 栏 里 看 到 已 装 备 的 背 包 , 你 可 以 将 战 利 品 拖 放 进 去 . 背 包 可 以 减 轻 你 的 负 重 , 让 你 可 以 携 带 更 多 物 品 , 但 要 注 意 : 如 果 背 包 里 装 了 很 多 东 西 , 那 么 移 动 速 度 仍 然 会 变 慢 .

皮 带 和 快 捷 键
可 以 将 某 些 物 品 装 备 到 腰 带 , 枪 套 或 背 部 . 这 些 物 品 将 显 示 在 屏 幕 底 部 的 方 框 中 , 并 可 以 使 用 与 显 示 的 数 字 对 应 的 快 捷 键 进 行 装 备 . 其 他 常 用 的 快 捷 键 包 括 :
: 装 备 并 打 开 最 好 的 光 源 . 在 装 备 光 源 时 按 下 可 以 将 其 打 开 或 关 闭 , 长 按 则 可 以 进 行 移 除 电 池 之 类 的 操 作 .
: 重 新 装 填 已 装 备 的 枪 支 . 长 按 可 以 进 入 更 多 选 项 . 按 下 可 以 清 除 卡 壳 或 者 架 起 武 器 .
: 如 果 在 车 辆 内 或 旁 边 , 则 切 换 出 高 级 车 辆 选 项 .
: 大 喊 , 吸 引 僵 尸 . 在 蹲 下 时 发 出 的 声 音 会 更 小 一 些 . 长 按 可 以 打 开 表 情 菜 单 . 你 可 以 在 这 里 向 朋 友 问 个 好 , 或 者 给 最 喜 欢 的 僵 尸 点 赞 !
: 切 换 搜 寻 模 式 .

UI_CharacterCreation.EN: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is the Character Creation screen. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> <LEFT> A survivor's positive and negative attributes must be balanced. UI_CraftingUI.EN: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is the Crafting Panel. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> <LEFT> All recipes available to you are shown here in tabs that correspond to various Skills. <LINE> <LINE> Items are crafted from the loot carried in the inventory, and also automatically taken from anything at your feet or any containers that are within arm's reach. <LINE> <LINE> Many recipes, particularly in Cooking, require multiple items. To make a sandwich, for example, take bread slices then add any of range of different foodstuffs. <LINE> <LINE> More complex crafting recipes are often locked to certain Professions. However, these can be also be learned from Skill Magazines if you are of a high enough level. <LINE> <LINE> Crafting recipes can be quickly searched using the name filter, or added to your own personal favorite list.

UI_HealthPanel.EN: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is the Health Panel. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> <LEFT> This screen shows injuries and the overall state of your body. <LINE> <LINE> To treat an injury: ensure you are carrying a relevant item (for example, a bandage) and right click on the wound before applying the dressing. (The bandage itself can also be selected and used.) <LINE> <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Common Injuries <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> Scratch/Burn: Apply bandage and wait. Wound infection can be avoided by dousing it in alcohol or disinfectant. <LINE> <LINE> Deep Wound: Stitch with suture needle, using a suture needle holder for best results. Apply bandage. <LINE> <LINE> Embedded Glass Shard: Remove shards with tweezers or a suture needle holder. Apply bandage. <LINE> <LINE> Bleeding: Apply bandage. Change bandage regularly to prevent it getting dirty, and your wound becoming infected. <LINE> <LINE> Fracture: Create a splint using a ripped sheet and a piece of wood (eg. a branch). Apply splint. Wait a long period before recovery. <LINE> <LINE> Infected Wound: Douse bandage in disinfectant or alcohol. Apply bandage. Take antibiotics to fight infection. <LINE> <LINE> Lodged Bullet: Remove bullet with tweezers or a suture needle holder. Stitch then bandage. Remember to disinfect dressing with alcohol or disinfectant. <LINE> <LINE> Bite: Apply bandage and pray.
UI_HealthPanel.CN: <CENTRE><SIZE:medium> 这 是 你 的 健 康 面 板 .<LINE><LINE><SIZE:small><LEFT> 这 里 显 示 了 你 的 身 体 整 体 健 康 状 态 .<LINE><LINE> 如 果 你 受 伤 了 , 你 则 需 要 立 即 处 理 , 例 如 流 血 需 要 绑 带 包 扎 , 怎 么 包 扎 呢 ? 只 要 确 保 你 拥 有 需 要 的 物 品 , 在 健 康 面 板 上 点 击 鼠 标 右 键 即 可 显 示 出 交 互 菜 单 <LINE><LINE><CENTRE><SIZE:medium> 常 见 的 创 伤 <LINE><LINE><SIZE:small> 划 伤 / 烧 伤 : 用 绷 带 包 扎 即 可 . 伤 口 可 以 用 酒 精 消 毒 以 避 免 感 染 .<LINE><LINE> 深 伤 口 : 需 要 用 缝 合 针 先 缝 合 伤 口 , 然 后 用 绷 带 包 扎 即 可 . 如 果 你 有 夹 钳 的 话 , 那 处 理 起 来 效 果 会 更 好 .<LINE><LINE> 玻 璃 扎 伤 : 需 要 用 镊 子 取 出 玻 璃 碎 片 , 然 后 用 缝 合 针 缝 合 伤 口 , 最 后 用 绷 带 包 扎 .<LINE><LINE> 流 血 : 需 要 用 绷 带 包 扎 伤 口 . 并 且 注 意 绷 带 的 情 况 , 如 果 脏 了 就 需 要 立 即 更 换 , 以 防 止 伤 口 感 染 .<LINE><LINE> 骨 折 : 需 要 准 备 一 个 夹 板 来 固 定 骨 折 部 位 ( 使 用 一 根 绳 子 和 木 板 就 可 以 制 作 ). 之 后 等 待 恢 复 即 可 , 可 能 需 要 较 长 的 时 间 才 能 恢 复 .<LINE><LINE> 伤 口 感 染 : 需 要 使 用 已 经 消 毒 的 绷 带 来 包 扎 伤 口 , 并 服 用 抗 生 素 以 确 保 情 况 不 会 恶 化 .<LINE><LINE> 枪 伤 : 需 要 先 用 夹 钳 取 出 子 弹 , 然 后 用 缝 合 针 缝 合 伤 口 并 使 用 绷 带 包 扎 , 记 得 用 酒 精 或 是 消 毒 剂 消 毒 .<LINE><LINE> 咬 伤 : 用 绷 带 包 扎 伤 口 , 之 后 祈 祷 你 不 会 变 成 僵 尸 吧 .

UI_Intro2.EN: THERE WAS NO HOPE OF SURVIVAL
UI_Intro2.CN: 没有任何帮助和生存的希望

UI_InventoryInfo.EN: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is the Inventory Panel. <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> Right click on loot items to show their uses - whether they can be eat, drunk, equipped or used in crafting recipes. <LINE> <LINE> You'll also find a list of the different bags and containers you carry here. Using these reduces your overall carry-weight. UI_ModsConflicts_ButtonMoveDown_tooltip.CN: 降低所选地图的优先级.

UI_ModsConflicts_ButtonMoveUp_tooltip.CN: 提高所选地图的优先级.

UI_ModsNagPanel_Text.EN:
Mods are created by members of the Project Zomboid community.
Mods created for earlier version of the game may not work with newer versions. This is especially true when playing the "Unstable" beta branch.
If you encounter bugs playing Project Zomboid, please try playing a game without using any mods before reporting issues on our forums.
UI_ModsNagPanel_Text.CN:
模 组 由 僵 尸 毁 灭 工 程 社 区 成 员 创 建 .
为 早 期 版 本 创 建 的 模 组 可 能 无 法 在 新 版 本 中 使 用 , 尤 其 是 在 " 不 稳 定 " 测 试 分 支 中 .
如 果 您 在 玩 僵 尸 毁 灭 工 程 时 遇 到 错 误 , 请 先 尝 试 不 使 用 任 何 模 组 进 行 游 戏 , 然 后 再 在 我 们 的 论 坛 上 报 告 问 题 .

UI_NewGame_Apocalypse_desc.CN: 专注于潜行. 寿命短. 最好避免战斗.

UI_NewGame_Builder_desc.EN: Construction, Exploration and Farming focus. A more relaxed experience.
UI_NewGame_Builder_desc.CN: 以建设, 探索和种田为重点, 更轻松的体验.

UI_NewGame_ChallengesDisabled.EN: Some challenge maps have been temporarily disabled while we work on improving them.
UI_NewGame_ChallengesDisabled.CN: 一些挑战地图已临时禁用, 因为我们正在努力改进它们.

UI_NewGame_FirstWeek_desc.EN: Starting Date: 9th July 1993 <LINE> <LINE> How it Begins. <LINE> <LINE> Moderate horde and unlooted homes. Water and electricity available for a limited period.
UI_NewGame_FirstWeek_desc.CN: 开 始 时 间 : 1993 年 7 月 9 日 <LINE><LINE> 故 事 开 始 的 地 方 . <LINE><LINE> 中 等 僵 尸 数 量 , 将 在 一 段 时 间 后 停 水 停 电 .

UI_NewGame_InitialInfection_desc.EN: Starting Date: 9th July 1993 <LINE> <LINE> Training scenario for new Survivors. <LINE> <LINE> [NON-CANON] Small horde, recently infected zombies with reduced senses and limited migration.
UI_NewGame_InitialInfection_desc.CN: 开 始 时 间 : 1993 年 7 月 9 日 <LINE> <LINE> 新 幸 存 者 的 训 练 场 景 . <LINE> <LINE> [ 与 正 常 世 界 观 不 同 ] 小 群 新 近 被 感 染 的 僵 尸 , 感 官 减 弱 , 迁 移 能 力 有 限 .

UI_NewGame_Sandbox_desc.EN: Customize your very own zombie apocalypse! Die in just the way you want.
UI_NewGame_Sandbox_desc.CN: 自定义你的游戏内容! 死在你想要的方式上吧…

UI_NewGame_Sandbox_desc2.EN: Tailor design your own difficulty and play style.
UI_NewGame_Sandbox_desc2.CN: 量身设计你自己的难度和游戏风格.

UI_NewGame_SelectDifficulty.EN: Please select a difficulty level to continue.

UI_NewGame_SixMonths_desc.EN: Starting Date: 9th December 1993 <LINE> <LINE> How it Ends. <LINE> <LINE> Large horde, ransacked homes and an overgrown game world. Water and electricity shut off.
UI_NewGame_SixMonths_desc.CN: 开 始 时 间 : 1993 年 12 月 9 日 <LINE><LINE> 你 等 死 的 地 方 . <LINE><LINE> 大 量 僵 尸 , 洗 劫 一 空 的 房 屋 和 杂 草 丛 生 的 城 市 . 水 电 已 经 停 了 .

UI_NewGame_Survival_desc.EN: Starting Date: 9th July 1993 <LINE> <LINE> The Hardcore Experience. <LINE> <LINE> Huge horde, high stakes and death at every turn. How long can you survive?
UI_NewGame_Survival_desc.CN: 开 始 时 间 : 1993 年 7 月 9 日 <LINE><LINE> 真 真 正 正 的 硬 核 游 戏 模 式 . <LINE><LINE> 巨 量 僵 尸 , 风 险 无 处 不 在 , 死 亡 如 影 随 形 . 不 知 你 能 活 多 久 ?

UI_NewGame_Survivor_desc.EN: Powerful combat. Longer lifespan. A challenging playstyle.
UI_NewGame_Survivor_desc.CN: 强大的战斗力. 寿命更长. 具有挑战性的游戏风格.

UI_NewGame_Tutorial_desc.EN: The first place to go for all freshly-infected Project Zomboid survivors.
UI_NewGame_Tutorial_desc.CN: 如果你是第一次接触该游戏, 你现在应该先试一试教程…

UI_News_Anim.EN:
WELCOME TO THE BUILD 41 PUBLIC BETA!
This is a Work in Progress version of the biggest code update PZ has ever had. There will be bugs and balance issues. Optimization improvements are ongoing. Some features have been temporarily disabled. If you have issues: don't get mad, get involved. Let us know on our forums.

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Chopper.CN: 随机玩家触发直升机事件

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Connections.CN: 显示有关所有连接的信息

UI_ServerOptionDesc_CreateHorde.EN: Spawn a horde near a player. Use : /createhorde count "username". Example /createhorde 150 "rj" Username is optional except from the server console. With no username the horde will be created around you
UI_ServerOptionDesc_CreateHorde.CN: 在指定玩家附近生成僵尸, 命令: /createhorde 数量 /"用户名/",示例: /createhorde 150 /"rj/"

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Disconnect.EN: Kicks a client according to their connection number. Connection numbers can be seen through /connections. Use /disconnect index. Example /disconnect 2
UI_ServerOptionDesc_Disconnect.CN: 根据客户端的连接号码来踢出.可以通过 /connections 查看连接号码. 使用/disconnect 编号, 比如 /disconnect 2

UI_ServerOptionDesc_GodMod.EN: Make yourself invincible. Use: /godmode -value, ex /godmode -true (could be -false)
UI_ServerOptionDesc_GodMod.CN: 开关上帝模式, 命令/godmode /"用户名/". 示例: /godmode /"rj/" -true (也可以是-false)

UI_ServerOptionDesc_GodModPlayer.EN: Make a player invincible. Use: /godmodeplayer "username" -value, ex /godmodeplayer "rj" -true (could be -false)
UI_ServerOptionDesc_GodModPlayer.CN: 让玩家进入上帝模式. 使用: /godmodeplayer "用户名"-value, 示例: /godmodeplayer "rj" -true (could be -false)

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Gunshot.EN: Place a gunshot sound on a random player
UI_ServerOptionDesc_Gunshot.CN: 随机玩家触发枪声事件

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Invisible.EN: Make yourself invisible to zombies. Use: /invisible -value, ex /invisible -true (could be -false)
UI_ServerOptionDesc_Invisible.CN: 让自己对僵尸无敌. 命令: /invisible /"用户名/". 示例: /invisible /"rj/" -true (也可以是-false)

UI_ServerOptionDesc_InvisiblePlayer.EN: Make a player invisible to zombies. Use: /invisibleplayer "username" -value, ex /invisibleplayer "rj" -true (could be -false)
UI_ServerOptionDesc_InvisiblePlayer.CN: 让玩家对僵尸无敌. 命令: /invisibleplayer "username" -value, 示例: /invisibleplayer "rj" -true (could be -false)

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Kick.EN: Kick a user. Add a -r "reason" to specify a reason for the kick. Use: /kickuser "username" -r "reason"
UI_ServerOptionDesc_Kick.CN: 踢出指定玩家, 命令: /kickuser /"用户名/" -r /"踢出原因/"

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Lightning.EN: Use /lightning "username", username is optional except from the server console
UI_ServerOptionDesc_Lightning.CN: 使用 /lightning "username", 用户名是可选的, 服务器控制台除外

UI_ServerOptionDesc_NoClip.EN: Makes a player pass through walls and structures. Toggles with no value. Use: /noclip "username" -value. Example /noclip "rj" -true (could be -false)
UI_ServerOptionDesc_NoClip.CN: 开关穿墙模式, 命令: /noclip /"用户名/" -value, 示例: /noclip /"rj/" -true (也可以是-false)

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Quit.CN: 退出服务器(自动执行保存)

UI_ServerOptionDesc_ReloadLua.EN: Reload a Lua script on the server. Use /reloadlua "filename"
UI_ServerOptionDesc_ReloadLua.CN: 重载指定的 Lua 脚本, 命令: /reloadlua "文件名"

UI_ServerOptionDesc_ReloadOptions.EN: Reload server options (ServerOptions.ini) and send to clients
UI_ServerOptionDesc_ReloadOptions.CN: 重新加载服务器上的选项 (ServerOptions.ini) 并将它们同步至客户端

UI_ServerOptionDesc_RemoveItem.EN: Remove items from yourself. Removes all items of type if count set to 0. Use: /removeitem "module.item" count. Example: /removeitem Base.Axe 5
UI_ServerOptionDesc_RemoveItem.CN: 从你身上移除物品. 如果数量设置为 0, 则移除所有该类型的物品. 使用: /removeitem \"module.item\" 数量. 例如: /removeitem Base.Axe 5

UI_ServerOptionDesc_RemoveWhitelist.EN: Remove a user from the whitelist. Use: /removeuserfromwhitelist "username"
UI_ServerOptionDesc_RemoveWhitelist.CN: 将指定玩家从白名单移除, 命令: /removeuserfromwhitelist /"用户名/"

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Replay.EN: Record and play replay for moving player. Use /replay "playername" -record|-play|-stop filename. Example: /replay user1 -record stadion.bin
UI_ServerOptionDesc_Replay.CN: 记录玩家的移动并重播. 使用: /replay /"playername/" -record|-play|-stop filename. 例如: /replay user1 -record stadion.bin

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Roll.EN: If you have dice, you can roll a random number - up to 100. Use: /roll 6
UI_ServerOptionDesc_Roll.CN: 生成随机数, 命令: /roll 6 (数字可自定义, 最大100)

UI_ServerOptionDesc_SafeHouse.EN: Release a safehouse you own. Use /releasesafehouse
UI_ServerOptionDesc_SafeHouse.CN: 释放你拥有的安全屋, 命令: /releasesafehouse

UI_ServerOptionDesc_SendPulse.EN: Toggle sending server performance info to this client. Use /sendpulse
UI_ServerOptionDesc_SendPulse.CN: 开关向此客户端发送服务器性能信息, 命令: /sendpulse

UI_ServerOptionDesc_ServerMsg.EN: Broadcast a message to all connected players. Use: /servermsg "My Message"
UI_ServerOptionDesc_ServerMsg.CN: 发送广播消息, 命令: /servermsg 消息!

UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetAccessLevel.EN: Set access level of a player. Current levels: Admin, Moderator, Overseer, GM, Observer. Use /setaccesslevel "username" "accesslevel". Example /setaccesslevel "rj" "moderator"
UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetAccessLevel.CN: 设置权限等级, 可用等级: admin, moderator, overseer, gm, observer.命令: /setaccesslevel /"用户名/" /"权限等级/", 示例: /setaccesslevel /"rj/" /"moderator/"

UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetLogLevel.CN: 设置日志级别. 使用: /log %1 %2

UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetPassword.EN: Use this command to change password for a user. Use: /setpassword "username" "newpassword"
UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetPassword.CN: 使用此命令更改用户的密码. 使用: /setpassword \"用户名\" \"新密码\"

UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetStatisticsPeriod.EN: Set and clear server statistics. Use /stats none|file|console|all period. Example /stats file 10
UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetStatisticsPeriod.CN: 设置和清除服务器统计信息. 使用: /stats none|file|console|all period. 例如: /stats file 10

UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetTimeSpeed.EN: Set the time multiplier on the server. Use /setTimeSpeed period. Example /setTimeSpeed 10
UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetTimeSpeed.CN: 设置服务器上的时间倍数. 使用 /setTimeSpeed 周期. 例如 /setTimeSpeed 10

UI_ServerOptionDesc_ShowOptions.EN: Show the list of current server options and values.

UI_ServerOptionDesc_StartRain.EN: Starts raining on the server. Use /startrain "intensity", optional intensity is from 1 to 100
UI_ServerOptionDesc_StartRain.CN: 服务器开始下雨. 使用 /starttrain "intensity", 可选强度从 1 到 100

UI_ServerOptionDesc_StartStorm.EN: Starts a storm on the server. Use /startstorm "duration", optional duration is in game hours
UI_ServerOptionDesc_StartStorm.CN: 在服务器上开始风暴. 使用 /startstorm "duration", 可选的 duration 的单位为游戏内的小时

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Status.CN: 获取服务器状态. 命令: /status players|zombies|loadedCells|minUpdatePeriod|maxUpdatePeriod|avgUpdatePeriod|loadCellFromDisk|saveCellToDisk|loaderThreadTasks|recalcThreadTasks|saveTasks|serverMapToLoad|serverMapLoadedCells|serverMapLoaded2|countServerChunkThreadSaveNow|threadMain|threadServerLOS|threadLoaderThread|threadRecalcAllThread|threadSaveThread|threadPolyPathThread|threadWorldReuser|threadPlayerDownloadServer|threadMapCollisionThread|probeChunkChecksum|probeBullet|probeAnimationPlayerUpdate|probeServerMapPreupdate|probeServerMapPostupdate|probeIngameStateUpdate|totalMemory|freeMemory|connectionsCount|packetLength|countIncomePackets|getCountIncomeBytes|getMaxIncomeBytesPerSecond|getCountOutcomePackets|getCountOutcomeBytes|getMaxOutcomeBytesPerSecond

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Teleport.EN: Teleport to a player. Once teleported, wait for the map to appear. Use /teleport "playername" or /teleport "player1" "player2". Example /teleport "rj" or /teleport "rj" "toUser"
UI_ServerOptionDesc_Teleport.CN: 传送至指定玩家处. 传送后, 地图要过一段时间才会显示. 命令: /teleport /"用户名/" 或 /teleport /"玩家1/" /"玩家2/",示例: /teleport /"rj/" 或 /teleport /"rj/" /"要传送到的玩家名称/"

UI_ServerOptionDesc_TeleportPlayer.EN: Teleport a player to another player. Use /teleportplayer "player1" "player2". Example /teleportplayer "rj" "toUser"
UI_ServerOptionDesc_TeleportPlayer.CN: 将一个玩家传送至指定玩家处. 命令: /teleportplayer "player1" "player2". 示例: /teleportplayer "rj" "toUser"

UI_ServerOptionDesc_TeleportTo.EN: Teleport to coordinates. Use /teleportto x,y,z. Example /teleportto 10000,11000,0
UI_ServerOptionDesc_TeleportTo.CN: 传送至指定坐标, 命令: /teleportto x,y,z, 示例: /teleportto 10000,11000,0

UI_ServerOptionDesc_Thunder.EN: Use /thunder "username", username is optional except from the server console
UI_ServerOptionDesc_Thunder.CN: 使用 /thunder "username", 用户名是可选的, 除了来自服务器控制台

UI_ServerOptionDesc_UnBanSteamId.CN: 解封玩家 SteamID, 命令: /unbanid SteamID

UI_ServerOptionDesc_UnBanUser.CN: 解封玩家, 命令: /unbanuser /"用户名/"

UI_ServerOptionDesc_VoiceBan.EN: Block voice from user "username". Use /voiceban "username" -value. Example /voiceban "rj" -true (could be -false)
UI_ServerOptionDesc_VoiceBan.CN: 屏蔽玩家语音, 命令: /voiceban /"用户名/" -value, 示例: /voiceban /"rj/" -true (也可以是-false)

UI_ServerOption_AdminSafehouse_tooltip.CN: 只有管理员可以申请安全屋.

UI_ServerOption_AllowDestructionBySledge.EN: Allow players to destroy world objects with sledgehammers
UI_ServerOption_AllowDestructionBySledge.CN: 允许玩家使用大锤摧毁世界物体.

UI_ServerOption_AllowNonAsciiUsername_to.EN: Allow use of non-ASCII (cyrillic etc) characters in usernames
UI_ServerOption_AllowNonAsciiUsername_to.CN: 禁用/启用玩家昵称中使用非 Ascii (西里尔文等) 字符

UI_ServerOption_AnnounceDeath_tooltip.EN: If checked, every time a player dies a global message will be displayed in the chat
UI_ServerOption_AnnounceDeath_tooltip.CN: 如果选中, 每次玩家死亡时都会在聊天中显示一条全局消息

UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatChecksum_toolti.CN: 禁用校验和反作弊保护.

UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatFire_tooltip.CN: 禁用火检查反作弊保护.

UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatHit_tooltip.CN: 禁用角色命中反作弊保护.

UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatItem_tooltip.CN: 禁用物品检查反作弊保护.

UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatOwnership_toolt.CN: 禁用所有权反作弊保护.

UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatPacket_tooltip.CN: 禁用数据包检查反作弊保护.

UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatPermission_tool.CN: 禁用玩家权限反作弊保护.

UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatSafeHouse_toolt.CN: 禁用安全屋反作弊保护.

UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatSafety_tooltip.CN: 禁用安全系统反作弊保护.

UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatSpeed_tooltip.CN: 禁用角色速度反作弊保护.

UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatTime_tooltip.CN: 禁用游戏时间检查保护.

UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatXP_tooltip.CN: 禁用玩家经验值反作弊保护.

UI_ServerOption_AutoCreateUserInWhiteLis.EN: Add unknown usernames to the whitelist when players join. Clients will supply their own username/password on joining. (This is for Open=true servers)
UI_ServerOption_AutoCreateUserInWhiteLis.CN: 自动添加新玩家至白名单列表, 仅在 Open 项设置为 true 时生效.

UI_ServerOption_BadWordListFile_tooltip.EN: Path to the file with the list of words to be prohibited. Each word must be on a separate line
UI_ServerOption_BadWordListFile_tooltip.CN: 包含要禁用的词汇列表的黑名单文件的路径. 每个词必须单独占一行

UI_ServerOption_BadWordPolicy_tooltip.EN: What to do with the sender of a bad word in the chat: 1 - ban, 2 - kick, 3 - record the violation in the database, 4 - mute
UI_ServerOption_BadWordPolicy_tooltip.CN: 如何处理聊天中发送违禁词的人: 1 - 封禁, 2 - 踢出, 3 - 在数据库中记录违规行为, 4 - 禁言

UI_ServerOption_BadWordReplacement_toolt.EN: The symbol or piece of text that will replace the bad word
UI_ServerOption_BadWordReplacement_toolt.CN: 用来代替脏话的符号或文字

UI_ServerOption_BloodSplatLifespanDays_t.EN:
Number of days before old blood splats are removed.
Removal happens when map chunks are loaded.
Zero means they will never disappear
UI_ServerOption_BloodSplatLifespanDays_t.CN:
移除旧血迹之前的天数.
加载地图块时删除.
0 表示永远不会删除.

UI_ServerOption_CarEngineAttractionModif.EN: Modify the range of zombie attraction to cars. (Lower values can help with lag.)
UI_ServerOption_CarEngineAttractionModif.CN: 修改汽车吸引僵尸的范围, 较低的值可以帮助减少服务器延迟

UI_ServerOption_ClientActionLogs_tooltip.EN: Semicolon-separated list of actions that will be written to the ClientActionLogs.txt server log.
UI_ServerOption_ClientActionLogs_tooltip.CN: 分号分隔的行动列表, 将被写入ClientActionLogs.txt服务器日志.

UI_ServerOption_ClientCommandFilter_tool.EN: Semicolon-separated list of commands that will not be written to the cmd.txt server log. For example: \n-vehicle. Inputting * means do NOT write any vehicle command. Inputting: \n+vehicle.installPart means DO write that command
UI_ServerOption_ClientCommandFilter_tool.CN: 不会写入 cmd.txt 服务器日志的以分号分隔的命令列表. 例如: \n-vehicle. 输入 * 表示不写任何车辆命令. 而输入: \n+vehicle.installPart 则会将该命令加入写入的白名单

UI_ServerOption_ConstructionPreventsLoot.EN: Items will not respawn in buildings that players have barricaded or built in
UI_ServerOption_ConstructionPreventsLoot.CN: 物品是否可以刷新在玩家建立的容器中.

UI_ServerOption_DefaultPort_tooltip.EN: Default starting port for player data. If UDP, this is this one of two ports used.
UI_ServerOption_DefaultPort_tooltip.CN: 玩家数据的默认起始端口. 如果是 UDP, 这是使用的两个端口之一.

UI_ServerOption_DisableRadioAdmin_toolti.EN: Disables radio transmissions from players with 'admin' access level
UI_ServerOption_DisableRadioAdmin_toolti.CN: 禁用具有[admin]访问级别的玩家的无线电传输.

UI_ServerOption_DisableRadioGM_tooltip.EN: Disables radio transmissions from players with 'gm' access level
UI_ServerOption_DisableRadioGM_tooltip.CN: 禁用具有[GM]访问级别的玩家的无线电传输.

UI_ServerOption_DisableRadioInvisible_to.EN: Disables radio transmissions from invisible players
UI_ServerOption_DisableRadioInvisible_to.CN: 禁用隐形玩家的无线电传输.

UI_ServerOption_DisableRadioModerator_to.EN: Disables radio transmissions from players with 'moderator' access level
UI_ServerOption_DisableRadioModerator_to.CN: 禁用具有[moderator]访问级别的玩家的无线电传输.

UI_ServerOption_DisableRadioOverseer_too.EN: Disables radio transmissions from players with 'overseer' access level
UI_ServerOption_DisableRadioOverseer_too.CN: 禁用具有[overseer]访问级别的玩家的无线电传输.

UI_ServerOption_DisableRadioStaff_toolti.EN: Disables radio transmissions from players with an access level
UI_ServerOption_DisableRadioStaff_toolti.CN: 禁用具有任何访问级别的玩家的无线电传输.

UI_ServerOption_DisableSafehouseWhenPlay.EN: Safehouse acts like a normal house if a member of the safehouse is connected (so secure when players are offline)
UI_ServerOption_DisableSafehouseWhenPlay.CN: 会让安全屋表现得像一个普通的房子, 如果这个安全屋里的人有在线的话.

UI_ServerOption_DiscordChannelID_tooltip.EN: The Discord channel ID. (Use if having difficulties with Discord channel name option)
UI_ServerOption_DiscordChannelID_tooltip.CN: Discord 频道ID. (在使用 Discord 频道名称选项有困难时使用)

UI_ServerOption_DiscordChannel_tooltip.EN: The Discord channel name. (Try the separate channel ID option if having difficulties)
UI_ServerOption_DiscordChannel_tooltip.CN: Discord 频道名称. (如果遇到困难, 请尝试单独的频道 ID 选项)

UI_ServerOption_DiscordEnable_tooltip.EN: Enables global text chat integration with a Discord channel
UI_ServerOption_DiscordEnable_tooltip.CN: 启用全局文字聊天与 Discord 频道的整合

UI_ServerOption_DisplayUserName_tooltip.EN: Display usernames above player's heads in-game.
UI_ServerOption_DisplayUserName_tooltip.CN: 在玩家头顶显示玩家的 ID.

UI_ServerOption_DoLuaChecksum_tooltip.EN: Kick clients whose game files don't match the server's.
UI_ServerOption_DoLuaChecksum_tooltip.CN: 踢出和服务器文件不匹配的玩家.

UI_ServerOption_DropOffWhiteListAfterDea.EN: Remove player accounts from the whitelist after death. This prevents players creating a new character after death on Open=false servers
UI_ServerOption_DropOffWhiteListAfterDea.CN: 玩家死亡后自动从服务器的白名单中移除, 防止玩家在死亡后创建新的角色.

UI_ServerOption_FactionDaySurvivedToCrea.EN: Players must survive this number of in-game days before being allowed to create a faction
UI_ServerOption_FactionDaySurvivedToCrea.CN: 创建派系所需的特定生存天数.

UI_ServerOption_FactionPlayersRequiredFo.EN: Number of players required as faction members before the faction owner can create a group tag
UI_ServerOption_FactionPlayersRequiredFo.CN: 派系所有者创建团队标记需要派系中有多少玩家.

UI_ServerOption_Faction_tooltip.EN: Players can create factions when true

UI_ServerOption_FastForwardMultiplier_to.EN: Governs how fast time passes while players sleep. Value multiplies the speed of the time that passes during sleeping.
UI_ServerOption_FastForwardMultiplier_to.CN: 控制玩家睡眠时时间流逝的速度. 该数值将会让睡眠时时间流逝的速度翻倍.

UI_ServerOption_GlobalChat_tooltip.EN: Toggles global chat on or off.

UI_ServerOption_GoodWordListFile_tooltip.EN: Path to the file with the list of words that should be allowed, even if they contain bad word. Each word should be on a separate line.
UI_ServerOption_GoodWordListFile_tooltip.CN: 包含允许输入的词汇 (即使这些单词包含违禁词) 的白名单文件的路径. 每个词应占一行.

UI_ServerOption_HidePlayersBehindYou_too.EN: If true, automatically hide the player you can't see (like zombies).
UI_ServerOption_HidePlayersBehindYou_too.CN: 如果为启用, 自动隐藏你看不到的玩家 (类似于僵尸的情况).

UI_ServerOption_HoursForCorpseRemoval_to.EN: Remove corpses that are older than this set number of in-game hours
UI_ServerOption_HoursForCorpseRemoval_to.CN: 移除超过此设定的游戏内小时数的尸体

UI_ServerOption_HoursForLootRespawn_tool.EN: After X hours, all containers in the world will respawn loot. To spawn loot a container must have been looted at least once. Loot respawn is not impacted by visibility or subsequent looting.
UI_ServerOption_HoursForLootRespawn_tool.CN: 当一个容器第一次被拿取后, 它必须在其战利品被刷新前经过这个设定的小时数.<br>战利品的刷新不受可见度或后续拿取的影响.<br>在X小时之后, 战利品将一直刷新, 所有的容器将在同一时间刷新战利品.

UI_ServerOption_HoursForWorldItemRemoval.EN: Number of hours after an item is dropped on the ground before it is removed. Items are removed the next time a relevant part of the map is loaded. Zero here will mean that items are not removed
UI_ServerOption_HoursForWorldItemRemoval.CN: 物品掉落在地面多久将被移除, 单位为小时, 加载地图时将删除符合时间条件的物品, 0 表示不删除项目.

UI_ServerOption_ItemNumbersLimitPerConta.EN: Maximum number of items that can be placed in a container.  Zero means there is no limit. (PLEASE NOTE: This includes individual small items such as nails. A limit of 50 will mean only 50 nails can be stored.)
UI_ServerOption_ItemNumbersLimitPerConta.CN: 可以放入容器的最大物品数. 0 表示没有限制. (请注意: 这包括个别小物品, 如钉子. 一个 50 的限制将意味着只能储存 50 个钉子. )

UI_ServerOption_ItemRemovalListBlacklist.EN: If true, any items NOT in the WorldItemRemovalList will be removed
UI_ServerOption_ItemRemovalListBlacklist.CN: 如果为启用, 将删除不在世界物品移除清单 (WorldItemRemovalList) 中的所有物品.

UI_ServerOption_KickFastPlayers_tooltip.EN: Kick players that appear to be moving faster than is possible. May be buggy -- use with caution.
UI_ServerOption_KickFastPlayers_tooltip.CN: 速度自动检测机制. 自动踢出移动速度过快的玩家 (推荐关闭).

UI_ServerOption_MapRemotePlayerVisibilit.EN: Controls display of remote players on the in-game map.\n1=Hidden 2=Friends 3=Everyone
UI_ServerOption_MapRemotePlayerVisibilit.CN: 控制远处的玩家是否显示在地图上. \n1=隐藏 2=仅朋友 3=所有

UI_ServerOption_Map_tooltip.EN: Enter the foldername of the mod found in \Steam\steamapps\workshop\modID\mods\modName\media\maps\

UI_modselector_help2.EN: List of mods and filters On the left is a list of mods. You can filter them to only show enabled mods or your favorites, and search by name, ModID or WorkshopID. To enable a mod, click on its checkbox. To add a mod to your favorites, click on the star.

UI_modselector_help3.EN: Presets and sharing mod lists To create a mod selection preset, turn on the mods you want to add to the preset, and click SAVE under the list of mods. The DEL button will delete the preset. To share the preset you created, select a preset and click the SHARE button. After that, a line of text with the mods will be added to your clipboard. You can send the text to someone who can add the mods to their game with the ADD button.
UI_modselector_help3.CN: 预 设 和 分 享 模 组 列 表 要 创 建 模 组 选 择 预 设 , 打 开 你 想 要 添 加 到 预 设 的 模 组 , 点 击 模 组 列 表 下 的 SAVE. DEL 按 钮 将 删 除 预 设 . 要 分 享 你 创 建 的 预 设 , 选 择 一 个 预 设 并 点 击 SHARE 按 钮 . 之 后 , 将 添 加 一 行 包 含 模 组 的 文 本 到 你 的 剪 贴 板 . 你 可 以 将 文 本 发 送 给 其 他 人 , 他 们 可 以 使 用 ADD 按 钮 将 模 组 添 加 到 他 们 的 游 戏 中 .

UI_modselector_help4.EN: Mod description On the right side of the screen is a description of the selected mod, which includes screenshots of the mod and a description of its parameters. It may also include links to sites that will open in your browser, and links to dependencies for the mod to work, or incompatibilities between this mod and others.

UI_modselector_help5.EN: Mod order Using the Mod Order button, you can change the order in which mods are loaded. They can be ordered automatically, or moved using the mouse (by clicking on the move icon and dragging the mod) or a gamepad. Mods towards the top are loaded first. Changing the order of mods may help with errors.

UI_modselector_help6.EN: <H2> Map order <LINE> <TEXT> In the case of map conflicts, the Map Order button will be available. Maps higher on the order will be given priority, and loaded over maps lower down.

UI_optionscreen_heart_volume_tt.EN:
The two major sounds heard in the normal heart sound like "lub dub".
The "lub" is the first heart sound, commonly termed S1, and is caused by turbulence caused by the closure of mitral and tricuspid valves at the start of systole.
The second sound, "dub" or S2, is caused by the closure of aortic and pulmonic valves, marking the end of systole.
UI_optionscreen_heart_volume_tt.CN:
正常心音中听到的两个主要声音类似于"lub dub".
"lub"是第一个心音, 通常称为 S1, 是由收缩期开始时二尖瓣和三尖瓣关闭引起的湍流引起的.
第二个心音"dub"或 S2, 是由主动脉瓣和肺动脉瓣关闭引起的, 标志着收缩期的结束.

UI_trait_FastHealerDesc.EN: Recovers quickly from injuries and illness.
UI_trait_FastHealerDesc.CN: 从伤害和疾病中恢复得更快.

UI_trait_FastReaderDesc.EN: Takes less time to read books.

UI_trait_HemophobicDesc.EN:
Panic when performing first aid on self.
Cannot perform first aid on others.
Gets stressed when bloody.
UI_trait_HemophobicDesc.CN:
对自己实施急救时会恐慌.
无法对他人实施急救.
流血时会感到压力.

UI_trait_HerbalistDesc.EN: Can find medicinal herbs and craft medicines and poultices from them.
UI_trait_HerbalistDesc.CN: 可以找到草药, 识别有毒的植物, 制作药膏.

UI_trait_HighThirstDesc.CN: 需要更多的水才可生存.

UI_trait_IlliterateDesc.EN: Cannot read any books or in-world text.

UI_trait_InconspicuousDesc.EN: Less likely to be spotted by zombies.

UI_trait_InsomniacDesc.EN: Slow loss of tiredness while sleeping.
UI_trait_InsomniacDesc.CN: 减慢睡觉时疲劳的恢复.

UI_trait_InventiveDesc.EN: Has lower skill level requirements to research recipes from items or auto learn recipes.
UI_trait_InventiveDesc.CN: 通过物品研究配方或自动学习配方时所需技能等级更低.

UI_trait_IronGutDesc.EN: Less chance to have food illness.

UI_trait_LowThirstDesc.CN: 只需更少的水即可生存.

UI_trait_MasonDesc.EN: Better at building stone and brick constructions.
UI_trait_MasonDesc.CN: 擅长建造石质和砖制建筑结构.

UI_trait_Mechanics2Desc.EN: Familiar with the maintenance and repair of all vehicle models on the roads of Kentucky.
UI_trait_Mechanics2Desc.CN: 熟悉肯塔基州道路上所有车型的维护和维修.

UI_trait_MechanicsDesc.EN: Has knowledge of common and commercial vehicle models, and repairs.
UI_trait_MechanicsDesc.CN: 对普通和商用车的型号和维修有详细的了解.

UI_trait_MetalWorkerDesc.EN: Can weld foraged metal to create items and barricades.
UI_trait_MetalWorkerDesc.CN: 可以将收集的金属焊接成物品和障碍物.

UI_trait_MetalworkerDesc.CN: 可以焊接金属来制造物品.

UI_trait_NightVisionDesc.CN: 在夜晚有着更好的视野.

UI_trait_PackmuleDesc.CN: 增加背包及容器的容量.

UI_trait_PoorPassengerDesc.EN: Gets motion sickness in a moving vehicle.
UI_trait_PoorPassengerDesc.CN: 在移动车辆中容易晕车.

UI_trait_SlowHealerDesc.EN: Recovers slowly from injuries and illness.
UI_trait_SlowHealerDesc.CN: 从伤害和疾病中恢复较为缓慢.

UI_trait_SlowReaderDesc.EN: Takes longer to read books and other literature.

UI_trait_SmokerDesc.EN:
Unhappiness rises when tobacco is not smoked.
Stress and unhappiness decrease after smoking tobacco.
UI_trait_SmokerDesc.CN: 吸烟后会减少不快乐和压力, 不抽烟会导致不快乐.

UI_trait_ThinSkinnedDesc.EN: Higher chance of being scratched or bitten by zombies.
UI_trait_ThinSkinnedDesc.CN: 增加划伤或咬伤破皮的机会.

UI_trait_WeakStomachDesc.EN: Higher chance to have food illness.

UI_trait_WhittlerDesc.EN: Can carve wood and bone items.
UI_trait_WhittlerDesc.CN: 可以雕刻木制和骨制物品.

UI_trait_WildernessKnowledgeDesc.EN: Can find medicinal herbs and craft medicines and poultices from them, and make simple stone and bone tools.
UI_trait_WildernessKnowledgeDesc.CN: 可以找到草药并用它们制作药物和敷料, 以及制作简单的石制和骨制工具.

UI_trait_athleticdesc.EN:
Faster running speed.
Can run for longer without tiring.
UI_trait_athleticdesc.CN:
奔跑速度更高.
可以奔跑更长的时间而不感到疲劳.

UI_trait_axemandesc.EN:
Better at chopping trees.
Faster axe swing.
UI_trait_axemandesc.CN:
更擅长砍树.
挥动斧头的速度更快.

UI_trait_broodingdesc.CN: 从坏情绪中恢复的较慢.

UI_trait_claustrodesc.EN: Gets panicked when in small indoor rooms.

UI_trait_clumsydesc.CN: 移动时会发出更多噪音.

UI_trait_eagleeyeddesc.EN:
Faster visibility fade.
Higher visibility arc.
Weapon sights more effective at long range.
UI_trait_eagleeyeddesc.CN:
能见度消失得更快.
视野范围更广.
武器瞄准的效果更好.

UI_trait_emaciateddesc.EN: Low strength, low endurance and prone to injury.
UI_trait_emaciateddesc.CN: 力量低, 耐力差且容易受伤.

UI_trait_feebledesc.EN:
Less knockback from melee weapons.
Decreased carrying weight.
UI_trait_feebledesc.CN:
近战武器的击退效果降低.
负重能力减少.

UI_trait_giftgabdesc.EN:
Extra high charisma.
Better chance of currying favour from NPCs.
UI_trait_giftgabdesc.CN:
魅力十足.
更容易讨好 NPC.

UI_trait_gracefuldesc.CN: 移动时会发出更少噪音.

UI_trait_hardheardesc.CN:
感知半径较小.
听力范围较小.

UI_trait_hypochondesc.EN: May develop infection symptoms without having been infected.
UI_trait_hypochondesc.CN: 可能会在没有被感染的情况下出现感染症状.

UI_trait_luckydesc.EN: Sometimes, things just go your way.
UI_trait_luckydesc.CN: 有时候, 事情会如你所愿.

UI_trait_marksmandesc.EN:
Improved gun accuracy and damage.
Quicker reload.
UI_trait_marksmandesc.CN:
提高射击精度.
换弹更快.

UI_trait_nightowldesc.EN:
Requires little sleep.
Stays extra alert even when sleeping.
UI_trait_nightowldesc.CN:
只需要很少的睡眠.
即使在睡觉的时候也保持高度警觉.

UI_trait_nutritionistdesc.EN: Can see the nutritional values of any food.
UI_trait_nutritionistdesc.CN: 可以看到任何食物的营养价值.

UI_trait_obesedesc.EN: Reduced running speed, very low endurance and prone to injury.
UI_trait_obesedesc.CN: 跑步速度减慢, 耐力极低并容易受伤.

UI_trait_outdoorsmandesc.EN: Less affected by harsh weather conditions.
UI_trait_outdoorsmandesc.CN: 不受恶劣天气条件的影响.

UI_trait_outofshapedesc.CN: 低耐力, 低耐力恢复.

UI_trait_overweightdesc.EN: Reduced running speed, low endurance and prone to injury.
UI_trait_overweightdesc.CN: 跑步速度减慢, 耐力低并容易受伤.

UI_trait_pronetoillnessdesc.EN:
More prone to disease.
Faster rate of zombification.
UI_trait_pronetoillnessdesc.CN:
更容易生病.
僵尸化的速度更快.

UI_trait_resilientdesc.EN:
Less prone to disease.
Slower rate of zombification.
UI_trait_resilientdesc.CN:
不容易生病.
僵尸化的速度较慢.

UI_trait_shortsighdesc.EN:
Smaller view distance.
Slower visibility fade.
Weapon sights less effective.
UI_trait_shortsighdesc.CN:
视野范围较小.
能见度消失得更慢.
武器瞄准的效果较差.

UI_trait_stoutdesc.EN:
Extra knockback from melee weapons.
Increased carrying weight.
UI_trait_stoutdesc.CN:
近战武器拥有更高的击退效果.
负重能力增加.

UI_trait_strongdesc.EN:
Extra knockback from melee weapons.
Increased carrying weight.
UI_trait_strongdesc.CN:
近战武器拥有更高的击退效果.
负重能力增加.

UI_trait_thickskinneddesc.EN: Lower chance of being scratched or bitten.
UI_trait_thickskinneddesc.CN: 减少划伤或咬伤破皮的机会.

UI_trait_underweightdesc.EN: Low strength, low endurance and prone to injury.
UI_trait_underweightdesc.CN: 力量低, 耐力差且容易受伤.

UI_trait_unfitdesc.EN: Very low endurance and endurance regeneration.
UI_trait_unfitdesc.CN: 极低的耐力, 极低的耐力恢复.

UI_trait_unluckydesc.EN: What could go wrong for you, often does.
UI_trait_unluckydesc.CN: 对你来说可能不好的事情, 经常会发生.

UI_trait_veryunderweightdesc.EN: Very low strength, very low endurance and prone to injury.
UI_trait_veryunderweightdesc.CN: 力量很低, 耐力很差且容易受伤.

UI_trait_weakdesc.EN:
Far less knockback from melee weapons.
Extremely small carrying weight.
UI_trait_weakdesc.CN:
近战武器的击退效果降低.
负重能力减少.

UI_trait_weightgaindesc.EN: Permanent tendency to gain weight. Starts with High Weight trait.
UI_trait_weightgaindesc.CN: 永久性特质, 更容易增加体重. 初始具有体重过重特质.

UI_trait_weightlossdesc.EN: Permanent tendency to lose weight. Starts with Low Weight trait.
UI_trait_weightlossdesc.CN: 永久性特质, 更容易减少体重. 初始具有体重过轻特质.

UI_worldscreen_MapNotFound.CN: 地图丢失. 请检查所需的模组是否已经安装.

UI_worldscreen_ModNotFound.EN: Mods are missing.  Loading may damage your save. Load anyways?
UI_worldscreen_ModNotFound.CN: 模组丢失. 加载可能会损坏你的存档. 仍然加载吗?
